BS.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Long-term Debt
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

BS.label: Deferred Offering Costs
BS.description: Specific incremental costs directly attributable to a proposed or actual offering of securities which are deferred at the end of the reporting period.

BS.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
BS.description: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Derivative Liability
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Notes Payable
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Security Deposit
BS.description: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

BS.label: Marketable Securities
BS.description: Amount of investment in marketable security.

BS.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

BS.label: Other Receivables
BS.description: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

BS.label: Interest Payable
BS.description: Amount of interest payable on debt, including, but not limited to, trade payables.

BS.label: Investments
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

BS.label: Dividends Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

BS.label: Interest Receivable
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

BS.label: Loans Payable
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Deposit Assets
BS.description: The carrying amount of the asset transferred to a third party to serve as a deposit, which typically serves as security against failure by the transferor to perform under terms of an agreement.

BS.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs.

BS.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
BS.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

BS.label: Deposits
BS.description: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

BS.label: Income Taxes Receivable
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.

BS.label: Prepaid Supplies
BS.description: Amount of consideration paid in advance for supplies that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Escrow Deposit
BS.description: The designation of funds furnished by a borrower to a lender to assure future payments of the borrower's real estate taxes and insurance obligations with respect to a mortgaged property. Escrow deposits may be made for a variety of other purposes such as earnest money and contingent payments. This element excludes replacement reserves which are an escrow separately provided for within the US GAAP taxonomy.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

BS.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Tax Deferred Income
BS.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from tax deferred revenue or income classified as other.

BS.label: Inventory, Noncurrent
BS.description: Inventories not expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

BS.label: Other Long-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

BS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
BS.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

BS.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross
BS.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Subscriptions Receivable
BS.description: Note received instead of cash as contribution to equity. The transaction may be a sale of capital stock or a contribution to paid-in capital.

BS.label: Unbilled Contracts Receivable
BS.description: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the entity and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts associated with contracts or programs where the recognized revenue for performance thereunder exceeds the amounts billed under the terms thereof as of the date of the balance sheet.

BS.label: Common Stock, Share Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
BS.description: Amount of subscription receivable from investors who have been allocated common stock.

BS.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Liability
BS.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as a liability.

BS.label: Accrued Sales Commission, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for sales commissions. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other.

BS.label: Other Notes Payable, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Finite-Lived Patents, Gross
BS.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the costs pertaining to the exclusive legal rights granted to the owner of the patent to exploit an invention or a process for a period of time specified by law. Such costs may have been expended to directly apply and receive patent rights, or to acquire such rights.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

BS.label: Grants Receivable
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interests
BS.description: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Other Long-term Debt
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

BS.label: Other Notes Payable
BS.description: Amount of long-term notes payable classified as other.

BS.label: Secured Debt, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, collateralized debt obligations due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer. Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

BS.label: Settlement Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amounts payable for money transfers, money orders, and consumer payment service arrangements. Settlement liabilities include amounts payable to intermediaries for global payment transfers.

BS.label: Deposit Liabilities, Accrued Interest
BS.description: Amount of accrued but unpaid interest on deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, No Par Value
BS.description: Face amount per share of no-par value preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Outstanding
BS.description: Value of nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer, held by shareholders. Excludes preferred shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

BS.label: Customer Deposits, Current
BS.description: The current portion of money or property received from customers which is either to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or applied to customer receivables in accordance with the terms of the contract or the understandings.

BS.label: PreferredStockConvertibleSharesIssuable
BS.description: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion of preferred stock.

BS.label: Secured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.

BS.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

BS.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of debt discount to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Derivative Asset, Current
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

BS.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Current
BS.description: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Long-term Debt, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Product Warranty Accrual, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Employee-related Liabilities
BS.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

BS.label: Accrued Royalties
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for royalties.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Share-based Arrangements, Liability, Current
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
BS.description: Number of unissued common shares allocated to investor for purchase on subscription basis.

BS.label: Loans Payable to Bank, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer, excluding current portion.

BS.label: Common Stock, Other Shares, Outstanding
BS.description: Number of shares of other common stock instruments held by shareholder, including, but not limited to, exchangeable shares.

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer), including liabilities for compensation costs, fringe benefits other than pension and postretirement obligations, rent, contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

BS.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of deferred tax liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

BS.label: EquitySecuritiesFVNINoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Other Investments
BS.description: Amount of investments classified as other.

BS.label: Retained Earnings, Appropriated
BS.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) not available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings appropriated for specific business purpose.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Current
BS.description: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as current.

BS.label: Customer Advances, Current
BS.description: The current portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: EquitySecuritiesFvNiCurrentAndNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

BS.label: Other Short-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Par Value
BS.description: Carrying amount of the par value of temporary equity outstanding. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Bank Overdrafts
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of payments made in excess of existing cash balances, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the entity. Overdrafts generally have a very short time frame for correction or repayment and are therefore more similar to short-term bank financing than trade financing.

BS.label: Other Receivables, Gross, Current
BS.description: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Short-term Borrowings
BS.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Redemption Price Per Share
BS.description: Amount to be paid per share that is classified as temporary equity by entity upon redemption. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Accrued Insurance, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverage's to employees. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Deposit Liability, Current
BS.description: The current portion, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of deposits held other than customer deposits.

BS.label: Equity Method Investment, Aggregate Cost
BS.description: This element represents the aggregate cost of investments accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

BS.label: Intangible Assets, Current
BS.description: The current portion of nonphysical assets, excluding financial assets, if these assets are classified into the current and noncurrent portions.

BS.label: Other Additional Capital
BS.description: Amount of additional paid-in capital (APIC) classified as other.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense Other, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accrued Bonuses
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for incentive compensation awarded to employees and directors or earned by them based on the terms of one or more relevant arrangements.

BS.label: Deposits Assets
BS.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment in the future.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Certificates of Deposit, at Carrying Value
BS.description: A savings certificate entitling the Entity (that is, bearer) to receive interest at an established maturity date, based upon a fixed interest rate. A certificate of deposit may be issued in any denomination. Certificates of deposit are generally issued by commercial banks and, therefore, insured by the FDIC (up to the prescribed limit). Certificates of deposit generally restrict holders from withdrawing funds on demand without the incurrence of penalties. Generally, only certificates of deposit with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. As a related example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

BS.label: Customer Refund Liability, Current
BS.description: Current regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

BS.label: Advances on Inventory Purchases
BS.description: Carrying value of capitalized payments made in advance for inventory that is expected to be received within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
BS.description: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

BS.label: Deferred Income, Current
BS.description: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Loans Payable to Bank, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of current portion of long-term loans payable to bank due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
BS.description: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost, Current
BS.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount
BS.description: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

BS.label: Restructuring Reserve, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of known and estimated costs associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructurings pursuant to a duly authorized plan, which are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the next operating cycle, if longer. Costs of such activities include those for one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and costs associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement, but excludes costs associated with the retirement of a long-lived asset.

BS.label: Common Unit, Issued
BS.description: Number of common units issued of limited liability company (LLC).

BS.label: Contingent Consideration Classified as Equity, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value of contingent consideration in a business combination that is classified in shareholders' equity.

BS.label: Debt and Lease Obligation
BS.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

BS.label: Investment Owned, at Fair Value
BS.description: Fair value of investment in security owned.

BS.label: Liabilities, Other than Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

BS.label: Nontrade Receivables, Current
BS.description: The sum of amounts currently receivable other than from customers. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share
BS.description: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current
BS.description: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits; however, time deposits and short-term certificates of deposit are not generally included in legally restricted deposits. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes current cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

BS.label: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

BS.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

BS.label: Notes and Loans Payable, Current
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of all long-term notes and loans payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Severance Benefits
BS.description: Liability for amount due employees, in addition to wages and any other money that employers owe employees, when their employment ends through a layoff or other termination. For example, a company may provide involuntarily terminated employees with a lump sum payment equal to one week's salary for every year of employment.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Current
BS.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Plan Assets
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets held under deferred compensation agreements.

BS.label: Derivative Asset, Noncurrent
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Senior Notes, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

BS.label: Workers' Compensation Liability, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Asset Retirement Obligation
BS.description: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

BS.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

BS.label: Receivable from Shareholders or Affiliates for Issuance of Capital Stock
BS.description: Amount due from owner or affiliate of reporting entity for issuance of shares. Includes, but is not limited to, amount due for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount due from officer or director.

BS.label: Security Deposit Liability
BS.description: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.

BS.label: Accrued Advertising, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for advertising of the entity's goods and services. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Loans Payable to Bank
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Aggregate Amount of Redemption Requirement
BS.description: Aggregate amount of redemption requirements for each class or type of redeemable stock classified as temporary equity for each of the five years following the latest balance sheet date. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.

BS.label: Commercial Paper
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Current
BS.description: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent cash, cash equivalents and investments that is restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits classified as long-term; that is not expected to be released from such existing restrictions within one year of the balance sheet date or operating cycle, whichever is longer. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes noncurrent cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

BS.label: Senior Notes, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term notes having the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to debt holders having a lesser priority of repayment.

BS.label: Advances to Affiliate
BS.description: Long-Term advances receivable from a party that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership. This does not include advances to clients.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amount classified as accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Notes Payable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiabilityCurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition, classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Tax and Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences, with jurisdictional netting, and liabilities classified as noncurrent and other.

BS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
BS.description: Cost of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

BS.label: Prepaid Royalties
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiability
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition.

BS.label: Assets Held-in-trust, Current
BS.description: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate within one year of the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

BS.label: Common Unit, Outstanding
BS.description: Number of common units of ownership outstanding of a limited liability company (LLC).

BS.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
BS.description: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

BS.label: Other Loans Payable, Current
BS.description: Amount of long-term loans classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Fair Value of Shares
BS.description: The fair value of shares that would be issued, determined under the conditions specified in the contract if the settlement were to occur at the reporting date.

BS.label: Accounts Payable, Trade
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

BS.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents
BS.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

BS.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
BS.description: Aggregate number of nonredeemable convertible preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

BS.label: Deferred Income, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Notes Payable to Bank, Current
BS.description: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

BS.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Current
BS.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Accrued Investment Income Receivable
BS.description: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

BS.label: Asset Retirement Obligations, Noncurrent
BS.description: Noncurrent portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Long Lived, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of assets classified as held for sale.

BS.label: Notes and Loans, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

BS.label: Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

BS.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Investments and Other Noncurrent Assets
BS.description: Amount of investments, and noncurrent assets classified as other.

BS.label: Settlement Assets, Current
BS.description: Cash received or short term receivables for unsettled money transfers, money orders, consumer payments, or business to business payments. Settlement assets include clearing and settling customers payments due to and from financial institutions and may include cash and cash equivalents.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and other assets expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

BS.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulativeCurrent
BS.description: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as current.

BS.label: Members' Capital
BS.description: Amount of member capital in limited liability company (LLC).

BS.label: Common Unit, Authorized
BS.description: Maximum number of common units of ownership permitted to be issued by a limited liability company (LLC).

BS.label: Debt Instrument, Debt Default, Amount
BS.description: Amount of outstanding long-term debt or borrowing associated with any securities or credit agreement for which there has been a default in principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption provisions, or any breach of covenant that existed at the end of the period and subsequently has not been cured.

BS.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities
BS.description: Sum as of the balance sheet date of the (a) fair values of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, and (b) the carrying amounts of the liabilities arising from financial instruments or contracts used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be extinguished or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.

BS.label: Interest Receivable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of noncurrent interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

BS.label: OtherReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of receivable classified as other and noncurrent.

BS.label: Royalty Guarantees, Commitments, Amount
BS.description: The amount the entity has committed to make for future royalty guarantees.

BS.label: Short-term Non-bank Loans and Notes Payable
BS.description: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Capital and Surplus, Balance
BS.description: The amount of statutory capital and surplus (stockholders' equity) as of the balance sheet date using prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practices (rather than GAAP, if different) of the state or country.

BS.label: Unsecured Debt, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term, uncollateralized debt obligations due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: CryptoAssetFairValue
BS.description: Fair value of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

BS.label: Equity Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of investments accounted under the equity method.

BS.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Investments
BS.description: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

BS.label: Restricted Investments, Current
BS.description: This element represents the current portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

BS.label: Restricted Investments, Noncurrent
BS.description: This element represents the noncurrent portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Equity
BS.description: Value of stock issued under share-based plans to employees or officers which is the unearned portion, accounted for under the fair value method.

BS.label: Finite-Lived License Agreements, Gross
BS.description: Gross carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of certain rights acquired to exercise a certain privilege or pursue a particular business or occupation and which is deemed to have a finite economic life.

BS.label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount of estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share
BS.description: The price per share at which the preferred stock of an entity that has priority over common stock in the distribution of dividends and in the event of liquidation of the entity is redeemed or may be called at. The redemption features of this preferred stock are solely within the control of the issuer.

BS.label: Accrued Liabilities for Commissions, Expense and Taxes
BS.description: The carrying amount for commissions, taxes and other expenses that were incurred but unpaid as of the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Nonredeemable or Redeemable, Issuer Option, Value
BS.description: Value of outstanding nonredeemable convertible preferred stock or outstanding convertible preferred stock that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Share-based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

BS.label: Long-term Investments and Receivables, Net
BS.description: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle) and amount due to the Entity from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such investments and receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

BS.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Value Added Tax Receivable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle), if longer of value added taxes due either from customers arising from sales on credit terms, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities.

BS.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiabilityNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

BS.label: Deferred Income
BS.description: Amount of deferred income excluding obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and other assets expected to be realized or consumed within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI and without Readily Determinable Fair Value
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

BS.label: Interest and Dividends Payable, Current
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity). Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Notes Payable to Bank, Noncurrent
BS.description: The total amount due within more than 12 month, or the operating cycle if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

BS.label: Receivables, Long-term Contracts or Programs
BS.description: Amount to be collected within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from customers in accordance with the contractual provisions of long-term contracts or programs including amounts billed and unbilled as of the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity before Treasury Stock
BS.description: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading
BS.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

BS.label: Unsecured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

BS.label: Common Unit, Issuance Value
BS.description: Stated value of common units of ownership issued by a limited liability company (LLC).

BS.label: CryptoAssetFairValueCurrent
BS.description: Fair value of crypto asset classified as current. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Deferred Costs and Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of deferred cost assets and assets classified as other.

BS.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulativeNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Government Contract Receivable
BS.description: The amount of receivables that are derived from government contracts.

BS.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

BS.label: Other Loans Payable, Long-term, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of long-term loans classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Restricted Investments
BS.description: Investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities whose use is restricted in whole or in part, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

BS.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Preferred Stock
BS.description: Value received from shareholder in nonredeemable preferred stock-related transaction in excess of par value, value contributed to entity and value received from other stock-related transaction. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer. Excludes common stock.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: CryptoAssetFairValueNoncurrent
BS.description: Fair value of crypto asset classified as noncurrent. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Tax Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences, after deferred tax asset, and other tax liabilities expected to be paid after one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityCurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability from government assistance, classified as current.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference Per Share
BS.description: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Cash and Due from Banks
BS.description: For banks and other depository institutions: Includes cash on hand (currency and coin), cash items in process of collection, noninterest bearing deposits due from other financial institutions (including corporate credit unions), and noninterest bearing balances with the Federal Reserve Banks, Federal Home Loan Banks and central banks.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

BS.label: Funds Held for Clients
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the funds held on behalf of others and that are expected to be liquidated within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. This does not include funds held under reinsurance agreements.

BS.label: Management Fee Payable
BS.description: Amount of fee payable for management of fund or trust.

BS.label: Other Restricted Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

BS.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

BS.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss of accounts and financing receivables. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Tax Receivable, Current
BS.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and other tax receivables expected to be realized or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Indefinite-Lived Trade Names
BS.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

BS.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Current
BS.description: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual that is expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

BS.label: Related Party Deposit Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of deposits held by the entity for a related party (entity, shareholder, employee).

BS.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Noncurrent
BS.description: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable after one year from the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Receivables from Customers
BS.description: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

BS.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount, Current
BS.description: The amount that is required to be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if as of the reporting date, the holder of the share has exercised the right to or the shares are mandatorily redeemable within one year of the reporting date or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable from Securitization
BS.description: The amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current, Other
BS.description: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Commitments, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of arrangements with third parties, including, but not limited to, operating lease arrangement and arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, or has agreed to commit resources to supply goods or services.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer and noncurrent obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities, noncurrent).

BS.label: Development in Process
BS.description: The current amount of expenditures for a real estate project that has not yet been completed.

BS.label: Nontrade Receivables, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent portion of the receivable other than from customers, that is amounts expected to be collected after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
BS.description: The number of nonredeemable preferred stock (shares) (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) allocated to investors to buy shares of a new issue of preferred stock before they are offered to the public. When stock is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the shares to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds.

BS.label: Advance Rent
BS.description: Amount at the balance sheet date that has been received by the entity that represents rents paid in advance.

BS.label: Assets, Noncurrent, Other than Noncurrent Investments and Property, Plant and Equipment
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets, excluding property, plant, and equipment and other property and investments, that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Charges and Other Assets.

BS.label: Billings in Excess of Cost, Current
BS.description: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized within one year or one operating cycle, whichever is longer, from the reporting date.

BS.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be realized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust
BS.description: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, but not limited to, rabbi trust) set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees.

BS.label: Customer Funds
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts received from and refundable to customers unless used by them to obtain goods and services from the entity.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Current
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading), classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Long-term Liability Charges
BS.description: The total amount of long-term liability charges that are being deferred beyond one year.

BS.label: Deposit Contracts, Liabilities
BS.description: Carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date pertaining to amounts received by the insurer or reinsurer from the insured (including a ceding company) under insurance or reinsurance contracts for which insurance risk is not transferred.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise
BS.description: Total amount of liabilities subject to compromise.

BS.label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Current
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as current.

BS.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationCurrent
BS.description: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program, classified as current.

BS.label: Dividends Receivable
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but not received.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Grants Receivable, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) of amounts due under the terms of governmental, corporate, or foundation grants.

BS.label: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
BS.description: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

BS.label: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes pension plan.

BS.label: Partners' Capital
BS.description: The amount of ownership interest of different classes of partners in limited partnership.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Credit Card Receivables
BS.description: Amounts receivable from issuing a card to individuals or businesses that allows someone to make a purchase on borrowed money.

BS.label: Customer Advances, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future.

BS.label: Inventory, Parts and Components, Net of Reserves
BS.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date for elements of machinery or equipment held for the purpose of replacing similar parts in the course of repair or maintenance.

BS.label: Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
BS.description: Portion of equity (net assets) in a subsidiary not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity which is not redeemable by the parent entity.

BS.label: Other Inventory, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of inventories not expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle (such as inventory related to long-term contracts or program rights).

BS.label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Subscriptions
BS.description: Amount of subscription received from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Retained Earnings Not Available for Dividends
BS.description: The amount of retained earnings as of the balance sheet date that cannot be distributed to stockholders pursuant to statutory rules and regulations.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Guaranty Liabilities
BS.description: This item represents a non-contingent liability for the fair value of an obligation to stand ready to perform over the term of a guaranty issued in the event that specified triggering events or conditions occur.

BS.label: Hedging Assets, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Indefinite-Lived Contractual Rights
BS.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date of rights with an indefinite period of benefit that arose from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

BS.label: Inventory, Net of Allowances, Customer Advances and Progress Billings
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of valuation reserves, other allowances, and customer advances received on long-term contracts or programs, of inventory expected to be converted to cash, sold or exchanged within the normal operating cycle.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale
BS.description: Amount, before valuation allowance, of financing receivable classified as held-for-sale.

BS.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Carrying Amount
BS.description: Amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the parent entity, classified as other equity.

BS.label: Retail Related Inventory, Merchandise
