BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise inventory purchased by a retailer, wholesaler or distributor and held for future sale.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
BS.description: Aggregate monetary value of a new issue of securities which have been allocated to investors to buy. When security is sold on a subscription basis, the issuer does not initially receive the total proceeds. In general, the issuer does not issue the security to the investor until it receives the entire proceeds. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: AccountsReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts receivable classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination, expected to be realized beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Costs in Excess of Billings
BS.description: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Restricted
BS.description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading and Available-for-sale
BS.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences, after deferred tax asset, and other liabilities expected to be paid after one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Inventory for Long-term Contracts or Programs, Gross
BS.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves, and progress payments, of inventory associated with long-term contracts, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Land Available-for-sale
BS.description: Amount of investment in land held for sale.

BS.label: Materials, Supplies, and Other
BS.description: The carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, and other assets, which are not included in inventory but used in production.

BS.label: Medium-term Notes, Current
BS.description: Amount of debt instrument classified as medium-term and current.

BS.label: PayablePreferredStockRedeemed
BS.description: Amount of payable for preferred stock reacquired. Includes, but is not limited to, unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

BS.label: Amount of Deferred Costs Related to Long-term Contracts
BS.description: Amount of deferred costs for long-term contracts and programs. Includes, but is not limited to, initial tooling costs and deferred production costs.

BS.label: FIFO Inventory Amount
BS.description: The amount of FIFO (first in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
BS.description: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

BS.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLeaseAfterAccumulatedDepreciation
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

BS.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Liquidation Value
BS.description: The amount of the liquidation value for auction market preferred securities.

BS.label: Common Stock Issued, Employee Stock Trust
BS.description: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, a 'rabbi trust') set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees. This trust does not allow employees to immediately or after a holding period diversify into nonemployer securities. The deferred compensation plan for which this trust is set up must be settled by the delivery of a fixed number of shares of employer stock.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Restricted
BS.description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

BS.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Asset
BS.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as an asset.

BS.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Current
BS.description: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year of the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

BS.label: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Current
BS.description: The current portion of Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedAfterAccumulatedAmortization
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

BS.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account
BS.description: The amount of the limited partners' ownership interests.

BS.label: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValue
BS.description: Fair value of shares that would be issued upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

BS.label: Deferred Employee Stock Ownership Plan, Issuance of Shares or Sale of Treasury Shares
BS.description: The issuance of shares or sale of treasury shares to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

BS.label: Workers' Compensation Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature. Used to reflect the noncurrent portion of the liabilities (due beyond one year; or beyond one operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Airline Related Inventory, Net
BS.description: Net carrying amount, as of the balance sheet date, of expendable merchandise, goods, commodities, or supplies to be used primarily in air transport of passengers and freight.

BS.label: Bank Owned Life Insurance
BS.description: The carrying amount of a life insurance policy on an officer, executive or employee for which the reporting entity (a bank) is entitled to proceeds from the policy upon death of the insured or surrender of the insurance policy.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Deposits on Flight Equipment
BS.description: Carrying amount, at the balance sheet date, of deposits made to the manufacturer for new flight equipment still under construction. May include capitalized interest.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Inventory, Real Estate, Construction in Process
BS.description: Cost of real estate projects incurred for projects for eventual sale or transfer (condominium or time share projects, vacation clubs).

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent portion of the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Notes, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments, excluding current portion.

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Notes, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term debt due within one year or the operating cycle if longer identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments.

BS.label: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent portion of Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Aggregate issuance value of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding.

BS.label: Program Rights Obligations, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid after one year.

IS.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
IS.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

IS.label: Depreciation
IS.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

IS.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

IS.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
IS.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

IS.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
IS.description: Number of new stock issued during the period.

IS.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
IS.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

IS.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
IS.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
IS.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

IS.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

IS.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

IS.label: Accretion (Amortization) of Discounts and Premiums, Investments
IS.description: The sum of the periodic adjustments of the differences between securities' face values and purchase prices that are charged against earnings. This is called accretion if the security was purchased at a discount and amortization if it was purchased at premium. As a noncash item, this element is an adjustment to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

IS.label: Inventory Write-down
IS.description: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

IS.label: Other Noncash Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.

IS.label: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
IS.description: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

IS.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Unrealized
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

IS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
IS.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Termination of Lease
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on termination of lease before expiration of lease term.

IS.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
IS.description: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

IS.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value
IS.description: Value of accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value during the period.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
IS.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
IS.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

IS.label: Accretion Expense
IS.description: Amount recognized for the passage of time, typically for liabilities, that have been discounted to their net present values. Excludes accretion associated with asset retirement obligations.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

IS.label: Write off of Deferred Debt Issuance Cost
IS.description: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.

IS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
IS.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

IS.label: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

IS.label: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
IS.description: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Provision for Other Credit Losses
IS.description: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

IS.label: Gain on Sale of Investments
IS.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

IS.label: Other General Expense
IS.description: Amount of general expenses not normally included in Other Operating Costs and Expenses.

IS.label: Other Operating Income
IS.description: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
IS.description: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Deconsolidation, Gain (Loss), Amount
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from deconsolidation of subsidiary and derecognition of group of assets constituting transfer of business or nonprofit activity, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of good or service in contract with customer.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

IS.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

IS.label: Salary and Wage, NonOfficer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

IS.label: Costs and Expenses, Related Party
IS.description: Costs of sales and operating expenses for the period incurred from transactions with related parties.

IS.label: Debt Related Commitment Fees and Debt Issuance Costs
IS.description: Represents the charge against earnings during the period for commitment fees and debt issuance expenses.

IS.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net
IS.description: Net Increase or Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

IS.label: Loss Contingency, Loss in Period
IS.description: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
IS.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax
IS.description: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Other Selling, General and Administrative Expense
IS.description: Amount of selling, general and administrative expense classified as other.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

IS.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
IS.description: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
IS.description: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

IS.label: Research and Development Asset Acquired Other than Through Business Combination, Written-off
IS.description: Amount of writeoff for research and development asset acquired in transaction other than business combination or from joint venture formation or both. Includes, but is not limited to, software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

IS.label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
IS.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
IS.description: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

IS.label: Preferred Stock, Accretion of Redemption Discount
IS.description: The amount of accretion of the preferred stock redemption discount during the period.

IS.label: Selling Expense
IS.description: Expenses recognized in the period that are directly related to the selling and distribution of products or services.

IS.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Impairments
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

IS.label: Cost of Goods and Service, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization
IS.description: Cost of product sold and service rendered, excluding depreciation, depletion, and amortization.

IS.label: Cost, Amortization
IS.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of intangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

IS.label: Marketing Expense
IS.description: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

IS.label: Salary and Wage, Officer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by officer. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

IS.label: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions
IS.description: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

IS.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

IS.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Stock
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Professional and Contract Services Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for professional and contracted services.

IS.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
IS.description: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

IS.label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
IS.description: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

IS.label: Temporary Equity, Dividends, Adjustment
IS.description: Accretion of temporary equity during the period due to cash, stock, and in-kind dividends. This item is an adjustment to net income necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders and is to be distinguished from Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends (Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends).

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Loss
IS.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
IS.description: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

IS.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
IS.description: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

IS.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer
IS.description: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606.

IS.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
IS.description: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

IS.label: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
IS.description: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

IS.label: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt
IS.description: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

IS.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income
IS.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

IS.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
IS.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

IS.label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization
IS.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

IS.label: Administrative Fees Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for administrative fee from service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, or overhead cost.

IS.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

IS.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of asset in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

IS.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
IS.description: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

IS.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
IS.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

IS.label: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for inducement to convert debt instrument representing fair value of security and other consideration transferred in excess of fair value of security and other consideration issuable pursuant to conversion privilege provided in terms of existing instrument.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, before Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

IS.label: Employee Benefit and Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash
IS.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for employee benefits and share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, pension, other postretirement, postemployment and termination benefits.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Other Cost of Operating Revenue
IS.description: Other costs incurred during the reporting period related to other revenue generating activities.

IS.label: Research and Development Expense, Software (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
IS.description: Research and development expense during the period related to the costs of developing and achieving technological feasibility of a computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed.

IS.label: Financing Interest Expense
IS.description: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, on foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, Tax
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense for integration-related cost incurred in connection with business combination. Includes system integration and conversion costs; severance and other employee-related costs; restructuring and other post-combination costs. Excludes acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination; cost to issue debt or equity securities; and cost related to acquisition of asset.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
IS.description: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

IS.label: Investment Income, Dividend
IS.description: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
IS.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

IS.label: General Insurance Expense
IS.description: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

IS.label: Noncash Merger Related Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
IS.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Investment Income, Investment Expense
IS.description: Amount of expenses related to the generation of investment income.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, Tax
IS.description: Amount, before reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Sales Commissions and Fees
IS.description: Primarily represents commissions incurred in the period based upon the sale by commissioned employees or third parties of the entity's goods or services, and fees for sales assistance or product enhancements performed by third parties (such as a distributor or value added reseller).

IS.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Diluted
IS.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

IS.label: Travel and Entertainment Expense
IS.description: Expenses incurred for travel and entertainment during the period.

IS.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
IS.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

IS.label: Cost, Depreciation
IS.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

IS.label: Management Fee Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the increase (decrease) in fair value of derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments recognized in the income statement.

IS.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmount
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossAfterTax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

IS.label: Interest Income, Deposits with Financial Institutions
IS.description: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

IS.label: Manufacturing Costs
IS.description: The aggregate costs incurred in the production of goods for sale.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
IS.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

IS.label: Equity, Fair Value Adjustment
IS.description: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an instrument classified in shareholders' equity could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

IS.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Discount
IS.description: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
IS.description: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense
IS.description: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Portion of net income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Parent
IS.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

IS.label: Undistributed Earnings, Basic
IS.description: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed.

IS.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Expense
IS.description: The amount of estimated penalties recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

IS.label: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
IS.description: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

IS.label: Business Development
IS.description: Business development involves the development of products and services, their delivery, design and their implementation. Business development includes a number of techniques designed to grow an economic enterprise. Such techniques include, but are not limited to, assessments of marketing opportunities and target markets, intelligence gathering on customers and competitors, generating leads for possible sales, follow-up sales activity, formal proposal writing and business model design. Business development involves evaluating a business and then realizing its full potential, using such tools as marketing, sales, information management and customer service.

IS.label: Impairment Charge on Reclassified Assets
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

IS.label: Other Labor-related Expenses
IS.description: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.

IS.label: Direct Operating Costs
IS.description: The aggregate direct operating costs incurred during the reporting period.

IS.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

IS.label: Revenue from Collaborative Arrangement, Excluding Revenue from Contract with Customer
IS.description: Amount of revenue from collaborative arrangement. Excludes revenue from contract with customer under Topic 606.

IS.label: Royalty Income, Nonoperating
IS.description: Ancillary revenue earned during the period from the consideration paid to the entity for the use of its rights and property by another party. Examples include licensing the use of copyrighted materials and leasing the extraction of natural resources.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
IS.description: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

IS.label: Cost, Depreciation, Amortization and Depletion
IS.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives, and reduction in quantity of natural resource due to consumption directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

IS.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

IS.label: Equipment Expense
IS.description: This element represents equipment expense including depreciation, repairs, rentals, and service contract costs. This item also includes equipment purchases which do not qualify for capitalization in accordance with the entity's accounting policy. This item may also include furniture expenses.

IS.label: InterestExpenseOperating
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

IS.label: Dividend Income, Operating
IS.description: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

IS.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

IS.label: GovernmentAssistanceNonoperatingIncome
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as nonoperating.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Interest Expense, Interest Income, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interests, Net
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

IS.label: LitigationSettlementLoss
IS.description: Amount of loss from litigation settlement for amount awarded to other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

IS.label: Net Investment Income
IS.description: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Loss
IS.description: Amount of realized loss from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
IS.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Exchange Fees
IS.description: The amount of expense in the period for fees charged by securities exchanges for the privilege of trading securities listed on that exchange. Some fees vary with the related volume, while others are fixed.

IS.label: Impairment of Real Estate
IS.description: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Recapitalization Costs
IS.description: Amount of recapitalization costs for professional fees associated with restructuring debt and equity mixture that do not qualify for capitalization.

IS.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
IS.description: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

IS.label: WarrantDownRoundFeatureDecreaseInNetIncomeLossToCommonShareholderAmount
IS.description: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for warrant classified as equity.

IS.label: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
IS.description: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

IS.label: LitigationSettlementGain
IS.description: Amount of gain from litigation settlement for amount awarded from other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

IS.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

IS.label: Information Technology and Data Processing
IS.description: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

IS.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Other
IS.description: Amount of other operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense Directors Fees
IS.description: Amount of expense for service provided by entity's director.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, before Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

IS.label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
IS.description: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Cost, Direct Material
IS.description: Cost of material used for good produced and service rendered.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

IS.label: Research and Development Asset Acquired Other than Through Business Combination, Fair Value Acquired
IS.description: Amount of cost capitalized for research and development acquired in transaction other than business combination or from joint venture formation or both. Includes, but is not limited to, software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

IS.label: Communications and Information Technology
IS.description: The amount of expense in the period for communications and data processing expense.

IS.label: Cost, Direct Labor
IS.description: Cost of labor directly related to good produced and service rendered. Includes, but is not limited to, payroll cost and equity-based compensation.

IS.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainLossNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnrealizedAfterTax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

IS.label: Occupancy, Net
IS.description: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

IS.label: Interest Income (Expense), after Provision for Loan Loss
IS.description: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.

IS.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Depreciation Expense on Property Subject to or Held-for-lease
IS.description: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

IS.label: Production and Distribution Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense related to the production and distribution of goods or services to customers and clients.

IS.label: Supplies Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

IS.label: Weighted Average Limited Partnership Units Outstanding, Diluted
IS.description: Weighted average number of limited partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Used in the calculation of diluted net income or loss per limited partnership unit.

IS.label: CryptoAssetRealizedGainLossNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: Embedded Derivative, Loss on Embedded Derivative
IS.description: Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense
IS.description: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Parent
IS.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

IS.label: Other Noninterest Expense
IS.description: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

IS.label: Reorganization Items
IS.description: Total amount of reorganization items.

IS.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Other
IS.description: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606, classified as other.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
IS.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases
IS.description: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.

IS.label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
IS.description: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

IS.label: CryptoAssetRealizedLossOperating
IS.description: Amount of realized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedLossOperating
IS.description: Amount of unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
IS.description: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

IS.label: Noninterest Income
IS.description: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

IS.label: Taxes, Miscellaneous
IS.description: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.

IS.label: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

IS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Payment for Settlement
IS.description: Amount of payment, which decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract. Excludes decreases to benefit obligation for remeasurement due to settlement.

IS.label: Derivative, Fair Value Hedge, Included in Effectiveness, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as fair value hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, recognized in earnings.

IS.label: Exploration Expense
IS.description: Exploration expenses (including prospecting) related to oil and gas producing entities and would be included in operating expenses of that entity. Costs incurred in identifying areas that may warrant examination and in examining specific areas that are considered to have prospects of containing oil and gas reserves, including costs of drilling exploratory wells and exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells. Exploration costs may be incurred both before acquiring the related property (sometimes referred to in part as prospecting costs) and after acquiring the property. Principal types of exploration costs, which include depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of exploration activities, are: (i) Costs of topographical, geographical and geophysical studies, rights of access to properties to conduct those studies, and salaries and other expenses of geologists, geophysical crews, and others conducting those studies. Collectively, these are sometimes referred to as geological and geophysical or "G&G" costs. (ii) Costs of carrying and retaining undeveloped properties, such as delay rentals, ad valorem taxes on properties, legal costs for title defense, and the maintenance of land and lease records. (iii) Dry hole contributions and bottom hole contributions. (iv) Costs of drilling and equipping exploratory wells. (v) Costs of drilling exploratory-type stratigraphic test wells.

IS.label: Insurance Commissions
IS.description: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Deposits
IS.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

IS.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Nonredeemable
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

IS.label: PreferredStockConvertibleDownRoundFeatureIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount1
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for convertible preferred stock.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Project
IS.description: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale of a project.

IS.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating
IS.description: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

IS.label: Operating Insurance and Claims Costs, Production
IS.description: Insurance and claims costs directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Weighted Average Limited Partnership Units Outstanding, Basic
IS.description: Weighted average number of limited partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

IS.label: Closed Block Operations, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a disposal group, which is allocated to the operations of the closed block.

IS.label: CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: CryptoAssetRealizedLossNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of realized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

IS.label: OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTaxParent
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to parent.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance and Operations
IS.description: Amount of operating expense for routine plant maintenance, repairs and operations of regulated operation.

IS.label: Aircraft Maintenance, Materials, and Repairs
IS.description: Amount of expense for maintenance and repair of aircraft. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of inspection, repair, material, and routine maintenance of aircraft.

IS.label: Aircraft Rental and Landing Fees
IS.description: Amount of expense for leasing aircraft from third party and cost incurred at airport in which airline conducts flight operation. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid to airport authority for takeoff and landing, gate space and facility, security, fuel storage facility, and other terminal costs.

IS.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedLossNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

IS.label: Increase (Decrease) in Participation Liabilities
IS.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of participation liabilities.

IS.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Interest Expense
IS.description: Amount of interest expense recognized for liability for future policy benefit.

IS.label: Loan Portfolio Expense
IS.description: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

IS.label: OciEquityMethodInvestmentAfterTaxNoncontrollingInterest
IS.description: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLossAfterReclassificationAdjustmentTaxParent
IS.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.

IS.label: OciMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificCreditRiskGainLossAfterAdjustmentsAndTaxParent
IS.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, attributable to parent.

IS.label: OrganizationalCostExpense
