IS.description: Amount of expense for formation and organizational costs incurred to establish entity to do business.

IS.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

CF.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
CF.description: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

CF.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
CF.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
CF.description: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

CF.label: Interest Expense
CF.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
CF.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities
CF.description: The gross value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities.

CF.label: Investment Income, Interest
CF.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Goodwill
CF.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

CF.label: InterestExpenseNonoperating
CF.description: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
CF.description: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

CF.label: Cash
CF.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

CF.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Warrant Issued
CF.description: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from the issuance of warrants. Includes allocation of proceeds of debt securities issued with detachable stock purchase warrants.

CF.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio
CF.description: Ratio applied to the conversion of stock split, for example but not limited to, one share converted to two or two shares converted to one.

CF.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Issuance Costs
CF.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from direct costs associated with issuing stock. Includes, but is not limited to, legal and accounting fees and direct costs associated with stock issues under a shelf registration.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Deferred Offering Costs
CF.description: Specific incremental costs directly attributable to a proposed or actual offering of securities which are deferred at the end of the reporting period.

CF.label: Restructuring Charges
CF.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

CF.label: Interest Expense, Debt
CF.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

CF.label: Restricted Cash, Current
CF.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

CF.label: Interest Income (Expense), Net
CF.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
CF.description: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Other Nonoperating Expense
CF.description: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

CF.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
CF.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
CF.description: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Other Income
CF.description: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

CF.label: Other Expenses
CF.description: Amount of expense classified as other.

CF.label: Professional Fees
CF.description: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

CF.label: Interest Income, Other
CF.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

CF.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Convertible Debt with Conversion Feature
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from recognition of deferred taxes for convertible debt with a beneficial conversion feature.

CF.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Shares Issued
CF.description: The number of shares issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or payments in the period.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

CF.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value, Adjustment
CF.description: Amount of decrease to net income for accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

CF.label: Interest and Other Income
CF.description: The amount of interest income and other income recognized during the period. Included in this element is interest derived from investments in debt securities, cash and cash equivalents, and other investments which reflect the time value of money or transactions in which the payments are for the use or forbearance of money and other income from ancillary business-related activities (that is, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

CF.label: Interest Expense, Other
CF.description: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

CF.label: Investment Income, Net
CF.description: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
CF.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax
CF.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

CF.label: Research and Development Expense (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
CF.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Excludes cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed, writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both, and write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

CF.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Realized
CF.description: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

CF.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
CF.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

CF.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
CF.description: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

CF.label: Other Restructuring Costs
CF.description: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

CF.label: Interest Income, Operating
CF.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Investment Income, Nonoperating
CF.description: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares Withheld for Tax Withholding Obligation
CF.description: Number of shares used to settle grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

CF.label: Gain on Sale of Investments
CF.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

CF.label: Other Operating Income
CF.description: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

CF.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Cost Method, Amount
CF.description: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the cost method.

CF.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
CF.description: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Initial Public Offering
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

CF.label: Deconsolidation, Gain (Loss), Amount
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from deconsolidation of subsidiary and derecognition of group of assets constituting transfer of business or nonprofit activity, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of good or service in contract with customer.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties, Current
CF.description: The aggregate increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

CF.label: Payments to Fund Long-term Loans to Related Parties
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

CF.label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
CF.description: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

CF.label: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed)
CF.description: The net book value of a nonmonetary asset transferred or exchanged in connection with the acquisition of a business or asset in a noncash transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. Nonmonetary assets and liabilities are assets and liabilities that will not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the future.

CF.label: Restructuring Reserve, Settled without Cash
CF.description: Amount of decrease in the reserve for full or partial settlement through consideration other than cash.

CF.label: Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Number of Shares
CF.description: Number of shares of equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Repayment of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
CF.description: The cash inflow from a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
CF.description: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Debt Related Commitment Fees and Debt Issuance Costs
CF.description: Represents the charge against earnings during the period for commitment fees and debt issuance expenses.

CF.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Embedded Derivative, Net
CF.description: Net Increase or Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

CF.label: Loss Contingency, Loss in Period
CF.description: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

CF.label: Other Noncash Income
CF.description: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
CF.description: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

CF.label: PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritiesFvNi
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Affiliates
CF.description: The cash inflow from an entity that is affiliated with the entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed
CF.description: The total amount of [all] liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
CF.description: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Security Deposits
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in security deposits.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
CF.description: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Research and Development Asset Acquired Other than Through Business Combination, Written-off
CF.description: Amount of writeoff for research and development asset acquired in transaction other than business combination or from joint venture formation or both. Includes, but is not limited to, software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-term Investments
CF.description: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

CF.label: Repayments of Senior Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.

CF.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
CF.description: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

CF.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferred
CF.description: Amount of consideration transferred in asset acquisition. Includes, but is not limited to, cash, liability incurred by acquirer, and equity interest issued by acquirer.

CF.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Impairments
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

CF.label: Cost, Amortization
CF.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of intangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

CF.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Upward Price Adjustment, Annual Amount
CF.description: Amount of gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Payables Assumed
CF.description: The amount of payables that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Long-term Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

CF.label: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions
CF.description: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

CF.label: Cash Divested from Deconsolidation
CF.description: Reduction in cash due to no longer including the former subsidiary's cash in the consolidated entity's cash.

CF.label: Deferred Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
CF.description: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future periods.

CF.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
CF.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Machinery and Equipment
CF.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of machinery and equipment.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
CF.description: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

CF.label: Professional and Contract Services Expense
CF.description: Amount of expense for professional and contracted services.

CF.label: Amortization of Deferred Charges
CF.description: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

CF.label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
CF.description: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain
CF.description: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
CF.description: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Impairment of Leasehold
CF.description: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Payments, Use
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
CF.description: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

CF.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
CF.description: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

CF.label: Payments of Loan Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

CF.label: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
CF.description: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

CF.label: Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of expense (income); loss (gain); increase (decrease) in liability and (increase) decrease in asset used in operating activity; and cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other; in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
CF.description: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Investments and Cash
CF.description: Sum of investments and unrestricted cash as of the balance sheet date.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuritiesFvNi
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Equity Method Investment, Aggregate Cost
CF.description: This element represents the aggregate cost of investments accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current portion (due within one year or one business cycle) of obligations evidenced by formal promissory notes.

CF.label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt
CF.description: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

CF.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given
CF.description: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Liabilities Incurred
CF.description: Amount of liabilities incurred by the acquirer as part of consideration transferred in a business combination.

CF.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

CF.label: Income Tax Credits and Adjustments
CF.description: A credit or adjustment for government or taxing authority authorized decrease in taxes owed as a result of meeting certain tax policy conditions.

CF.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
CF.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

CF.label: Acquisition Costs, Period Cost
CF.description: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

CF.label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization
CF.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

CF.label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges
CF.description: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Compensation
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation created by employee agreements whereby earned compensation will be paid in the future.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a controlling interest in another entity or an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Software
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

CF.label: Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
CF.description: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
CF.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

CF.label: Repayment of Long-term Debt, Long-term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

CF.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Sale or Disposal of Property, Plant and Equipment
CF.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment from disposition.

CF.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of asset in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

CF.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
CF.description: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
CF.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

CF.label: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
CF.description: Amount of expense for inducement to convert debt instrument representing fair value of security and other consideration transferred in excess of fair value of security and other consideration issuable pursuant to conversion privilege provided in terms of existing instrument.

CF.label: Payments for Royalties
CF.description: The amount of cash paid for royalties during the current period.

CF.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Current
CF.description: The current cash, cash equivalents and investments that are restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against short-term borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits; however, time deposits and short-term certificates of deposit are not generally included in legally restricted deposits. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes current cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

CF.label: Employee Benefit and Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for employee benefits and share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, pension, other postretirement, postemployment and termination benefits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
CF.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

CF.label: Notes Assumed
CF.description: The fair value of notes assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
CF.description: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Bank Overdrafts
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the excess drawing from an existing cash balance, which will be honored by the bank but reflected as a loan to the drawer.

CF.label: Business Acquisition, Share Price
CF.description: Per share price of saleable stock paid or offered to be paid by acquirer in business combination.

CF.label: Financing Interest Expense
CF.description: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

CF.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Premium
CF.description: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Payments of Capital Distribution
CF.description: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Assets, Fair Value Adjustment
CF.description: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an asset could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

CF.label: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
CF.description: Amount of expense for integration-related cost incurred in connection with business combination. Includes system integration and conversion costs; severance and other employee-related costs; restructuring and other post-combination costs. Excludes acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination; cost to issue debt or equity securities; and cost related to acquisition of asset.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

CF.label: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

CF.label: Payments for Capital Improvements
CF.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

CF.label: Payments for Hedge, Financing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
CF.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Interest Received
CF.description: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.

CF.label: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
CF.description: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Deposits
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

CF.label: Investment Income, Dividend
CF.description: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

CF.label: Product Warranty Expense
CF.description: The expense charged against earnings for the period pertaining to standard and extended warranties on the entity's goods and services granted to customers.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

CF.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value, Including Discontinued Operations
CF.description: For the entity and the disposal group, cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the Entity may deposit additional funds at any time and also effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Compensating balance arrangements that do not legally restrict the withdrawal or usage of cash amounts may be reported as Cash and Cash Equivalents, while legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or company statements of intention with regard to particular deposits are not generally reported as cash and cash equivalents.

CF.label: Noncash Merger Related Costs
CF.description: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.

CF.label: Notes Reduction
CF.description: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Tenant Allowance
CF.description: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
CF.description: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Intangible Assets, Current
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in intangible assets (for example patents and licenses).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Unbilled Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amount of revenue for work performed for which billing has not occurred, net of uncollectible accounts.

CF.label: Payments for Tenant Improvements
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for cost of leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Short-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.

CF.label: Other Payments to Acquire Businesses
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with other payments to acquire businesses including deposit on pending acquisitions and preacquisition costs.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-term Loans to Related Parties
CF.description: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

CF.label: ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax
CF.description: Amount of excise tax on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Shares Issued
CF.description: The number of shares issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
CF.description: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

CF.label: Payments of Debt Restructuring Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for cost incurred in the modification of term of existing debt agreement in order for the entity to achieve some advantage.

CF.label: Provision for Other Losses
CF.description: Amount of expense related to other loss.

CF.label: Restricted Cash and Investments, Noncurrent
CF.description: The noncurrent cash, cash equivalents and investments that is restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Restrictions may include legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or entity statements of intention with regard to particular deposits classified as long-term; that is not expected to be released from such existing restrictions within one year of the balance sheet date or operating cycle, whichever is longer. Excludes compensating balance arrangements that are not agreements which legally restrict the use of cash amounts shown on the balance sheet. Includes noncurrent cash equivalents and investments that are similarly restricted as to withdrawal, usage or disposal.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits Outstanding
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in monies given as security or collateral for items acquired or borrowed on a temporary basis. Deposits may also be paid as initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossAfterTax
CF.description: Amount, after tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deferred Liability
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred obligations classified as other.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Liabilities Assumed
CF.description: Amount of liabilities, classified as other, assumed in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

CF.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiability
CF.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
CF.description: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
CF.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Current
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from note holders for outstanding loans.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

CF.label: Convertible Preferred Stock Converted to Other Securities
CF.description: Value of convertible preferred stock that was converted to other securities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Assets Held-for-sale
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in book value of long-lived assets that the reporting entity plans to sell within one year (or one business cycle).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Taxes
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Discount
CF.description: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Noncash Contribution Expense
CF.description: Noncash charitable contributions made by the entity during the period.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
CF.description: The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-term Investments
CF.description: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of long-term investments which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
CF.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Production Related Impairments or Charges
CF.description: Nonrecurring impairment charges related to the write-off of production-related equipment and inventory. This tag is used when an Entity charges this cost to cost of goods sold.

CF.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Construction in Progress Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
CF.description: Future cash outflow to pay for construction in progress expenditures that have occurred.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

CF.label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
CF.description: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease
CF.description: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Deposits
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

CF.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Current
CF.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
CF.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of cash collateral held for borrowed securities, for which the cash is restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
CF.description: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax, Parent
CF.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

CF.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Received
CF.description: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration received in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

CF.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredContingentConsideration
CF.description: Amount of contingent consideration recognized as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restructuring Reserve
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) of the liability pertaining to the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination and to asset retirement obligations.

CF.label: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings
CF.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

CF.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Period Charge
CF.description: The change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods, which change has been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Private Placement
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

CF.label: Prepaid Interest
CF.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Proceeds from Secured Notes Payable
CF.description: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

CF.label: Settlement Assets, Current
CF.description: Cash received or short term receivables for unsettled money transfers, money orders, consumer payments, or business to business payments. Settlement assets include clearing and settling customers payments due to and from financial institutions and may include cash and cash equivalents.

CF.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion of Dividends
CF.description: Value of accretion of temporary equity during the period due to unpaid dividends.

CF.label: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of expense (income) and loss (gain) in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Cash Acquired in Excess of Payments to Acquire Business
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of a business when the cash held by the acquired business exceeds the cash payments to acquire the business.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

CF.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Expense, Amortization
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

CF.label: Impairment Charge on Reclassified Assets
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

CF.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
CF.description: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

CF.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

CF.label: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.

CF.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense
CF.description: Amount of accretion expense recognized during the period that is associated with an asset retirement obligation. Accretion expense measures and incorporates changes due to the passage of time into the carrying amount of the liability.

CF.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating assets after deduction of noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Assets Acquired
CF.description: Amount of assets, classified as other, acquired in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
CF.description: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

CF.label: Royalty Income, Nonoperating
CF.description: Ancillary revenue earned during the period from the consideration paid to the entity for the use of its rights and property by another party. Examples include licensing the use of copyrighted materials and leasing the extraction of natural resources.

CF.label: Transfer to Investments
CF.description: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

CF.label: CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseIncludingExchangeRateEffectDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperations
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change; attributable to discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
CF.description: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

CF.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
CF.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

CF.label: Restricted Cash and Investments
CF.description: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

CF.label: Cost, Depreciation, Amortization and Depletion
CF.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible and intangible assets over their useful lives, and reduction in quantity of natural resource due to consumption directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

CF.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

CF.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Settlements Receivable
