CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in insurance settlements receivable, which are amounts due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy. The expectation is that such reimbursement will be received within one year of the balance sheet date.

CF.label: InterestExpenseOperating
CF.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Notes Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Transfers and Changes
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment from reclassification, impairment, donation, and change classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

CF.label: Repayments of Commercial Paper
CF.description: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.

CF.label: Contribution of Property
CF.description: Value of property contributed in noncash investing and financing activities.

CF.label: Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Other Related Parties
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables due from related parties classified as other.

CF.label: LitigationSettlementLoss
CF.description: Amount of loss from litigation settlement for amount awarded to other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

CF.label: Proceeds from Construction Loans Payable
CF.description: The cash inflow from borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Unsecured Notes Payable
CF.description: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

CF.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents, Noncurrent
CF.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as noncurrent. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Straight Line Rent
CF.description: Difference between actual rental income due and rental income recognized on a straight-line basis.

CF.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

CF.label: Dividends, Paid-in-kind
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends (PIK) declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

CF.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Loss
CF.description: Amount of realized loss from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Finance Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of assets used to generate operating income.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Supplies
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for supplies that provide economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Loans Assumed
CF.description: The fair value of loans assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
CF.description: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

CF.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-term Notes
CF.description: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

CF.label: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
CF.description: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

CF.label: CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseIncludingExchangeRateEffectContinuingOperations
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage, including effect from exchange rate change; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Impairment of Real Estate
CF.description: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Long-term Receivables, Current
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) of receivables that were originally due beyond one year (or one business cycle).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Insurance
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Royalties Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for compensation payments related to the use of copyrights, patents, trade names, licenses, technology. Royalty payments are also paid by the lease holders for oil, gas, and mineral extraction.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

CF.label: Investment Tax Credit
CF.description: The amount deducted from an entities' taxes, reflecting a percentage of an amount invested in certain assets spread over the useful life of those assets; includes deferred investment tax credits.

CF.label: ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTaxPayable
CF.description: Amount of excise tax payable on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

CF.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
CF.description: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

CF.label: WarrantDownRoundFeatureDecreaseInNetIncomeLossToCommonShareholderAmount
CF.description: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for warrant classified as equity.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash Used to Settle Award
CF.description: Aggregate cash paid by the entity during the period to settle equity instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Notes Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the sum of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; and from note holders for outstanding loans.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: LitigationSettlementGain
CF.description: Amount of gain from litigation settlement for amount awarded from other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Accounts Receivable Acquired
CF.description: The amount of accounts receivable that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Deposits
CF.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from deposits classified as other.

CF.label: Payments of Derivative Issuance Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of a derivative security.

CF.label: Postemployment Benefits, Period Expense
CF.description: Period expense related to postemployment benefits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

CF.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve, Effect on Income, Net
CF.description: The difference between the change in the inventory reserve representing the cumulative difference in cost between the first in, first out and the last in, first out inventory valuation methods and any LIFO decrement which have been reflected in the statement of income during the period.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Inventory Acquired
CF.description: The amount of inventory that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Other Restricted Assets, Current
CF.description: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

CF.label: Repayments of Construction Loans Payable
CF.description: The cash outflow from repayment of borrowings to finance the cost of construction.

CF.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Period Increase (Decrease)
CF.description: Change in the value of each type or class of stock classified as temporary equity during the period. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.

CF.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain (Loss), Net
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of acquisition-date fair value of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

CF.label: Escrow Deposit Disbursements Related to Property Acquisition
CF.description: Amount of escrow deposit disbursements related to property acquisition in noncash investing or financing transactions.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Commodity Contract Assets and Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the assets (liabilities) created through trading commodity-based derivative instruments.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Leasing Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from lessees arising from lease agreements.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Customers
CF.description: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in amounts payable to customers. The term customers generally excludes other broker-dealers; persons who are principal officers, directors, and stockholders; and persons whose securities or funds are part of the regulatory net capital of the broker-dealer. Another broker-dealer's account can be classified as a customer if the account is carried as an omnibus account in compliance with certain regulations. The accounts of principal officers, directors and stockholders may be combined in the customer captions if they are not material and the combination is disclosed in the oath that is required to accompany the annual audited FOCUS Report.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Property and Other Taxes Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of cash payments due to taxing authorities for non-income-related taxes.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Proceeds from Secured Lines of Credit
CF.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

CF.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredOtherAssets
CF.description: Amount of tangible and intangible assets included as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition, classified as other. Excludes cash.

CF.label: Escrow Deposits Related to Property Sales
CF.description: Escrow deposits related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Asset Retirement Obligations
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of asset retirement obligations.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Billing in Excess of Cost of Earnings
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability reflecting cash payments received before the related costs have been incurred.

CF.label: PaymentForAcquisitionCryptoAsset
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: Payments for Hedge, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

CF.label: Payments for Other Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for operating activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Business Three, Net of Cash Acquired
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with a third acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Investments to be Held in Decommissioning Trust Fund
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of investments that will be held in a decommissioning trust fund.

CF.label: Proceeds from Accounts Receivable Securitization
CF.description: Proceeds from securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

CF.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
CF.description: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

CF.label: Research and Development Asset Acquired Other than Through Business Combination, Fair Value Acquired
CF.description: Amount of cost capitalized for research and development acquired in transaction other than business combination or from joint venture formation or both. Includes, but is not limited to, software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

CF.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainLossNonoperating
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: Deferred Revenue, Refund Payments
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to customers for refund payments of revenue that was previously reported as deferred or unearned revenue.

CF.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash
CF.description: Amount of currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits, held by a disposal group.

CF.label: ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossUnrealizedAfterTax
CF.description: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Investment Income Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in investment income that has been earned but not yet received in cash.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current operating assets after deduction of current operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
CF.description: The amount of net gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Land
CF.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

CF.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

CF.label: ProceedsFromDisposalCryptoAsset
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from disposal of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
CF.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

CF.label: Repayments of Medium-term Notes
CF.description: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

CF.label: Settlement of Asset Retirement Obligations Through Noncash Payments, Amount
CF.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled through noncash transactions. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

CF.label: Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Assumptions
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the assumptions or model used to calculate the fair value of a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

CF.label: Cumulative Dividends
CF.description: Amount of cumulative cash dividends distributed to shareholders.

CF.label: Customer Funds
CF.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts received from and refundable to customers unless used by them to obtain goods and services from the entity.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Current
CF.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading), classified as current.

CF.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Other Change
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change, classified as other.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
CF.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventories and Other Operating Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in inventory, and assets classified as other.

CF.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
CF.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: InterestIncomeShortTermInvestmentOther
CF.description: Amount of interest income from short-term investment classified as other.

CF.label: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Receivables
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

CF.label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Repayments of Accounts Receivable Securitization
CF.description: Repayments of securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

CF.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Range of Outcomes, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Value, High
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

CF.label: Consideration Received for Beneficial Interest Obtained for Transferring Financial Asset
CF.description: Amount of beneficial interest received as consideration for transferring noncash financial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, trade receivable in securitization transaction.

CF.label: CryptoAssetRealizedGainLossNonoperating
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Amortization Expense
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred sales inducement cost.

CF.label: Embedded Derivative, Loss on Embedded Derivative
CF.description: Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
CF.description: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale of financing receivable, including, but not limited to, lease receivable.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income
CF.description: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries or equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Other Related Parties, Current
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party receivables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value Adjustments on Other Assets (Liabilities) Carried at Fair Value under Fair Value Option
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value adjustment on other assets (liabilities) carried at fair value under the fair value option on the statement of cash flows of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in insurance liability balances during the period.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension Benefits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit or defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

CF.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from operating activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

CF.label: Variable Interest Entity, Initial Consolidation, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: The gain (loss) recognized on initial consolidation of a variable interest entity (VIE) when the VIE is not a business (as defined).

CF.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset retirement obligations.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Condemnation
CF.description: The gain (loss) is the pre-tax difference between the net condemnation award and the entity's adjusted basis of the condemned property.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Interest in Projects
CF.description: Gain (loss) included in earnings resulting from the sale of interest in projects.

CF.label: GovernmentAssistanceOperatingExpense
CF.description: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance, classified as operating.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Marketable Securities, Restricted
CF.description: The change during the period, either increase or decrease, in total debt and equity financial instruments including: (1) securities held-to-maturity, (2) trading securities, and (3) securities available-for-sale that are pledged to one or more secured parties who have the right to buy, sell, or re-pledge the collateral.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Self Insurance Reserve
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) of Restricted Investments
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Available-for-sale Securities, Short-term
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term available-for-sale securities.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Trust Preferred Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of trust preferred securities, which possess characteristics of both equity and debt securities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Repayments of Long-term Loans from Vendors
CF.description: Cash outflows under financing arrangements with vendors (seller-financed debt), which had a maturity date at inception of more than one year (or more than one operating cycle, if longer); such debt may have arisen from purchases of property, plant and equipment or other productive assets.

CF.label: Transfer from Investments
CF.description: Value of investments transferred from the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Accounts Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable from change in methodology.

CF.label: Amortization of Deferred Hedge Gains
CF.description: The amount of expense charged against earnings by an Entity to record deferred gains and losses on hedge instruments. Examples include gain on economic hedges, amortization of gain on designated fair value hedge and so forth.

CF.label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
CF.description: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

CF.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

CF.label: CryptoAssetRealizedLossOperating
CF.description: Amount of realized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedLossOperating
CF.description: Amount of unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in obligations owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Lease Acquisition Costs
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in the balance of capitalized lease acquisition costs during the period. The cost usually covers a variety of administrative costs, such as the cost of obtaining a credit report, verifying insurance coverage, lease commission charges, checking the accuracy and completeness of the lease documentation, and entering the lease in data processing and accounting systems.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Postemployment Obligations
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion of the liability that represents various benefits due to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits
CF.description: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

CF.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Proceeds
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables related to a loss contingency.

CF.label: Other Adjustments to Income, Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of noncash income (expense), classified as other, from discontinued operations.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Trading Securities, Short-term
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from sales and purchases of trading securities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Principal Repayments on Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Long-term Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

CF.label: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
CF.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

CF.label: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Sales-type Lease, Selling Profit (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of profit (loss) recognized at commencement from sales-type lease.

CF.label: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
CF.description: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

CF.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Payment for Settlement
CF.description: Amount of payment, which decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract. Excludes decreases to benefit obligation for remeasurement due to settlement.

CF.label: Derivative, Cost of Hedge Net of Cash Received
CF.description: The premium (cost) of a hedge, net of any cash received on settlement during the period.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
CF.description: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Affiliates
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of mortgage loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Royalties
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Unearned Premiums
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

CF.label: InterestExpenseInterestBearingLiability
CF.description: Amount of interest expense on interest-bearing liability.

CF.label: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Receivables
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow from the purchase of receivables classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Trading Securities Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities
CF.description: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

CF.label: Repayments of Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
CF.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes repayments of short-term and long-term debt.

CF.label: Depletion
CF.description: The noncash expense charged against earnings to recognize the consumption of natural resources.

CF.label: Dividend Income, Equity Securities, Operating
CF.description: Amount of dividend income on investment in equity security, classified as operating.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Reclassification to Held-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of financing receivable reclassified to held-for-sale.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Project
CF.description: The gains and losses included in earning resulting from the sale of a project.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Materials and Supplies
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of capitalized costs of materials, supplies, or both, which are not included in inventory.

CF.label: Payments for Participation Liabilities
CF.description: Cash payments related to participation costs.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

CF.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Limited Partnership Investments
CF.description: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

CF.label: Proceeds from Subordinated Short-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

CF.label: Amortization of Advance Royalty
CF.description: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of the advance royalties. These royalties are paid in one accounting period, but are deducted from earnings over time through amortization. For example, royalties that are required to be paid in advance of production from a mineral, oil, or gas property and amortized over the period of right to produce these items.

CF.label: CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseExcludingExchangeRateEffectDisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperations
CF.description: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash, cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossNonoperating
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossOperatingAndNonoperating
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating and nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes standard product warranties.

CF.label: GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreaseCurrent
CF.description: Amount of decrease in asset from government assistance, classified as current.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: IncreaseDecreaseInManagementFeePayable
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) management fee payable for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of other financial instruments used in operating activities.

CF.label: IncreaseDecreaseInProfessionalFeePayable
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fee payable for professional service, including, but not limited to, legal and accounting services.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Retail Related Inventories
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of merchandise inventory held by a retailer, wholesaler, or distributor for future sale; includes packaging and other supplies used to store, transport, or present merchandise inventory.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Workers' Compensation Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due for insurance (or actual expenses) to cover the medical expenses and lost income for employees that are injured during the course of doing work-related activities.

CF.label: Payments for Leasing Costs, Commissions, and Tenant Improvements
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost and cost for leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Held-to-maturity Securities, Short-term
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Payments for Purchase of Securities, Operating Activities
CF.description: Cash paid to purchase debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
CF.description: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset for use in the normal oil and gas operations and to purchase mineral interests in oil and gas properties not intended for resale.

CF.label: Proceeds from Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes proceeds from long-term and short-term debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received
CF.description: Cash received for dividends and interest on the entity's equity and debt investments during the current period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-investment
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

CF.label: Cash and Securities Segregated under Federal and Other Regulations
CF.description: Amount of cash subject to withdrawal restrictions, restricted deposits held as compensating balances, and cash and securities segregated in compliance with regulations (such as cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers).

CF.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedLossNonoperating
CF.description: Amount of unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

CF.label: GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncrease
CF.description: Amount of increase in asset from government assistance.

CF.label: Health Care Organization, Stop Loss Insurance Premium Expense
CF.description: Stop-loss insurance premiums recognized as expense. In stop-loss insurance, prepaid health care providers or associated entities transfer portions of their financial risks to other companies. A provider typically contracts to recover health care costs in excess of stated amounts during the contract periods.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund borrowed from other financial institution arising from the insufficient reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Health Care Insurance Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in health care insurance liability balances during the period.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities
CF.description: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Participation Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of participation liabilities.

CF.label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
CF.description: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

CF.label: Net Change Interest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits domestic.

CF.label: Payments for Delayed Tax Exempt Exchange
CF.description: Cash outflow related to a property which is traded for the promise to provide a replacement like-kind property in the near future also known as a tax deferred exempt exchange.

CF.label: ProceedsFromAdvanceForAndContributionInAidOfConstructionFinancingActivity
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from advance for and contribution in aid of construction, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

CF.label: Transfer of Portfolio Loans and Leases to Held-for-sale
CF.description: Value of loans and leases held in the entity's portfolio transferred to loans and leases held-for-sale in noncash transactions.

CF.label: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentDerivativeAndForeignCurrencyTransactionOperatingAfterTax
CF.description: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment, derivative, and foreign currency transaction, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Number of Reportable Segments
unclassified.description: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

unclassified.label: Number of Operating Segments
unclassified.description: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discrete financial information is available. An operating segment may engage in business activities for which it has yet to earn revenues, for example, start-up operations may be operating segments before earning revenues.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
unclassified.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease having initial or remaining lease term in excess of one year to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
unclassified.description: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-based Compensation Cost
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the option's term.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
unclassified.description: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Foreign
unclassified.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to foreign operations, which is defined as Income or Loss generated from operations located outside the entity's country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Current Foreign Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Percent
