unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of the country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Share Price
unclassified.description: Price of a single share of a number of saleable stocks of a company.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights
unclassified.description: Exercise price per share or per unit of warrants or rights outstanding.

unclassified.label: Deferred Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

unclassified.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Foreign Income Tax Rate Differential, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, in Process Research and Development
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Variable Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Research
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible research tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Short-term Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
unclassified.description: Aggregate change in value for stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock purchase plan.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized loss in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Warrants or Rights
unclassified.description: Number of securities into which the class of warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, 500,000 warrants may be converted into 1,000,000 shares.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Issued for Services
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Value of the stock issued includes, but is not limited to, services contributed by vendors and founders.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Other
unclassified.description: Value of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
unclassified.description: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price of options that were either forfeited or expired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant
unclassified.description: The difference between the maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) authorized for issuance under the plan (including the effects of amendments and adjustments), and the sum of: 1) the number of shares (or other type of equity) already issued upon exercise of options or other equity-based awards under the plan; and 2) shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance on granting of outstanding awards, net of cancellations and forfeitures, if applicable.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Price Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or per unit amount of equity securities issued.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
unclassified.description: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
unclassified.description: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
unclassified.description: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
unclassified.description: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) as of the balance sheet date pertaining to a specified type of cost associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Minimum
unclassified.description: The minimum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Maximum
unclassified.description: The maximum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Price Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share amount received by subsidiary or equity investee for each share of common stock issued or sold in the stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of options vested. Excludes equity instruments other than options, for example, but not limited to, share units, stock appreciation rights, restricted stock.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Maximum
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the maximum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability
unclassified.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Minimum
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the minimum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) in additional paid in capital (APIC).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
unclassified.description: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

unclassified.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Domestic
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible domestic operating loss carryforwards. Excludes state and local operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, State and Local
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible state and local operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
unclassified.description: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Aggregate Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which current fair value of underlying stock exceeds exercise price of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of discretionary contributions made by an employer to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
unclassified.description: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Cash, FDIC Insured Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of cash deposited in financial institutions as of the balance sheet date that is insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation,Other Reconciling Items, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to other reconciling items. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of pro forma revenue of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation attributable to other reconciling item. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Work in Process, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of merchandise or goods in the production process expected to be completed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Credit, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Convertible Securities
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of the conversion of convertible securities.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Financial and Nonfinancial Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Number
unclassified.description: Number of fully vested and expected to vest exercisable options that may be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Call Options and Warrants
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of call options and warrants using the treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Raw Materials, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of raw materials expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of options vested.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries intended to be permanently reinvested outside the country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued upon Conversion
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued for each share of convertible preferred stock that is converted.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount
unclassified.description: Amount remaining authorized for purchase of share under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Noncurrent
Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Current
Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Employees' Gross Pay
unclassified.description: Percentage of employees' gross pay for which the employer contributes a matching contribution to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Number of Reporting Units
unclassified.description: Number of reporting units tested for impairment of goodwill. A reporting unit is an operating segment or one level below an operating segment.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of non-vested options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Converted
unclassified.description: The number of shares converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Match
unclassified.description: Percentage employer matches of the employee's percentage contribution matched.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding stock options as of the balance sheet date for all option plans in the customized range of exercise prices.

unclassified.label: Shares, Issued
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued as of the balance sheet date, including shares that had been issued and were previously outstanding but which are now held in the treasury.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from inventory.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Exercisable
unclassified.description: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding exercisable stock options as of the balance sheet date in the customized range of exercise prices for which the market and performance vesting condition has been satisfied.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration transferred, consisting of acquisition-date fair value of assets transferred by the acquirer, liabilities incurred by the acquirer, and equity interest issued by the acquirer.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of New Accounting Principle in Period of Adoption (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Agreed-upon price for the exchange of the underlying asset relating to the share-based payment award.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage
unclassified.description: Effective interest rate for the funds borrowed under the debt agreement considering interest compounding and original issue discount or premium.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of options vested.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual
unclassified.description: Amount of loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in unrecognized tax benefits attributable to uncertain tax positions taken in tax returns.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for more than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible debt securities using the if-converted method.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Foreign
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contributions Per Employee, Percent
unclassified.description: Maximum percentage of employee gross pay the employee may contribute to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the obligation for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities exceeding one year or beyond the operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties and interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal, through the balance sheet date and due to be paid more than one year (or one operating cycle, if longer) after the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Option, Nonvested, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of non-vested options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of operating lease payments.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated, Period Percent
unclassified.description: The number of positions eliminated during the period as a percentage of total positions eliminated during the period in connection with the restructuring plan(s).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position without allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
Deferred Revenue, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously reported as deferred or unearned revenue.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Each Warrant or Right
unclassified.description: Number of securities into which each warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, each warrant may be converted into two shares.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of the tax credit carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderTaxEffectPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Credit, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Letters of Credit Outstanding, Amount
unclassified.description: The total amount of the contingent obligation under letters of credit outstanding as of the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average exercise price as of the balance sheet date for those equity-based payment arrangements exercisable and outstanding.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Cash and Equivalents
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
unclassified.description: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Research and Development, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research and development expense.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of additional shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Purchase Plans
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of an employee stock purchase plan.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderTaxEffectAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
Fair Value, Assets, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Prepaid Expenses
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from prepaid expenses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of unrecorded obligation to transfer funds in future for fixed or minimum amount or quantity of product and service at fixed or minimum price. Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced and take-or-pay and throughput contracts.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of equity instruments other than options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested instruments.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued during the period pursuant to acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other
unclassified.description: This element represents movements included in the statement of changes in stockholders' equity which are not separately disclosed or provided for elsewhere in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderOtherAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderOtherPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The weighted average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees could acquire the underlying shares with respect to all outstanding stock options which are in the customized range of exercise prices.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of other commitment not otherwise specified in the taxonomy. Excludes commitments explicitly modeled in the taxonomy, including but not limited to, long-term and short-term purchase commitments, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, supply commitments, registration payment arrangements, leases, debt, product warranties, guarantees, environmental remediation obligations, and pensions.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Purchase of Assets
unclassified.description: Value of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals, classified as other.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdiiPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to foreign-derived deduction eligible income (FDDEI) (formerly referred to as foreign-derived intangible income (FDII)).

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Sought, Value
unclassified.description: The value (monetary amount) of the award the plaintiff seeks in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares Issued in Period
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Shares, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued which are neither cancelled nor held in the treasury.

unclassified.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Subsidiary Equity Issuance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from subsidiary issuance of equity interests to noncontrolling interest holders.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized. Includes amount, before amortization expense and impairment loss, of goodwill for private company.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Granted
unclassified.description: Net number of non-option equity instruments granted to participants.

unclassified.label: Area of Land
unclassified.description: Area of land held.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of weighted-average expected volatility for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Interest Included in Payments
unclassified.description: Amount necessary to reduce net minimum lease payments to present value for capital leases.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationFdiiAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax benefit from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to foreign-derived deduction eligible income (FDDEI) (formerly referred to as foreign-derived intangible income (FDII)).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
Stock and Warrants Issued During Period, Value, Preferred Stock and Warrants
unclassified.description: Value of preferred stock and warrants for common stock issued.

unclassified.label: Area of Real Estate Property
unclassified.description: Area of a real estate property.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Interest Carryforward
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible interest carryforward.

unclassified.label: Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosures
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate During Period
unclassified.description: The average effective interest rate during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: The portion of the valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from net operating loss carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Exercised
unclassified.description: Number of non-option equity instruments exercised by participants.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
unclassified.description: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Entity Listing, Par Value Per Share
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Financial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial obligations, including, but not limited to, debt instruments, derivative liabilities, federal funds purchased and sold under agreements to repurchase, securities loaned or sold under agreements to repurchase, financial instruments sold not yet purchased, guarantees, line of credit, loans and notes payable, servicing liability, and trading liabilities.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Business Combination
