unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from a business combination.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated
unclassified.description: The number of positions eliminated during the period as a result of restructuring activities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Subject to Expiration
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are subject to expiration dates.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Excluding Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost to be recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Money Market Funds, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by definition. Original maturity means an original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Research and Development, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible research and development expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in goodwill acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, from divestiture.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Rent
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
unclassified.description: Value of new stock classified as temporary equity issued during the period.

unclassified.label: Cash, Uninsured Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of cash as of the balance sheet date that is not insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of property, plant, and equipment acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Enterprise, Deficit Accumulated During Development Stage (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage
unclassified.description: For an entity that discloses a concentration risk in relation to quantitative amount, which serves as the "benchmark" (or denominator) in the equation, this concept represents the concentration percentage derived from the division.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Redemptions or Purchase of Interests
unclassified.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest (for example, but not limited to, redeeming or purchasing the interests of noncontrolling shareholders, issuance of shares (interests) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to the parent entity for other than cash, and a buyback of shares (interest) by the non-wholly owned subsidiary from the noncontrolling interests).

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Present Value of Net Minimum Payments
unclassified.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, including amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

unclassified.label: Current Federal, State and Local, Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense accrued for an underpayment of income taxes.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Deferred Rent
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred rent.

unclassified.label: Long-term Purchase Commitment, Amount
unclassified.description: The minimum amount the entity agreed to spend under the long-term purchase commitment.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Distributions to Noncontrolling Interest Holders
unclassified.description: Decrease in noncontrolling interest balance from payment of dividends or other distributions by the non-wholly owned subsidiary or partially owned entity, included in the consolidation of the parent entity, to the noncontrolling interest holders.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Disposals
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in property, plant, and equipment from disposition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
unclassified.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Accelerated Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of additional cost recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement from occurrence of event accelerating recognition of cost.

unclassified.label: Accrued Professional Fees
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for professional fees, such as for legal and accounting services received.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Diluted
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease reasonably possible in the next twelve months for the unrecognized tax benefit.

unclassified.label: Interest on Convertible Debt, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of interest recognized on convertible debt instrument excluding interest on principal required to be paid in cash.

unclassified.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of remaining performance obligation to total remaining performance obligation not recognized as revenue.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Intangible Assets, Other than Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of identifiable intangible asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date. Excludes goodwill and financial asset.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to repatriation of foreign earnings.

unclassified.label: State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise stock options, restrictive stock units (RSUs), convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), and other dilutive convertible securities.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Issuances
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments
unclassified.description: The net amount of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities, net of adjustments (for example, to additional paid in capital) including the write-off of an equity component recognized to record the convertible debt instrument as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This item is meant to disclose the value of shares issued on conversion of convertible securities that were recorded as two separate (debt and equity) components.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of non-vested options forfeited.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period related to Restricted Stock Awards, net of any shares forfeited.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Compensation
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee compensation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from provisions, reserves, allowances, and accruals, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Amount Outstanding (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Number, after forfeiture, of shares or units issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes shares or units issued under employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

unclassified.label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Amount of Unrecorded Benefit
unclassified.description: The amount of the unrecognized tax benefit of a position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount thereof will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of prepaid expense and asset classified as other, acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Capital Leased Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of leased physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Land
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depletion of real estate held for productive use, excluding land held for sale.

unclassified.label: SegmentReportingOtherItemAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense (income) and loss (gain) calculated as difference between segment revenue and separately disclosed expense category to arrive at segment profit (loss).

unclassified.label: Adjustment to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Effect from Share-based Compensation, Net
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of accounts payable assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Foreign
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Remaining Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Amount of borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded to Other Party
unclassified.description: Amount awarded to other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings
unclassified.description: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than Twelve Months, Fair Value
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Research and Development Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from research and development costs.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Intrinsic value of outstanding award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of non-vested options forfeited.

unclassified.label: Accrued Rent, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for contractual rent under lease arrangements. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Percentage of Voting Interests Acquired
unclassified.description: Percentage of voting equity interest acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

unclassified.label: Other Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Translation
unclassified.description: Foreign exchange rate used to translate amounts denominated in functional currency to reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Current
unclassified.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Current, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Purchase Price of Common Stock, Percent
unclassified.description: Purchase price of common stock expressed as a percentage of its fair value.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Fair Value
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Continuing Operations
Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the restructuring reserve from an adjustment to a previously accrued restructuring liability.

unclassified.label: Debt, Long-term and Short-term, Combined Amount
unclassified.description: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the repatriation of foreign earnings.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Liabilities, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Lower Range Limit
unclassified.description: The floor of a customized range of exercise prices for purposes of disclosing shares potentially issuable under outstanding stock option awards on all stock option plans and other required information pertaining to awards in the customized range.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Upper Range Limit
unclassified.description: The ceiling of a customized range of exercise prices for purposes of disclosing shares potentially issuable under outstanding stock option awards on all stock option plans and other required information pertaining to awards in the customized range.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expensed and Capitalized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost expensed and capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
unclassified.description: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as an asset out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
unclassified.description: Minimum amount to be expended to satisfy the terms of arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, excluding long-term purchase commitments or unconditional purchase obligations.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Transfers Into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Restricted Stock Unit, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for restricted stock unit under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, receivable from customer for product and service.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts, Notes and Loans Receivable, Net
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts, notes and loans receivable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer), from the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Liability, Transfers Into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Number of Businesses Acquired
unclassified.description: Number of businesses acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Value of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Finite-Lived Intangibles
unclassified.description: Amount of identifiable finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Meals and Entertainment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible meals and entertainment expense.

unclassified.label: Other Sundry Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements that are due within one year or operating cycle, if longer, from the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Accrued Vacation, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for unused vacation time owed to employees based on the entity's vacation benefit given to its employees. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Goodwill Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Purchase Price (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The total charge for the use of long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments including both interest and principal payments.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Twelve Months or Longer, Fair Value
Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in earnings and other comprehensive loss (OCI).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
unclassified.description: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

unclassified.label: Excess Stock, Shares Issued
unclassified.description: Number of excess stock shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders.

unclassified.label: Inventory Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of inventory reserves for last-in first-out (LIFO) and other inventory valuation methods.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
unclassified.description: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost
unclassified.description: Amount expected to be recognized in earnings for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Warrants or Options Issued
unclassified.description: The number of warrants issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Exercise of Option, Tax Benefit
unclassified.description: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Tax Benefit Realized from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Estimated Litigation Liability
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying amount of the estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs.

unclassified.label: Taxes Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Future Minimum Sublease Rentals
unclassified.description: Contractually required future rental payments receivable on noncancelable subleasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Purchase of Assets
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued during the period as part of a transaction to acquire assets that do not qualify as a business combination.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Principal
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to principal.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Derivative, Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of the assets less the liabilities of a derivative or group of derivatives.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Common Stock Subject to Repurchase or Cancellation
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common stock subject to repurchase or cancellation determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Common stock subject to repurchase are outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall).

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Decrease, Forgiveness
unclassified.description: Decrease for amounts of indebtedness forgiven by the holder of the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Charitable Contribution Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible charitable contribution carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowances, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences from reserves and accruals, compensation and benefit costs, and other provisions, reserves, and allowances.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Costs of Goods Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of costs of goods sold attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of operating income (loss) attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Interest on Income Taxes Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense for an underpayment of income taxes.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Meals and Entertainment, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to meals and entertainment expense.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Proceeds from Loans
unclassified.description: Cash received from principal payments made on loans related to operating activities.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

unclassified.label: Warrant, Exercise Price, Decrease
unclassified.description: Per share decrease in exercise price of warrant. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Cash Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Derivative Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from derivative instruments.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards forfeited during the period.

unclassified.label: Warrants Not Settleable in Cash, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of warrants not settleable in cash classified as equity.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Annual Principal Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of annual principal payment for debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Alternative Minimum Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible alternative minimum tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance, Noncurrent
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized costs.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss
unclassified.description: Reflects the estimated amount of loss from the specified contingency as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Retired
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common and preferred stock retired from treasury during the period.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Cost and Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to cost and expense.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Gains on Trading Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on trading securities.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate at Period End
unclassified.description: The effective interest rate at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
unclassified.description: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Revenue of Acquiree since Acquisition Date, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of acquiree's revenue since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Sublease Rentals
unclassified.description: The total amount of sublease rental income recognized during the period that reduces the entity's rent expense incurred under operating leases.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in property, plant, and equipment from addition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Rights, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of vesting of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Capital Units, Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of authorized capital units or capital shares. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Dividends, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Asset (Liability)
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset after deduction of liability.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, New Claims Filed, Number
unclassified.description: The total number of new claims filed pertaining to a loss contingency during the period.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Increase (Decrease) for Contract Acquired in Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due, from business combination.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, State Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from state taxes.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
unclassified.description: Future minimum rental payments in aggregate as of the balance sheet date under operating leases.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for estimated claims under standard and extended warranty protection rights granted to customers.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Dividend
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued to shareholders as a dividend during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Authorized Repurchase Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Warrant, Exercise Price, Increase
unclassified.description: Per share increase in exercise price of warrant. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-in-trust
unclassified.description: The total amount of cash and securities held by third party trustees pursuant to terms of debt instruments or other agreements as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, which can be used by the trustee only to pay the noncurrent portion of specified obligations.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling within One Year, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Fee Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fee that accompanies borrowing money under the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred revenue recognized for transactions arising during the current reporting period. Deferred revenue is a liability as of the balance sheet date related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized. Generally, an Entity records deferred revenue when it receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized in conformity with GAAP.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Contingently Issuable Shares
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares are those shares that are issuable for little or no cash contingent on certain conditions being met.

unclassified.label: Investment Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of interest on investment.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Dilutive Convertible Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of dilutive convertible securities excluding adjustments related to ESOP convertible preferred stock, stock options, and restrictive stock units.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Two Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the second year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received Per Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration received by subsidiary or equity investee in exchange for shares of stock issued or sold. Includes amount of cash received, fair value of noncash assets received, and fair value of liabilities assumed by the investor.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance, Current
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contributions Per Employee, Amount
unclassified.description: Maximum amount the employee may contribute to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, General and Administrative Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of general and administrative expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within one year of the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Three Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the third year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Available-for-sale Securities
Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory penalties accrued for a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed by the entity, in its tax return.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets, Current
