unclassified.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a liability into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed.

unclassified.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Minimum Rentals
unclassified.description: This element represents the payments that the lessee is obligated to make or can be required to make in connection with a property under the terms of an agreement classified as an operating lease, excluding contingent rentals and a guarantee by the lessee of the lessor's debt and the lessee's obligation to pay (apart from the rental payments) executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes.

unclassified.label: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionRatio
unclassified.description: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion for each share of preferred stock to be converted.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Payments
unclassified.description: The estimated amount of dividends to be paid to holders of the underlying shares (expected dividends) over the option's term. Dividends are taken into account because payment of dividends to shareholders reduces the fair value of the underlying shares, and option holders generally do not receive dividends.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Remaining Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
unclassified.description: Number of shares remaining authorized to be purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount of inventory acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Impairment Losses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated impairment losses.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, after Year Five for Next Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Holiday, Aggregate Dollar Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of income taxes from which a reporting entity is exempt or for which it will receive a reduction in income taxes as a result of the income tax holiday granted by the taxing jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Current Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Amount of current borrowing capacity under the credit facility considering any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed (for example, borrowings may be limited by the amount of current assets), but without considering any amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest, Percentage Rate
unclassified.description: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: PreferredStockConvertibleConversionPrice
unclassified.description: Per share conversion price of preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Selling, General and Administrative Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Convertible, Carrying Amount of Equity Component
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of the equity component of convertible debt which may be settled in cash upon conversion.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from goodwill.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

unclassified.label: Dividends Payable, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: The per share amount of a dividend declared, but not paid, as of the financial reporting date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Restricted Stock
unclassified.description: Number of shares of restricted stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that restricted shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Restricted shares are subject to sales, contractual, regulatory or other restrictions that prevent or inhibit the holder from freely disposing of them before the restriction ends.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Earnings or Loss of Acquiree since Acquisition Date, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of acquiree's earnings (loss) since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Other Noncurrent Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of deferred costs.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Total Compensation Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Future Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Goodwill, Other Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Transfers
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from transfer into (out of) asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Pending Claims, Number
unclassified.description: Number of pending claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Nonredeemable Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after income tax of income (loss) including the portion attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling interest. Excludes the portion attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest recognized as temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Four Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the fourth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested in Period, Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Exit Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Includes, but is not limited to, one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and termination benefits associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement. Excludes expenses associated with special or contractual termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage price of original principal amount of debt at which debt can be redeemed by the issuer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Equity Method Investments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from equity method investments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Currency Losses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses on foreign currency transactions.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate During Period
unclassified.description: The effective interest rate during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Adoption, Quantification (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Employee-related Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued.

unclassified.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, before forfeiture, of shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, before Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Number, before forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
unclassified.description: Aggregate value of stock issued during the period as a result of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

unclassified.label: Net Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of net assets (liabilities).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed), Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to employee service rendered, excluding assumptions about future compensation level.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Percent
Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Paid, Value
unclassified.description: Amount of damages paid to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Prior Period Reclassification Adjustment
unclassified.description: The amount of a reclassification adjustment made to prior period financial statement amounts.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard and extended product warranty.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, ESPP, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for employee stock purchase program (ESPP) award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, at Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Contract with Customer, Performance Obligation Satisfied in Previous Period
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized from performance obligation satisfied or partially satisfied in previous reporting periods. Includes, but is not limited to, change in transaction price.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Cash Received from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Vested
unclassified.description: Intrinsic value of vested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Other (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Goodwill, Expected Tax Deductible Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of goodwill arising from a business combination that is expected to be deductible for tax purposes.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Payments for Underwriting Expense
unclassified.description: Cash paid for expenses incurred during underwriting activities (the process to review insurance applications, evaluate risks, accept or reject applications, and determine the premiums to be charged) for insurance companies.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded obligation to transfer funds in the future for fixed or minimum amounts or quantities of goods or services at fixed or minimum prices (for example, as in take-or-pay contracts or throughput contracts).

unclassified.label: Revenue Recognition, Milestone Method, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: The amount of consideration recognized during the period for the milestone or milestones.

unclassified.label: SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLongLivedAssets
unclassified.description: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived asset included in determination of segment asset by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Long-lived asset excludes financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Per Share Weighted Average Price of Shares Purchased
unclassified.description: Per share weighted-average price paid for shares purchased on open market for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Number of shares related to Restricted Stock Award forfeited during the period.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

unclassified.label: Unsecured Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt, Subsequent Adjustments
unclassified.description: The amount of subsequent adjustments to additional paid in capital for convertible financial instruments where a component of equity and a component of debt are recognized.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Doubtful Other Receivables, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on receivable, classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Cost-method Investments, Other than Temporary Impairment
DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of debt issued.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, General Business
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible general business tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Derivatives
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from derivatives.

unclassified.label: Derivative Assets (Liabilities), at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair values as of the balance sheet date of the net amount of all assets and liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Prepaid and Other Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as prepaid and other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Equity Issuance, Per Share Amount (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis with Unobservable Inputs
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Long-term Loans to Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Due from (to) Related Party
Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost Remaining
unclassified.description: Amount of expected cost remaining for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Salary and Wage, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer and officer employees. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Grant Date Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: The grant-date intrinsic value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of short-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Stock Option, Exercise Price, Increase
unclassified.description: Per share increase in exercise price of option. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision and option granted under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Interest-bearing, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Reflects the effective interest rate as of the balance sheet date on interest-bearing trade payables.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Indefinite-Lived Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of identifiable indefinite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date. Excludes goodwill and financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Rate
unclassified.description: Dividend or interest rate associated with the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction. Noncash are transactions that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments. Part noncash refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Expense from Stock Options Exercised
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax expense from write-off of the deferred tax asset related to deductible stock options at exercise.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount classified as property, plant, and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Amount
Future Amortization Expense, after Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Awarded, Value
unclassified.description: Amount of damages awarded to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received
unclassified.description: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of notes payable.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Prepaid Advertising
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures and Expirations
unclassified.description: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were either cancelled or expired.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from tax credit carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to interest.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Financing Arrangements
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from financing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Gross Profit (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gross profit attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Due to Officers or Stockholders, Current
Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Five Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the fifth year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from License Fees Received
unclassified.description: Cash received from licensees for license fees during the current period.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Recognition of Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock, Shares Issued Net of Shares for Tax Withholdings
unclassified.description: Number, after shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date
unclassified.description: Amount of costs incurred to date for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the restructuring reserve.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Percentage of Ownership after Transaction
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity investee's stock owned by parent company after stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Secured Debt
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

unclassified.label: Senior Notes
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Expirations
unclassified.description: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements for which rights to exercise lapsed.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustments
unclassified.description: Adjustments to temporary equity resulting from foreign currency translation adjustments.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Debt Maturities, Amortized Cost Basis (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions
Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Ratio
unclassified.description: Ratio applied to the conversion of debt instrument into equity with equity shares divided by debt principal amount.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Balance, Principal Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of investment owned.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Parent
unclassified.description: The parent entity's interest in net assets of the subsidiary, expressed as a percentage.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Sublease Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of revenue recognized for the period under subleasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
unclassified.description: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were cancelled as a result of occurrence of a terminating event.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Percentage of Outstanding Stock Maximum
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that may be issued in accordance with the plan as a proportion of outstanding capital stock.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares Purchased for Award
unclassified.description: Number of shares purchased for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Currency Transaction Gains
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on foreign currency transactions.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Upward Price Adjustment, Cumulative Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Holiday, Income Tax Benefits Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share amount effect of the income tax benefit resulting from the income tax holidays granted by taxing jurisdictions.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities that result from activities that generate operating income.

unclassified.label: Interest Costs Incurred
unclassified.description: Total interest costs incurred during the period and either capitalized or charged against earnings.

unclassified.label: Members' Equity
unclassified.description: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC), attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Future minimum lease payments receivable under operating leases for periods greater than five years following the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Restricted Cash, Financing Activities
Value Added Tax Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of value added taxes due either from customers arising from sales on credit terms, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Capital Leases, Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Net
unclassified.description: The total gross amount less the charge for the use of the long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Trading Days
unclassified.description: Threshold number of specified trading days that common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instruments must exceed threshold percentage within a specified consecutive trading period to trigger conversion feature.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Debt Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Benefits Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Income Tax Examination, Liability (Refund) Adjustment from Settlement with Taxing Authority
unclassified.description: The amount of the additional liability or refund received or expected based on a final settlement with a taxing authority.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, at Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of the investment.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Offering Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, legal fee pertaining to share offered for sale, registration fee, underwriting, printing prospectus, and initial fee for listing on exchange.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Payments for Previous Acquisition
unclassified.description: Cash outflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of short-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion, Net
unclassified.description: The effective portion of net gain (loss) reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consideration
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration received or receivable for the disposal of assets and liabilities, including discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Premium Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded from Other Party
unclassified.description: Amount awarded from other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Provision
unclassified.description: Amount charged against operating income increasing loss contingency liability, after adjustments to reduce previously estimated charges.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Rate
unclassified.description: Identify the stated interest rate per the agreement, for example, leasing and debt arrangements between related parties.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Translation and Other Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the restructuring reserve related to foreign currency translation (gain) loss and other increases (decreases).

unclassified.label: Amount of Restricted Net Assets for Consolidated and Unconsolidated Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of restricted net assets of consolidated and unconsolidated subsidiaries as of the end of the most recently completed fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Amortizable Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Range of Outcomes, Value, High
unclassified.description: Maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible loss carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Returns and Allowances
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated returns and sales allowances.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Trading Securities
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Software
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized software.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Finite Lived Intangible Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
unclassified.description: Maximum potential amount of future payments (undiscounted) the guarantor could be required to make under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Underwriting Expense
unclassified.description: Costs incurred during the period, such as those relating to general administration and policy maintenance that do not vary with and are not primarily related to the acquisition or renewal of insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Payments for Deposits
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for deposits on goods and services during the period; excludes time deposits and deposits with other institutions, which pertain to financial service entities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding, Pro Forma
unclassified.description: The weighted average number of shares (units) outstanding in the calculation of pro forma basic earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred and payable classified as other.

unclassified.label: Billed Contracts Receivable
unclassified.description: Amounts due for billed services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the Company and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts billed to customers under contracts or programs but not paid as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Cash and Cash Equivalents (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Class of Warrant or Right, Unissued
unclassified.description: The number of warrants or rights which entitle the entity to receive future services in exchange for the unvested, forfeitable warrants or rights.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Percentage of Stock Price Trigger
unclassified.description: Minimum percentage of common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instruments to determine eligibility of conversion.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Downward Price Adjustment, Annual Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of loss from downward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
unclassified.description: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in indefinite-lived asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fee for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease), Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Change in the weighted average exercise price of options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Accelerated Vesting, Number
unclassified.description: Number of shares for which recognition of cost was accelerated for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Benefit from Stock Options Exercised (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Weighted Average Number of Shares, Contingently Issuable
unclassified.description: Shares issuable for little or no cash consideration upon the satisfaction of certain conditions (contingently issuable shares) are considered outstanding common shares and included in the computation of basic Earnings Per Share as of the date that all necessary conditions have been satisfied (in essence, when issuance of the shares is no longer contingent). Outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall) are treated in the same manner as contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares include shares that (a) will be issued in the future upon the satisfaction of specified conditions, (b) have been placed in escrow and all or part must be returned if specified conditions are not met, or (c) have been issued but the holder must return all or part if specified conditions are not met. The number of contingently issuable shares is determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

unclassified.label: Accrued Payroll Taxes
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory payroll taxes incurred through that date and withheld from employees pertaining to services received from them, including entity's matching share of the employees FICA taxes and contributions to the state and federal unemployment insurance programs.

unclassified.label: Accrued Salaries
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the obligations incurred through that date and payable for employees' services provided.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after One Through Five Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security, measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year through fifth year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Compensation Expense, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit. Other employee benefit expense includes, but is not limited to, service component of net periodic benefit cost for defined benefit plan. Excludes compensation cost in cost of good and service sold.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Rate of Compensation Increase
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate of compensation increase used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contribution Per Employee, Percent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Investments
Goodwill, Impairment Loss, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Incentive from Lessor
unclassified.description: Amount of incentive received by lessee from lessor.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

unclassified.label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Upper Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Shares, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
unclassified.description: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Tax Benefit from Stock Options Exercised (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Tenant Improvements
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of improvements having a life longer than one year that were made for the benefit of one or more tenants.

unclassified.label: Accrued Employee Benefits
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized leases. This element may apply to energy companies that lease mineral producing properties and to other enterprises that capitalize property, plant, or equipment obtained through capital leases.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified within Twelve Months
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of existing gains or losses on cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Legal Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the estimated loss from legal settlements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Finite-Lived Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from long-lived assets other than property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Fixed interest rate related to the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Excess Stock, Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Maximum number of excess stock shares permitted to be issued.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Rent
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for rent that provides economic benefits in future periods.

unclassified.label: Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners
unclassified.description: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Percentage of Fair Value in Excess of Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Percentage of fair value of reporting unit in excess of carrying amount.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Nonvested
unclassified.description: Intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Deficiency from Share-based Compensation
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price, Increase
unclassified.description: Per share increase in conversion price of convertible common stock. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Reclassified to Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time from transfer to receivable due to right to consideration becoming unconditional.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employers Matching Contribution, Annual Vesting Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of employer's matching contributions to a defined contribution plan that vests in a given year.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Qualified Production Activity, Percent
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of plan compensation cost recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
unclassified.description: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Qualified Production Activity, Amount
Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties
