unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed by the reporting entry in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties
unclassified.description: For an unclassified balance sheet, reflects the carrying amount of unpaid loan amounts due from related parties at the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Notes and Loans Payable
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Number of Positions Eliminated
unclassified.description: The expected number of positions to be eliminated as a result of restructuring activities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Short-term Debt, Fair Value
unclassified.description: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued, Value, Stock Options Exercised, Net of Tax Benefit (Expense)
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options, after deduction of related income tax (expense) benefit.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Options and Restrictive Stock Units
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of stock options or restrictive stock units (RSUs).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling within One Year, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of tangible and intangible assets other than cash transferred by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, business or subsidiary, or both, of acquirer transferred to former owner of acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Software Development Costs for Software Sold to Customers
unclassified.description: Unamortized costs incurred for development of computer software, which is to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed, after establishing technological feasibility through to the general release of the software products. Excludes capitalized costs of developing software for internal use.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from inventory.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Benefits Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of payment to participant under defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk related to obligation and assets used to effect settlement.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Percentage Rate
unclassified.description: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Number of Countries in which Entity Operates
unclassified.description: The number of countries in which the entity operates as of balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Research and Development Arrangement, Contract to Perform for Others, Compensation Earned
unclassified.description: The amount of compensation earned (contract income) under a research and development arrangement accounted for as a contract to perform research and development for others.

unclassified.label: Short-term Lease Commitment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term lease commitment.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Deferred Purchase Price
unclassified.description: A device of credit enhancement where a part of the purchase price for the receivable/ payable is retained to serve as a cash collateral.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the par value method.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Ownership Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of the Variable Interest Entity's (VIE) voting interest owned by (or beneficial interest in) the reporting entity (directly or indirectly).

unclassified.label: Variable Lease, Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for variable lease payment excluded from lease liability.

unclassified.label: Accrued Rent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for contractual rent under lease arrangements.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of equity in the acquiree held by the acquirer immediately before the acquisition date in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Threshold Consecutive Trading Days
unclassified.description: Threshold period of specified consecutive trading days within which common stock price to conversion price of convertible debt instrument must exceed threshold percentage for specified number of trading days to trigger conversion feature.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Due to Other Related Parties, Current
Future Amortization Expense, Remainder of Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Supplies, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Aggregated amount of unprocessed materials to be used in manufacturing or production process and supplies that will be consumed. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

unclassified.label: Loss on Sale of Investments
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Loans Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term loans payable classified as other.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Accelerated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accelerated depreciation charged against earnings associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Other Increases (Decreases) in Period
unclassified.description: The addition or reduction in the number of reserved shares that could potentially be issued under the option plan attributable to reasons other than grants, exercises, forfeitures, and expirations during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Temporary Equity, Net Income
unclassified.description: The portion of net income or loss attributable to temporary equity interest.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of accrued expenses.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, Potential Cash Payment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Acquisition of Less than 100 Percent, Noncontrolling Interest, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Earnings (Deficit)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative earnings (deficits) for relevant time periods.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage of Principal Amount Redeemed
unclassified.description: Percentage of principal amount of debt redeemed.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-based Compensation Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense recognized from equity-based compensation arrangements (for example, shares of stock, unit, stock options or other equity instruments), awarded to key employees or individuals. Excludes amount related to plans that cover generally all employees (for example, but not limited to, qualified pension plans).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Bonuses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee bonuses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Available-for-Sale Securities, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
unclassified.description: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Net Rentable Area
unclassified.description: Net rentable area for properties owned.

unclassified.label: Notes Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the holder a definite sum of money at a future date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Net amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net
Payments for Loans
unclassified.description: Cash payments for and related to principal collection on loans related to operating activities.

unclassified.label: Sales and Excise Tax Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Any certificate of deposit or savings account held by a bank or other financial institution for a short-term specified period of time. Because of their short-term, time deposits are considered highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Sale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease from sale of accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Basic Earnings Per Share, Pro Forma
unclassified.description: Pro forma basic earnings per share or earnings per unit, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Prepaid Expense and Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Receivables (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Liability (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Capitalized Contract Cost, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Change in Timeframe, Performance Obligation Satisfied, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized arising from contract liability from change in timeframe for performance obligation to be satisfied.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable and accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation and amortization expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax because of a tax holiday.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Cumulative Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Contract, Asset, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward contracts, and swaps.

unclassified.label: Foreign Earnings Repatriated
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign earnings repatriated from subsidiaries outside the country of domicile.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Borrowings
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Equity Issuance or Sale of Parent Equity Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Other Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates, classified as other. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Payments for Commissions
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for commissions during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Royalties Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for royalties during the current period.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Other Share Increase (Decrease) in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could acquire or could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to any other type of change in shares reserved for issuance.

unclassified.label: Short-term Lease Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term lease payment excluded from lease liability.

unclassified.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period to an employee benefit plan, such as a defined contribution or defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
unclassified.description: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
unclassified.description: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Undistributed Earnings Allocated to Participating Securities (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
Bridge Loan
unclassified.description: Short-Term financing which is expected to be paid back relatively quickly, such as by a subsequent longer-term loan. Also called swing loan or bridge financing.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Value Assigned
unclassified.description: Value of equity interests (such as common shares, preferred shares, or partnership interest) issued or issuable to acquire the entity.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Liabilities Noncurrent
Banking Regulation, Total Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of total capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Estimate of Transaction Price
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in estimate of transaction price which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due. Includes, but is not limited to, change in assessment of whether estimate of variable consideration is constrained.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Number of Equity Instruments
unclassified.description: The number of equity instruments that the holder of the debt instrument would receive if the debt was converted to equity.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Incremental percentage increase (decrease) in the stated rate on a debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlement of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Contracts, Liability, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liability contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward (delivery or nondelivery) contracts, and swaps entered into.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible restructuring charges.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Unit Purchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity unit purchase agreements using the treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments of both interest and principal.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount
unclassified.description: The redemption (or callable) amount of currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not currently declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

unclassified.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Other Revenues from Transactions with Related Party
Repayments of Assumed Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayments of a long-term debt originally issued by another party but is assumed by the entity.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Expected Dividend
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the weighted average expected dividend for an entity using a valuation technique with different dividend rates during the contractual term.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Decrease for Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the standard product warranty accrual from payments made in cash or in kind to satisfy claims under the terms of the standard product warranty. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Spinoff Transaction
unclassified.description: The change in equity as a result of a spin-off transaction (a regular or reverse spin-off) which is based on the recorded amounts.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant and Equipment, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant and equipment.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions, Greater than or Equal to One Year
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred revenue assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Commercial Paper, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Unsecured short-term debt instrument issued by corporations which are highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price, Decrease
unclassified.description: Per share decrease in conversion price of convertible common stock. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment before transfers included in determining net income.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Repurchase Amount
unclassified.description: Fair value amount of debt instrument that was repurchased.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Tax Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Contingencies
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from contingent liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Warranty Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from warranty reserves.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change in terms of existing plan or initiation of new plan.

unclassified.label: Diluted Earnings Per Share Pro Forma
unclassified.description: Pro forma diluted earnings per share, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Downward Price Adjustment, Cumulative Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative loss from downward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sale of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Securities, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible amortization.

unclassified.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of other assets.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Selling and Marketing Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of selling and marketing expense classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid to purchase other assets as part of operating activities.

unclassified.label: Pension Cost (Reversal of Cost)
unclassified.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividends Per Share, Declared
unclassified.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
Proceeds from Sale of Buildings
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sale of buildings.

unclassified.label: Stock Option, Exercise Price, Decrease
unclassified.description: Per share decrease in exercise price of option. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision and option granted under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Increase (Decrease) Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from adjustment.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts Receivable, Charge-offs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredTransactionCost
unclassified.description: Amount of transaction cost incurred as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of asset recognized arising from contingent consideration in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Units, Value
unclassified.description: Value of capital units or capital shares. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of FIN 48 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Customer Advances and Deposits
unclassified.description: Refundable consideration, usually cash, held by the entity pending satisfactory completion of the entity's obligations or pending the closing of a contract.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investment in Noncontrolled Affiliates
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and investments in other affiliates which are not controlled nor consolidated.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, after Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Unused Capacity, Commitment Fee Percentage
unclassified.description: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Number of Plaintiffs
unclassified.description: Number of plaintiffs that have filed claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount after impairment of indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other. Excludes financial assets and goodwill.

unclassified.label: Payments to Employees
unclassified.description: Payments of cash to employees, including wages and salaries, during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds and Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Rental Income, Nonoperating
unclassified.description: Income earned by providing the use of assets to an outside party in exchange for a payment or series of payments that is nonoperating in nature.

unclassified.label: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Book Value
unclassified.description: The net book value of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and lease back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Average Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, average borrowings during the period.

unclassified.label: US Government Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Debt (bills, notes or bonds) that are issued by the government of the United States which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits Resulting in Net Operating Loss Carryforward (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Other Account
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to accounts other than cost and expense.

unclassified.label: Accelerated Share Repurchases, Initial Price Paid Per Share
unclassified.description: The price paid per share to immediately purchase the targeted number of shares on the date of executing the accelerated share repurchase agreement.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Loss, Recovery of Bad Debts
unclassified.description: Amount of recovery of loans and lease receivables which had previously been fully or partially written-off as bad debts.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain from remeasurement of acquisition-date fair value of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Interest Rate of Debt
unclassified.description: The rate of interest that was being paid on the original debt issue that is being converted in the noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, If-converted Value in Excess of Principal
unclassified.description: The amount by which the convertible debt's if-converted value exceeds its principle amount at the balance sheet date, regardless of whether the instrument is currently convertible. This element applies to public companies only.

unclassified.label: Deferred Sales Commission
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of advanced commission payments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Pensions
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from pension benefits.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of defined benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Payment for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of payment, which decreases plan assets of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Actual Allocation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of actual investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

unclassified.label: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to restructuring charges.

unclassified.label: Excess Stock, Shares Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of shares of excess stock held by shareholders.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income for derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Issues
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Land Subject to Ground Leases
unclassified.description: Area of land subject to a ground lease.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Percentage
unclassified.description: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for the line of credit facility regardless of whether the facility has been used.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired
unclassified.description: The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Noncash Income Tax Expense
unclassified.description: The portion of the noncash component of income tax expense for the period other than the portion from the net change in the entity's deferred tax assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Payments for Merger Related Costs
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid during the reporting period for charges associated with the mergers.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Operating Activity
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from lease payment, classified as operating activity.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the accrual for restructuring costs.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instrument Other than Option, Nonvested, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Accrued Rent, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) for contractual rent under lease arrangements.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Other, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after One Through Five Years, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year through fifth year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Deferred Taxes Asset (Liability), Net, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Compensated Absences
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensated absences (includes, but not limited to, sick and personal days).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts for Asset (Liability) Recognized in Statement of Financial Position
unclassified.description: Amount of asset (liability), recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Includes, but is not limited to, lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for right to receive specified benefits, purchase of nonparticipating annuity contract and change from remeasurement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plans, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Administrative Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of administrative expense incurred by defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Depreciation Expense on Reclassified Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation expense for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Revenue (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Excise and Sales Taxes
unclassified.description: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax because of a tax holiday.

unclassified.label: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Interest Revenue (Expense), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Finance Lease, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of finance lease payments.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss on Contract Termination
unclassified.description: The loss recognized on termination of a contract.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Loss, Other than Temporary Impairments, Amount (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

unclassified.label: Research and Development Arrangement, Contract to Perform for Others, Costs Incurred, Gross
unclassified.description: The amount of costs incurred under a research and development arrangement accounted for as a contract to perform research and development for others.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Maximum Number of Shares Per Employee
unclassified.description: The highest quantity of shares an employee can purchase under the plan per period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: The number of shares that would be issued, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the settlement were to occur at the reporting date.
