unclassified.label: Purchase Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Stockholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in stockholders' equity during the period.

unclassified.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligation
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation for supplier finance program.

unclassified.label: Taxes and Licenses
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense, excluding income, excise, production and property taxes, and licenses and fees not related to production.

unclassified.label: Accelerated Share Repurchases, Settlement (Payment) or Receipt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash receipt from (payment to) bank; or stock received from (issuance to) bank in the settlement of the accelerated share repurchase agreement.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax
Available-for-sale Securities, Change in Net Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, which include amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

unclassified.label: Construction Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Cost of Services, Licenses and Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Deferred Revenue and Credits, Current
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date on potential earnings that were not recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP, and which are expected to be recognized as such within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investment in Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the entity's investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Foreign Currency Exchange Rate Changes, Plan Assets (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Income
unclassified.description: Amount of other income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Due from Other Related Parties, Current
EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationBeatAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to base erosion and anti-abuse tax (BEAT).

unclassified.label: FederalStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in foreign income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Balance, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of investment owned.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Patents Allegedly Infringed, Number
unclassified.description: Number of another entity's patents that the entity has allegedly infringed.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Warrants Issued
unclassified.description: The number of warrants issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Other Borrowings
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date for the aggregate of other miscellaneous borrowings owed by the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to reacquire callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Fees Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Sale of Stock, Percentage of Ownership before Transaction
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity investee's stock owned by parent company before stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Compensation Cost (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Expected Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the percentage amount by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during the expected term of a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

unclassified.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationDecreaseSettlement
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in obligation for supplier finance program from settlement.

unclassified.label: Accelerated Share Repurchases, Final Price Paid Per Share
unclassified.description: Final price paid per share for the purchase of the targeted number of shares, determined by an average market price over a fixed period of time.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Debt Maturities, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gains (Losses), Sale Proceeds (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Business Combination Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Liabilities, Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Less Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, less fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: The charge for the use of long-lived depreciable capital leased assets for the period.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Measure of Progress
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in measure of progress which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not Previously Recorded
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), for which no credit loss was previously recorded.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Issued
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued pursuant to the terms of a deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax on Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Amount
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Goodwill, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Incentive to Lessee
unclassified.description: Amount of incentive granted by lessor to lessee.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months, Net
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges as of the balance sheet date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next twelve months.

unclassified.label: Lease Deposit Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for lease payments received, including variable lease payments, when collectability is not probable at commencement date for sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of long-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax Effect (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) before Reclassifications, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) before reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Contributions
unclassified.description: Total contributions made by each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments to Suppliers
unclassified.description: Payments of cash to suppliers for goods and services during the current period.

unclassified.label: Payment for Pension Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Purchase Date
unclassified.description: Discount rate from fair value on purchase date that participants pay for shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Plan Modification, Number of Grantees Affected
unclassified.description: Number of grantees affected by modification of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the standard product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Stock Dividends, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common and preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

unclassified.label: Subordinated Borrowing, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Stated interest rate of the subordinated debt.

unclassified.label: SupplierFinanceProgramObligationIncrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in obligation for supplier finance program.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Measurement Period Adjustment, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of tax liability from transition tax on accumulated earnings of controlled foreign corporation deemed repatriated under United States of America (US) Public Law 115-97 (House of Representatives (H.R.) 1 of 115th Congress).

unclassified.label: Taxes, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense classified as other.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Capitalized Interest Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated interest costs capitalized as part of property, plant and equipment cost basis.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions, Less than One Year
Capitalized Computer Software, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetCost
unclassified.description: Cost of crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Other Capitalized Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized costs classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Comprehensive Income
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains in other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from event reducing expected years of future service of present employees or eliminating accrual of benefits for some or all future services of present employees.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Foreign, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in foreign income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, No Longer Bifurcated, Amount Reclassified to Stockholders' Equity
unclassified.description: The amount of the liability for the conversion option reclassified to stockholders' equity when the embedded option no longer required separation from the host instrument.

unclassified.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Foreign Countries (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value, Asset, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Trademarks, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a specified period of time.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedges Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Total amount of gain (loss) derived from fair value hedges recognized in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
unclassified.description: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Lessee, Assets under Capital Lease
unclassified.description: The amount, during the lease term, of each minimum [capital] lease payment allocated to interest expense so as to produce a constant periodic rate of interest on the remaining balance of the capital lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Average Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: Average amount borrowed under the credit facility during the period.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement Interest
unclassified.description: Interest expense (income) directly attributable to an award in settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Four
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Three
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Two
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow reducing loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Net Asset Value Per Share
unclassified.description: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
unclassified.description: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four and Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth and fifth fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Public Offering
unclassified.description: The number of units sold in a public offering of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Conversions, Inducements
unclassified.description: The excess of (1) the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in transactions by the registrant to the holders of the convertible preferred stock over (2) the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms, during the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collaborators
unclassified.description: Cash received from collaborators during the current period.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

unclassified.label: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Revenue Recognition, Sales Returns, Reserve for Sales Returns
unclassified.description: Amount of estimated sales returns.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: The combined weighted average of the accumulated differences between the fair values on underlying shares and exercises prices to acquire such shares as of the grant date on options that were either forfeited or lapsed.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Warrant, Down Round Feature, (Increase) Decrease in Equity, Amount
Additions to Other Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Intangible Assets Other than Goodwill (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Acquired Receivable, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Net Gains and Losses
unclassified.description: The net gains or losses recognized for each transaction with the acquiree that was recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Expenditure, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of capital expenditure attributable to discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Net
unclassified.description: Net increase or decrease in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period.

unclassified.label: DebtInstrumentRepaidPrincipal
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of debt repaid.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Common Stock Reserved for Future Issuance
unclassified.description: Number of common shares reserved for future issuance related to deferred compensation arrangements with individuals.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Hedging Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from hedging transactions.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Contributions by Plan Participant
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increase benefit obligation.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Gain (Loss), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of plan assets to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Development Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized development cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Revenue, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred revenue attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Prepaid and Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as prepaid and other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Finance Lease, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss from right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease due in next rolling 12 months following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals to be received by the seller-lessee for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Intraperiod Tax Allocation
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for continuing operations, discontinued operations, other comprehensive income, and items charged (credited) directly to shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease), during an accounting period, in total obligations owed to the reporting entity's executives and owners.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Related Parties, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion (due within one year or one business cycle, whichever is longer) of the amount owed by the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-Lived Trademarks
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

unclassified.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Accrued Interest
unclassified.description: Increase for accrued, but unpaid interest on the credit facility for the period.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Number of Defendants
unclassified.description: Number of defendants named in a legal action.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: The total amount of revenue recognized for the period from operating leases, including minimum lease revenue, contingent revenue, percentage revenue and sublease revenue.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Contingent Rentals
unclassified.description: The increases or decreases in lease payments that result from changes occurring after the inception of the lease in the factors (other than the passage of time) on which lease payments are based, except that any escalation of minimum lease payments relating to increases in construction or acquisition cost of the leased property or for increases in some measure of cost or value during the construction or preconstruction period, are excluded from contingent rentals. Contingent rentals also may include amounts for which the triggering events have not yet occurred or the specified targets for which have not yet been achieved (such as sales based percentage rent), but which events are considered probable of occurring or which specified targets are considered probable of being achieved.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net, Available-for-sale Securities
Payments for Postemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
Payments to Acquire Lease Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Amount of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to a long-term capital lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Effective Yield (Interest Rate)
unclassified.description: Yield on the receivable, on which interest has been imputed, as calculated from its issuance value or purchase price. The calculated effective interest rate considers factors such as the issued face value or price paid for the receivable, the time period between payments, and the time until maturity [full receipt] of the receivable.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Net Amount
unclassified.description: The receivable or note face amount less the unamortized discount or premium.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Redemption Premium
unclassified.description: The excess of the (1) fair value of consideration transferred to the holders of a security in excess of (2) the carrying amount of the security reported on the registrant's balance sheet, which will be deducted from net earnings to derive net earnings available to common shareholders. This amount is generally an adjustment considered in the computation of earnings per share.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Due from (to) Related Party, Current
Self Insurance Reserve, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-based Liabilities Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid to settle liability for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Maximum Employee Subscription Rate
unclassified.description: The highest percentage of annual salary that an employee is permitted to utilize with respect to the plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Stockholders' Equity
unclassified.description: The amount by which stockholders' equity was increased by the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Expected Dividend Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the expected term of a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Risk Free Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

unclassified.label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Lower Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Current
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability that is expected to be paid within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Income Tax Expense
Time Deposits, at or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations that meet or exceed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of fixed and determinable portion of unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
unclassified.description: The reporting entity's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Accumulated Amortization of Other Deferred Costs
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortization of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs, deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies, or deferred leasing costs for real estate operations.

unclassified.label: Additional Collateral, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of additional assets that would be required to be posted as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestIssuedAndIssuable
unclassified.description: Amount of acquirer's equity interest issued and issuable as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Additional Disclosures, Acquisition Cost Expensed
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination and recognized separately from acquisition of asset and assumption of liability. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee and advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees. Excludes integration, restructuring, and other post-combination costs; cost related to acquisition of asset; and acquisition-related cost for transaction with third party.

unclassified.label: Cost, Maintenance
unclassified.description: Cost of maintenance incurred and directly related to good produced and service rendered.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Collateral Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of assets pledged to secure a debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Repurchased Face Amount
unclassified.description: Face (par) amount of the original debt instrument that was repurchased.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Cost, Gross, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Loss Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from loss reserves other than estimated credit losses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Income Tax Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation allowance for deferred tax asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation, or both, and reported as adjustment to income tax expense. Excludes change in valuation allowance within measurement period.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Gains (Losses) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Assets
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from derivative instruments and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Number of Instruments Held
unclassified.description: The number of derivative instruments of a particular group held by the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Variable Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Variable interest rate in effect as of the balance sheet date related to the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable and accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Dividends, Preferred Stock, Paid-in-kind
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

unclassified.label: Early Repayment of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to amortization.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax contingencies.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax on Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Percent
Equity Method Investment, Amount Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of the entity's equity method investment which has been sold.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value Hedge Liabilities
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Issuances
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Gain Contingency, Unrecorded Amount
unclassified.description: The amount or range of possible amounts of gain that could be realized upon the resolution of a contingency.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAwardAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of government assistance awarded that comprises amount received, receivable, and to be received unless condition for government assistance is not met. Includes, but is not limited to, government grant, assistance, incentive, award, subsidy, and loan.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, before Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current tax expense (benefit) and deferred tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations and income (loss) from discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Other Related Parties, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party payables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Derivative Instruments, Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash and Investments
Increase in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible
unclassified.description: Amount of increase reasonably possible in the next twelve months for the unrecognized tax benefit.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Nonvested Shares with Forfeitable Dividends
unclassified.description: Number of additional shares included in diluted EPS for potentially dilutive effect of nonvested equity-based payment award containing forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents, whether paid or unpaid.

unclassified.label: Inventory, LIFO Reserve
unclassified.description: Amount by which inventory stated at last-in first-out (LIFO) is less than (in excess of) inventory stated at other inventory cost methods.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Percent of Net Assets
unclassified.description: Percentage of investment owned to net assets.

unclassified.label: Lease Incentive, Payable, Current
unclassified.description: This item represents an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Annual Principal Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in debt under credit facility arrangement from principal payment.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Net Income (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Payments for Construction in Process
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

unclassified.label: Payments for Leasing Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost of lease incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
unclassified.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of preferred stock outstanding.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Discount
unclassified.description: The excess of (1) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet over (2) the fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock, during the accounting period, which will be added to net earnings to arrive at net earnings available to common shareholders in the calculation of earnings per share.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
unclassified.description: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Additions from Business Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in liability for standard and extended product warranty acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Related Parties Amount in Cost of Sales
unclassified.description: Amount included in cost of sales related to transactions with related parties incurred and recorded in the statement of operations for the period.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated, Inception to Date Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the total number of positions eliminated as of the balance sheet date since inception of the restructuring plan(s).

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Monthly Rental Payments
unclassified.description: The amount of the monthly rental payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transactions involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Offering Date
unclassified.description: Discount rate from fair value on offering date that participants pay for shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Modification of Terms, Incremental Compensation Cost
unclassified.description: The excess of the fair value of the modified award over the fair value of the award immediately before the modification.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Increase (Decrease) for Preexisting Warranties
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual from changes in estimates attributable to preexisting product warranties. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Treasury Stock, Retired, Par Value Method, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease of par value, additional paid in capital (APIC) and retained earnings of common and preferred stock retired from treasury when treasury stock is accounted for under the par value method.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
unclassified.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Business Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from business combination.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Leasing Fees
unclassified.description: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction.

unclassified.label: Assets of Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Concentration Risk, Credit Risk, Financial Instrument, Maximum Exposure
unclassified.description: Maximum amount of loss due to credit risk that, based on the gross fair value of the financial instrument, the entity would incur if parties to the financial instruments that make up the concentration failed completely to perform according to the terms of the contracts and the collateral or other security, if any, for the amount due proved to be of no value to the entity.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Dividends, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: The after-tax amount of any dividends on convertible preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Customer Advances and Deposits, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of aggregate prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that are to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Effective Interest Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment Terms, Balloon Payment to be Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of payment greater than the preceding installment payments to be paid at final maturity date of debt.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred revenue.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from business combination.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative asset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, elected not to be and before offset against a right to receive collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards, Weighted Average Period of Recognition (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Foreign Countries (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Equity, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of the entity's equity.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
unclassified.description: This item represents the aggregate value of each identified investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting based on the quoted market price for those investments in common stock for which a quoted market price is available.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Gross Profit (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Income Tax
unclassified.description: Current period income tax expense or benefit pertaining to a gain (loss) on an extinguishment of debt.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Customer Relationships, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer relationship acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives Recorded in Earnings, Net
unclassified.description: Aggregate impact of foreign currency derivatives on earnings for the period. Includes impact of foreign currency cash flow hedge ineffectiveness and the ineffectiveness of fair value hedging derivatives and full change in fair value of the foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Estimate of Possible Loss
unclassified.description: Estimated amount of loss resulting from an adverse tax position.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Increase (Decrease) in Liability from Prior Year
unclassified.description: The amount the liability recorded for the income tax examination increased or decreased in the current year/accounting period.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividends, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Loans
