unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans classified as other.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill), Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, that lack physical substance, having a projected indefinite period of benefit.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-Lived License Agreements
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the capitalized costs to acquire rights under a license arrangement (for example, to sell specified products in a specified territory) having an indefinite period of benefit.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Early Contract Termination Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of early contract termination fees included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Collateral Fees, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fees associated with providing collateral for the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Accrued Costs to Dispose of Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of estimated accrued cost to dispose of asset and other item expected to be sold in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Repayments of Principal in Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Assets, Miscellaneous
unclassified.description: Amount of other miscellaneous assets.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Inventory, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other inventory expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, in Transit, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of merchandise or supplies to which the entity holds the title but does not hold physical possession because the goods are currently being transported.

unclassified.label: Payment for Management Fee
unclassified.description: Amount paid to managing member or general partner for management of the day-to-day business functions of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Buildings
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Per-Dollar-Amount
unclassified.description: The amount per share used to calculated dividend payments on preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Loan Originations
unclassified.description: Cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans to Purchase Common Stock
unclassified.description: Cash inflow from repayment of loans for purchasing common stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Restricted Investments, Percent of Net Assets
unclassified.description: The percent of net assets of the aggregate value of all restricted investments.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Discount for Postvesting Restrictions
unclassified.description: Restrictions on equity-based instruments during the vesting period, such as the inability to transfer unvested awards, are not taken into account in estimating the fair value of the award. However, restrictions that remain in effect after an award is vested, such as the inability to transfer or hedge vested options or a prohibition on the sale of outstanding vested shares (or other type of equity) for a period of time, affect the estimate of an award's fair value.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Sponsor Fees
unclassified.description: Fees paid to advisors who provide certain management support and administrative oversight services including the organization and sale of stock, investment funds, limited partnerships and mutual funds.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies
unclassified.description: Total costs accrued as of the balance sheet date for environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrued Insurance
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverage's to employees.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

unclassified.label: Advance Royalties
unclassified.description: The amount paid to music publishers, record producers, songwriters, or other artists in advance of their earning royalties from record or music sales. Such an amount is based on contractual terms and is generally nonrefundable.

unclassified.label: Alternative Investment
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment other than investment in equity security, investment in debt security and equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Example includes, but is not limited to, investment in hedge fund, venture capital fund, private equity fund, and real estate partnership or fund.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Accounts Payable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Asset Acquired and Liability Assumed, Lease Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of lease obligation assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The financing charge for leasing arrangements meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Other Value, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Value of share of other common stock instruments held by shareholder. Includes, but is not limited to, exchangeable share.

unclassified.label: Compensated Absences Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability accrued for the employer's obligation related to an employee's right to receive compensation for future absences that have been earned by employee.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Convertible Subordinated Debt, Current
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment upon liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Stock Price Trigger
unclassified.description: Price of the entity's common stock which would be required to be attained for the conversion feature embedded in the debt instrument to become effective.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Cash Awards Granted, Percentage
unclassified.description: Commitment made to pay deferred cash remuneration expressed as a percentage of the individual's base salary.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Share-based Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Comprehensive Loss
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses in other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Provision for Loan Losses
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Restructuring Charges
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from restructuring reserve.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
unclassified.description: The amount as of the balance sheet date of the estimated future tax effects attributable to policy acquisition costs being expensed for tax purposes but capitalized in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles, which will reverse in future periods when amortization of such capitalized costs cannot be deducted for tax purposes.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Net (Gains) Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in plan assets of defined benefit plan from business combination.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Other Cost (Credit)
unclassified.description: Amount of defined benefit plan cost (credit), classified as other.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Plan Participant
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increases plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Target Allocation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of target investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contribution Per Employee, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative, Cash Received on Hedge
unclassified.description: The amount of cash received during the period on settlement of a hedge.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative liability, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, before offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassification from Accumulated OCI to Income, Estimated Net Amount to be Transferred
unclassified.description: The estimated value of gains (losses), net anticipated to be transferred in the future from accumulated other comprehensive income into earnings.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationBeatPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to base erosion and anti-abuse tax (BEAT).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividend, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as assets, net of those classified as liabilities.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Volatility Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements)
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: FeeIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of fee income including, but not limited to, managerial assistance, servicing of investment, and origination and commitment fees.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in other income tax contingencies.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue and Customer Advances and Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of an acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, (c) the increase (decrease) during the reporting period, excluding the portion taken into income, in the liability reflecting services yet to be performed by the reporting entity for which cash or other forms of consideration was received or recorded as a receivable, or (d) some combination of (a), (b), and (c).

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of loan receivable, including, but not limited to, mortgage loans held for investment, finance receivables held for investment, policy loans on insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal after Year Five
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Claims Dismissed, Number
unclassified.description: Number of claims dismissed.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of other current and other deferred income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Other Interest and Dividend Income
unclassified.description: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Materials, Supplies and Merchandise under Consignment, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of inventory owned by the entity but in the hands of a customer, typically a reseller.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount, after of valuation reserves and allowances, of inventory, classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Land Held-for-use
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of land for use; excludes purchases of land held as inventory or as investments.

unclassified.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability, Current
unclassified.description: For a classified balance sheet, the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the portion of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement that is payable within one year of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: This is the principal amount outstanding for securitized loans only (across all types of loans).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Grantors
unclassified.description: Cash received from grantors during the current period related to operating activities. This element represents receipts from a guarantor for the amount of guarantee provided.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Salvage Value, Percentage
unclassified.description: Stated as a percentage, the estimated or actual value of the asset at the end of its useful life or when it is no longer serviceable (cannot be used for its original purpose) divided by its [historical] capitalized cost.

unclassified.label: Quantifying Misstatement in Current Year Financial Statements, Amount
Restricted Investments, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate value of all restricted investments.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Quantity of Securities Issued
unclassified.description: The number of shares or units of entity securities issued in the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Interest Rate Increase
unclassified.description: Percentage increase in the stated interest rate on a short-term debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Stockholders' Equity Note, Changes in Capital Structure, Subsequent Changes to Number of Common Shares
unclassified.description: Change in number of shares issued and outstanding as a result of capital structure change to a stock dividend, stock split or reserve split occurring after the balance sheet date but prior to the later of the issuance of financial statements or the effective date of registration statement.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, recorded in results of operations to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be ineffective.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Purchases
unclassified.description: The amount purchased during the period under an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation (for example, under the take-or-pay or throughput contract).

unclassified.label: WarrantDownRoundFeatureIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount1
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for warrant classified as equity.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of trade and related party payables and accrued expenses.

unclassified.label: Accrued Utilities, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for utilities, such as electrical power, heating oil, natural gas, and water. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from disposal other than by sale of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange or distribution to owner in spinoff.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Gross Unrealized Loss
Available-for-sale Securities, Change in Net Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss) before Taxes (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, at Fair Value, Current (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, at Fair Value, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Share, Basic
unclassified.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Accrued Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Consideration Transferred
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to items of consideration transferred in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Contingent Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of preacquisition contingent liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets Noncurrent
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Noncurrent Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Discount on Shares
unclassified.description: Discount on common shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Change Due to Net Income Attributable to Parent and Effects of Changes, Net
unclassified.description: This element represents the total net income attributable to the parent for the period and the effect of net changes during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not result in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Purchase of Interest by Parent
unclassified.description: Represents the purchase by the parent of an additional equity interest in a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The purchase of the additional equity interest represented by this element increases the parent's controlling interest in the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Increase (Decrease) for Contract Acquired in Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, from business combination.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Modification of Contract
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from contract modification which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Convertible Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt, as of the balance sheet date, initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Convertible Subordinated Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying value of convertible subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer. This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Cost of Property Repairs and Maintenance
unclassified.description: The aggregate costs of keeping the property in good condition but that do not appreciably prolong the life or increase the value of the property.

unclassified.label: Cost of Services, Licenses and Maintenance Agreements (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Gain (Loss) on Settlement of Other Claims, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of net gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Recorded Liability
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date to an individual under a deferred compensation arrangement. This amount may be the result of periodic accruals made over the period of active employment, or reflect termination benefits resulting contractual terms or a death benefit.

unclassified.label: DeferredIncomeRevenueRecognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized previously reported as deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Intra-entity Transfer, Asset Other than Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from intra-entity transfer of asset within consolidated group. Excludes intra-entity transfer of inventory.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Gain on Sale Leaseback Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from a gain reported for tax purposes on sale and leaseback transactions in accordance with enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount to be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income from gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred tax liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Foreign Currency Translation Gains (Losses)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) in the disposal group, including discontinued operation, recognized in the statement of income as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Dividends, Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Extraterritorial Income Exclusion, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and the expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for extraterritorial income exclusion.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain on Embedded Derivative
unclassified.description: Increase in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability, measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings and from related hedged item to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Employee Stock Options
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Extraterritorial Income Exclusion, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for extraterritorial income exclusion.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entry (during the current year or operating cycle) in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities.

unclassified.label: Loan Processing Fee
unclassified.description: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
unclassified.description: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Five
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Claims Settled, Number
unclassified.description: Number of claims settled.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Net Worth Required for Compliance
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum net worth required for mortgage banking as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two and Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second and third fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments receivable in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price
unclassified.description: Exercise or strike price stated in the contract for options indexed to the issuer's equity shares.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative designated and qualifying as net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

unclassified.label: Other Liabilities and Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheet date, of noncurrent obligations and noncurrent portion of deferred revenue not separately disclosed in the balance sheet. Noncurrent liabilities are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Deferred revenue is a liability related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized, and is not expected to be recognized in the next twelve months.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Portion Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security, recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
unclassified.description: Aggregate number of nonredeemable preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Customers
unclassified.description: Cash receipts from customers during the current period which are usually for sales of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Decommissioning Trust Fund Assets
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of assets held in a decommissioning trust fund.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Dividends Received
unclassified.description: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Limited Partners Units
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of common limited partners units during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard and extended product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Number of Units
unclassified.description: The number of units (items of property) under operating lease arrangements.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated, Inception to Date
unclassified.description: The number of positions eliminated as of the balance sheet date since inception of the restructuring plan(s).

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Other
unclassified.description: Other increase (decrease) in number of shares reserved for issuance under non-option equity instrument agreements that is not separately disclosed.

unclassified.label: Supply Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
unclassified.description: The floor amount as of the balance sheet date that the entity must expend to satisfy the terms of disclosed arrangements (excluding long-term commitments) in which the entity must commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Percentage Ownership after All Transactions
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity method investee's stock owned by parent immediately after all stock transactions.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Deferred Tax Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes.

unclassified.label: Accrued Sales Commission
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for sales commissions.

unclassified.label: AdjustmentToAdditionalPaidInCapitalConvertibleDebtInstrumentIssuedAtSubstantialPremium
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in additional paid-in capital (APIC) from recognition of substantial premium at which convertible debt instrument is issued.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Current
unclassified.description: Current portion of the carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Gross Unrealized Gain
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Inventory (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Revenue Reported by Acquired Entity for Last Annual Period
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue reported by acquiree in fiscal period prior to business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of liability arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Marketable Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt and equity securities acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Modification of Contract
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from contract modification which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product
unclassified.description: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability.

unclassified.label: Costs Incurred, Development Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of development cost incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of New Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Cash Award Granted, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment made to pay deferred cash remuneration.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Authorized for Issuance
unclassified.description: The maximum number of shares authorized for issuance under the deferred compensation arrangement as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Asset, Net, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Cumulative Amount of Temporary Difference (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Administration Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of administration expense of defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. Excludes plan administration expense paid by employer.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Increase on Service and Interest Cost Components
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point increase in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of cost (credit) included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Fair Value of Plan Assets (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from settlement and curtailment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plans, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Demutualization by Insurance Entity, Securities Issued, Gross Cash Proceeds
unclassified.description: The price per share or unit times the number of shares or units issued in an insurance entity stock offering in connection with its conversion from a mutual form of ownership to a stock entity. Amount is gross, before offering costs.

unclassified.label: Deposit Contracts, Assets
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of assets as of the balance sheet date pertaining to amounts paid by the insured (including a ceding company) under insurance or reinsurance contracts for which insurance risk is not transferred.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Money Market Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of deposits in accounts that offer many of the same services as checking accounts although transactions may be somewhat more limited, share some of the characteristics of a money market fund and are insured by the Federal government, also known as money market accounts.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Ineffective Portion and Amount Excluded from Effectiveness Testing, Net
unclassified.description: The portion of gains and losses (net) on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments representing (a) the amount of the hedge ineffectiveness and (b) the amount, if any, excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Aggregate fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Due to Other Related Parties, Noncurrent
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Fair Value of Shares Subject to Repurchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Fair value of the shares allocated that are subject to a repurchase obligation.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Allocated Shares
unclassified.description: The shares or units in an ESOP trust that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula. IRS rules require allocations to be nondiscriminatory generally based on compensation, length of service, or a combination of both. For any particular participant such shares or units may be vested, unvested, or partially vested.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Foreign Currency Translation
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Fixtures and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of fixtures and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, machinery, equipment, and engines.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Franchisor Costs
unclassified.description: Aggregate costs incurred that are directly related to activities, including but not limited to, generating franchise revenues from franchisor owned outlets and franchised outlets.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Subsequent Recognition of Deferred Tax Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease from subsequent recognition of deferred tax asset for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Carrying Value of Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of impaired long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale. Excludes long-lived asset held for sale and disposed of.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Book Overdrafts
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in book overdrafts.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Participating Nonvested Shares with Non-forfeitable Dividend Rights
unclassified.description: This element represents nonvested share-based payment awards that contain non-forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents (whether paid or unpaid). Basic and dilutive earnings per share are generally disclosed for such shares using the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Subordinated Notes and Debentures
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on subordinated notes and debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeInterestEarningAsset
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from interest-earning asset.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as assets.

unclassified.label: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
unclassified.description: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

unclassified.label: Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of lease income from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments, interest income, profit (loss) recognized at commencement, and lease payments paid and payable to lessor.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Capacity Available for Specific Purpose Other than for Trade Purchases
unclassified.description: The maximum amount of borrowing capacity under a line of credit that is available as of the balance sheet date for a specific purpose other than for financing goods acquired for inventory or imminent delivery to a customer.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
unclassified.description: Maximum amount borrowed under the credit facility at any time during the period.

unclassified.label: LongTermDebtAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of long-term debt.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Stores
unclassified.description: Represents the number of stores.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Shares
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that could be issued to settle option contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for net period benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Investments and Securities, at Cost
unclassified.description: Includes other investments and securities that are not at fair value as of the balance sheet date and those that are not accounted for under the equity method.

unclassified.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for taxes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Per Share Amounts of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
unclassified.description: Per share amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

unclassified.label: Principal Amount Outstanding of Loans Held-in-portfolio
unclassified.description: This is the result of the principal amount outstanding of total loans managed or securitized less securitized loans and loans that are in the process of being securitized.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Other Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Corporate Unit
unclassified.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of an interest in a corporate unit during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

unclassified.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLeaseAccumulatedDepreciation
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of accumulated amortization, depreciation, depletion for physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Amount, net of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization, of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of recorded unconditional purchase obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Revenue for Reportable Segment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award vested under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Short-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of short-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, over Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of short-term debt outstanding calculated over time.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Income Tax Benefit
Temporary Equity, Elimination as Part of Reorganization
unclassified.description: Redemption of temporary equity as the result of a triggering event associated with the temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount, before valuation allowance, of accounts receivable held for sale.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings, Diluted
unclassified.description: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed. Includes the adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.
