unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Cumulative amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization (related to property, plant and equipment, but not including land or leased assets).

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Share, Diluted
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Deferred Tax Liabilities, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Intangible Assets Not Amortizable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Notes Payable and Long-term Debt (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisitions, Purchase Price Allocation, Year of Acquisition, Net Effect on Income
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income before tax from accretion of discount (amortization of premium and intangible asset) in year of business combination when asset of acquired entity exceed 10 percent of consolidated assets.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of the increase (decrease) in fair value of the hedged item in a fair value hedge recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not arise in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Construction Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Estimate of Transaction Price
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in estimate of transaction price which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time. Includes, but is not limited to, change in assessment of whether estimate of variable consideration is constrained.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on passage of time.

unclassified.label: Cost Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
Debt Default, Short-term Debt, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of outstanding short-term debt or borrowing associated with any securities or credit agreement for which there has been a default in principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption provisions, or any breach of covenant that existed at the end of the period and subsequently has not been cured.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate at Period End (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of investment in debt investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Legal and Advisory Professional Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization items related to legal and advisory professional fees related to entities in bankruptcy.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Contributions by Employer
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions made by employer into fund established for purposes of making future disbursement to individual in accordance with deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The per share price that the individual must pay to acquire shares under the deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Cash-based Arrangements, Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments in Five Fiscal Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Derivative Asset Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Asset Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax (Expense) Benefit from Provision for (Gain) Loss on Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit on (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Cash Distributions Declared
unclassified.description: Amount of equity impact of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Due from Banks
unclassified.description: A bank's noninterest bearing demand deposits in other banks (such as correspondents).

unclassified.label: Due to Officers or Stockholders, Noncurrent
Effect on Future Cash Flows, Amount
unclassified.description: The quantified amount of the future effect on cash flows.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Charitable Contributions, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to charitable contributions expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Domestic, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in domestic income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Cash and Cash Equivalents (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Probability of Default (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Measured on Recurring Basis, Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Option, Aggregate Differences, Long-term Debt Instruments
unclassified.description: This item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of long-term debt instruments that have contractual principal amounts and for which the fair value option has been elected.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on financing receivable recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
GovernmentAssistanceAmountCumulative
unclassified.description: Amount of asset from government assistance.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged liability in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Ongoing Project
unclassified.description: Amount recognized as an operating expense or loss during the period to reduce the carrying amount of a project that has been impaired but not abandoned.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Equity Transactions
unclassified.description: The tax effect of an increase or decrease in contributed capital (for example, deductible expenditures reported as a reduction of the proceeds from issuing capital stock) during the period charged or credited directly to shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidFederalBeforeRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Charitable Contributions, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible charitable contributions expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Domestic, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in domestic income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in state and local income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables arising from the contracting of goods and services, net for uncollectible accounts.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Leasing Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Insured Event, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

unclassified.label: Interest Costs Capitalized Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Other Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense incurred on long-term debt classified as other, including, but not limited to, interest on long-term notes and amortization of issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Interest Paid, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid during the current period for interest owed on debt associated with discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase, Additional Borrowings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to interest.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable with Fixed Rates of Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of loan with fixed rate of interest.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest, Amount
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Members' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to Limited Partners
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to limited partners.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Redeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other redeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Investment Advisory Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for investment advisory service, including, but not limited to, managing money in fund.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for transfer agent and custodian services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid for maintaining investor record, account balance, and company's stock transaction and fee paid for holding and safeguarding assets of individual, mutual fund, and investment company.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable to Bank
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable to banks, excluding mortgage notes, initially due beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Adjustments for Noncash Items Included in Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Unamortized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Employee-related Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Inventories, Spare Parts, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of components of assembled products that can be sold directly or indirectly through sales of assembled products.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Supplies, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation and LIFO reserves of other supplies used within the manufacturing or production process expected to be consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring Income
unclassified.description: Amount of other income that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Other Ownership Interests, Offering Costs
unclassified.description: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the other unit holders.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units Net of Offering Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, after offering cost, from issuance of new unit of limited partnership interest in public offering.

unclassified.label: Prepayment Fees on Advances, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of income earned, after hedging basis adjustments, from fees charged for prepayment of certain Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances before original maturity.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-use
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Receivable for Recovery of Import Duties, Net
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of tariffs due either from customers or suppliers arising from sales or purchases, or as previously overpaid to tax authorities or vendors.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Face Amount
unclassified.description: The principal amount of the receivable or note before consideration of the discount or premium.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

unclassified.label: Related Party Tax Expense, Due to Affiliates, Current
unclassified.description: The amount of any current tax-related balances due to affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Revenues from Transactions with Related Party (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Research and Development Arrangement with Federal Government, Customer Funding to Offset Costs Incurred
unclassified.description: The amount of customer funding recorded as an offset to costs incurred for a fixed-price, best-efforts research and development cost-sharing arrangement with the Federal Government.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Income before Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax expense (benefit), of result of operation in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes corporate overhead and interest costs.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase or decrease in number of shares reserved for issuance under stock option agreements awarded under the plan that validly exist and are outstanding, including vested options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Exercise Price, Beginning Balance (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Standard and Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the standard and extended product warranty accrual.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Shares, Issued for Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Provisional Liability (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Other Changes
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in temporary equity from changes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investments in debt securities classified as trading.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Number of Shares Held (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
US Government Agencies Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Debt securities issued by a United States government agency such as Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac), and Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae), which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to common stock as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings of Domestic Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings of domestic subsidiaries or domestic joint ventures intended to be permanent.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Loss on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income pertaining to the decrease in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments to the extent that a cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Insurance Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount of insurance proceeds for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number Basic Shares Outstanding Adjustment, Pro Forma
unclassified.description: Adjustment to the weighted average number of basic shares outstanding to convert this to a pro forma presentation.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accrued Exchange Fee Rebate, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for rebates of an exchange fee some mutual funds impose on shareholders if they exchange (transfer) to another fund within the same fund group. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Asset, Weighted Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Reallocation of Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Amortization of Lease Incentives
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization of lease incentive costs incurred by the lessor for the benefit of the lessee.

unclassified.label: AOCI Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security, measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in rolling sixth through tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Borrowings under Guaranteed Investment Agreements
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the obligations to contract holders to provide to them an agreed upon rate of return pursuant to the terms of the underlying contract. These contracts represent lending by the contract holders to the entity in return for a guaranteed (primarily fixed) interest rate until maturity, unless called earlier if the contracts provide that option to the contract holders (usually institutions). There is little or no insurance risk for the entity.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Liabilities Incurred (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Deferred Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Acquired Receivables, Gross Contractual Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gross contractual receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Range of Outcomes, Value, Low
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Remaining Discount Amortization Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityFairValue
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Fair Value of Shares Issued
unclassified.description: The total fair value of shares issued during the period under a deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income during the current period and current obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities, current).

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Severance Payments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from severance costs.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Gain (Loss), Immediate Recognition as Component in Net Periodic Benefit (Cost) Credit
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss), recognized immediately as component of net periodic benefit (cost) credit, for change in value of benefit obligation or plan assets from experience different from that assumed, change in actuarial assumption, or consequence of temporarily deviating from substantive plan. Includes, but is not limited to, amount in excess of 10 percent of greater of fair value of plan assets or benefit obligation.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Divestiture
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from disposal or classification as held-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Debt Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Ultimate Health Care Cost Trend Rate
unclassified.description: Ultimate trend rate for health care cost for defined benefit postretirement plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Liability Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Net Liability Position, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value amounts of derivative instruments that contain credit-risk-related contingent features that are in a net liability position at the end of the reporting period. For nonderivative instruments that are designated and qualify as hedging instruments, the fair value amounts are the carrying value of the nonderivative hedging instrument, including the adjustment for the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on that instrument.

unclassified.label: Cost, Direct Tax and License
unclassified.description: Amount of tax incurred and cost of license directly related to good produced or service rendered.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred revenue attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred tax assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Distributed Earnings
unclassified.description: The total amount of dividends declared in the period for each class of stock and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends). Dividends declared in the current period do not include dividends declared in respect of prior-period unpaid cumulative dividends. Preferred dividends that are cumulative only if earned are deducted only to the extent that they are earned.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares in ESOP
unclassified.description: Sum of the allocated, committed-to-be-released and suspense shares of the entity held by the plan.

unclassified.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Individual Foreign Countries, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity
unclassified.description: Difference between amount at which an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting is carried (reported) on the balance sheet and amount of underlying equity in net assets the reporting Entity has in the investee.

unclassified.label: Estimated Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts expected to be recovered under the terms of insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Amount, Asset
unclassified.description: The fair value of financial assets, which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Hedge Assets
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative assets designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Unfunded Commitments
unclassified.description: The amount of unfunded commitments for which the entity is obligated, to those certain investments for which net asset value per share is calculated (including by unit, membership interest, or other equity (ownership interest) unit measure) (alternative investments).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Option, Credit Risk, Gains (Losses) on Assets
unclassified.description: This item represents the estimated amount of gains or losses included in earnings during the period attributable to changes in instrument-specific credit risk arising from loans and other receivables held as assets.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease, due in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Noncompete Agreements, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of payments made to third parties in exchange for their agreement not to engage in specified competitive practices in specified geographic territories for a specified period of time.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivatives at Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Gain Contingency, Patents Allegedly Infringed upon, Number
unclassified.description: Number of entity's patents that another entity has allegedly infringed.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for less than 12 months.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Client Funds Held
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of client funds held and maintained in custodial and separate accounts, and which are owned by clients or contract holders.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances and Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of (a) prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date, (b) the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement, or (c) a combination of (a) and (b).

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Written Put Options
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of outstanding written put options using the reverse treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Current (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Inventory, Work in Process and Raw Materials
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items held by the entity which are partially completed at the time of measurement and unprocessed items that will go through the production process and become part of the final product. Includes supplies used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines work in process and raw materials into an aggregate amount.

unclassified.label: Investments in Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investments in an entity not consolidated. Includes, but is not limited to, investments in an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group, an entity which the company has significant influence, but does not have control and subsidiaries that are not required to be consolidated and are accounted for using the equity or cost method.

unclassified.label: Land and Land Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of real estate held for productive use and additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use, examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots. Excludes land held for sale.

unclassified.label: Lease Incentive Receivable
unclassified.description: This item represents a receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

unclassified.label: Lease Incentive Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: This item represents the current receivable for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease. The receivable is due within one year. For classified balance sheets, this element represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Assumed
unclassified.description: The fair value of line of credit assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment, Principal
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payment applied to principal.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in financing receivable from new loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of contractual obligation to pay money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage added to reference rate used to compute variable rate on loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second and third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Claims Settled and Dismissed, Number
unclassified.description: The number of claims settled and dismissed during the period.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Portion Not Accrued
unclassified.description: The difference between the maximum amount of estimated loss and the amount recorded as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: The amount of net income or loss for the period per each limited partnership and general partnership unit in instances when basic and diluted earnings per unit are the same amount and aggregated on the face of the financial statements. Basic earnings per unit is the amount of net income or loss for the period per unit outstanding during the reporting period. Diluted earnings per unit includes the amount of net income or loss for the period available to each limited and general partnership unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of units for all dilutive potential units outstanding during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Cash Flow Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Offering Costs, Partnership Interests
unclassified.description: Costs incurred in connection with the offering and selling of additional partner interest.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Variable Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Noncontrolling Interests
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in one or more of the entities consolidated into the reporting entity's financial statements other than joint ventures, limited partnerships, operating partnerships or interests held by preferred unit holders.

unclassified.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Partners' Capital Account, Distributions
unclassified.description: Total distributions to each class of partners (i.e., general, limited and preferred partners).

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sold in Private Placement
unclassified.description: The number of units sold in a private placement of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Payment for Administrative Fees
unclassified.description: Amount paid to managing member or general partner, affiliate of managing member or general partner, or affiliate of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP) for administrative services provided to the LLC or LP, for example, but not limited to, salaries, rent, or overhead costs.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Weighted Average Cost Inventory
unclassified.description: The percentage of weighted average cost inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is valued using different valuation methods.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Authorized
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units authorized to be issued.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.

unclassified.label: Provision for Loss on Contracts
unclassified.description: Cumulative provision for contract losses not offset against related costs accumulated on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Realized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
Reimbursement from Limited Partnership Investment
unclassified.description: A payment from an investee, in which the investment basis has previously been reduced to zero. This amount reduces net cash used in operating activities.

unclassified.label: Retainage Deposit
unclassified.description: The amount of assets, typically cash, provided to suppliers of goods in advance of receipt and acceptance, or services (such as research facilities, lawyers or consultants), which is held by such parties until the entity either effects full payment (including applying the retainer) or obtains release from liability.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Self Insurance Reserve
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions) of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Number of Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Number of increase (decrease) of non-vested options.

unclassified.label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Acquisition Costs or Sale Proceeds (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate standard product warranty liability that is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the extended product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Change in Reporting Entity
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Measurement Period Adjustment, Increase (Decrease) in Effective Tax Rate
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of tax liability from transition tax on accumulated earnings of controlled foreign corporation deemed repatriated under United States of America (US) Public Law 115-97 (House of Representatives (H.R.) 1 of 115th Congress), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

unclassified.label: Trading Securities, Change in Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss)
Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Amount Derecognized
unclassified.description: Amount of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction, at the date of derecognition.

unclassified.label: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Cash Proceeds Received for Assets Derecognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, before counterparty netting, of cash proceeds received in transfers of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

unclassified.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Increase (Decrease), Gross of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative translation gain (loss), before tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment, after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Carrying Basis
unclassified.description: Cost basis for treasury stock acquired for purposes other than retirement.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Addition, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from recovery of amount previously written off or reestablishment of reserve previously utilized.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Underwriters, Promoters, and Employees, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to underwriters, promoters, and employees excluding salaries, wages and amount to related party, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Accrued Exchange Fee Rebate
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for rebates of an exchange fee some mutual funds impose on shareholders if they exchange (transfer) to another fund within the same fund group.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Asset, Residual Value
unclassified.description: Amount of residual value for finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Recoveries of Bad Debts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Write-offs
unclassified.description: Amount of loans and leases that have been written off from both loan receivables and allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
unclassified.description: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, ESOP Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amount Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit) and Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) and other comprehensive (income) loss.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Revision of Estimate
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset retirement obligation from changes in the amount or timing of the estimated cash flows associated with the settlement of the obligation.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Sold at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with interest rate reset through auction process, sold at par value.

unclassified.label: Basic Earnings Per Share Adjustment, Pro Forma
unclassified.description: Pro Forma Basic Earnings Per Share Adjustment to reconcile between Net Income and Pro Forma.

unclassified.label: Billings in Excess of Cost
unclassified.description: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Net Tangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Acquired Receivables, Estimated Uncollectible
unclassified.description: Amount of estimated contractual cash flow not expected to be collected for receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: BusinessCombinationPriceOfAcquisitionExpected
unclassified.description: Purchase price of expected business acquisition prior to consideration being transferred. Excludes asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Intangibles
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to intangibles acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of equipment acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Expenses and Losses Recognized
unclassified.description: The expenses and losses recorded for each transaction with the acquiree that was recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition date of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capitalization, Long-term Debt and Equity
unclassified.description: Amount of consolidated capitalization which comprises long-term debt and equity instruments.

unclassified.label: Cash, Including Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Includes cash within disposal group or discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Clearance Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of expense in the period for clearance fees.

unclassified.label: Collateralized Agreements
unclassified.description: The total of collateralized agreements including securities purchased under agreements to resell (repos), borrowed securities, and secured demand notes.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Held in Trust
unclassified.description: Value of common stock held in trust.

unclassified.label: Compensating Balance, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of a specific compensating balance arrangement that is maintained under an agreement for a bank loan or future credit availability.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Sale of Interest by Parent
unclassified.description: Represents a sale by the parent of a portion of its equity interest in a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The sale of the equity interest represented by this element does not result in a loss of control by the parent.

unclassified.label: Long-term Construction Loan, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: This element represents the noncurrent portion of a long-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project (generally one to seven years), usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these loans tends to be high, and the lender has a security interest in the real property.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Sale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease from sale of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time and other income.

unclassified.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Cost-method Investments, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
Costs in Excess of Billings, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings which is expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityFairValueCurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityFairValueNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Write-off of Debt Issuance Costs and Debt Discounts
unclassified.description: Amount of write-off of debt issuance costs and debt discounts related to prepetition debt obligations.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Cash-based Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements payable after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, after deduction of accumulated amortization or the effects of subsequent adjustments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Set-up Costs, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Deferred incremental direct costs incurred typically at a contract's inception so that the company may be in a position to fulfill all contractual obligations of an arrangement. The costs are directly related to specified activities under the arrangement and are deferred in order to match revenue that will be recognized after one year from the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle if longer). Excludes start-up costs (such as one-time activities related to opening a new facility, introducing a new product or service, establishing business with a new class of customers, preopening costs, and organization costs), which are expensed as incurred.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Parent's Basis in Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the parent entity's basis in a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Amounts that Will be Amortized from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) in Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received and expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes contribution previously paid by employer in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed for Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Other Plan Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Derivative, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Net Hedge Ineffectiveness Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the ineffectiveness of the hedge.

unclassified.label: Direct Costs of Leased and Rented Property or Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of expense incurred and directly related to generating revenue by lessor from operating lease of rented property and equipment.
