unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Deferred Gain on Disposal
unclassified.description: The excess amount received or due over net assets in a transaction accounted for as a divestiture where a subsidiary, business or operating assets are "sold" by the entity to a newly formed, thinly capitalized, highly leveraged buyer. This gain is not yet recognized and is disclosed on the balance sheet as an offset against the carrying amount of the securities received.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Dividends, Common Stock, Paid-in-kind
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Continuing Operations
Equity Method Investment, Underlying Equity in Net Assets
unclassified.description: This item represents the entity's ownership percentage in the investee multiplied by the investee's total equity.

unclassified.label: EquityOwnershipPercentageExcludingConsolidatedEntityAndEquityMethodInvestee
unclassified.description: Percentage of ownership of equity interest excluding interest in entity that is consolidated and equity method investee.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Trade Names, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a reasonably expected period of economic benefit.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Assets at Fair Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Foreign Currency Derivative Liabilities at Fair Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Debt Investments
Gain on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
unclassified.description: Aggregate gain on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecreaseNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in asset from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceOperatingIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in unrealized loss position.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss on capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax (Expense) Benefit, Continuing Operations, Government Grants
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit from continuing operations attributable to government grants to the extent recognized as a reduction of income tax expense.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalBeforeRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Employee, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from employees for floats, allowances and loans (generally evidenced by promissory notes).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Finished Goods and Work in Process Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of finished goods inventory and work in process inventory.

unclassified.label: Insurance Services Revenue
unclassified.description: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans
unclassified.description: Amount of interest and fee income from loans classified as other.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale); classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Firm Purchase Commitment, Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of loss recognized on firm purchase commitment for inventory.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Raw Materials and Purchased Parts, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of items purchased for use as components of a finished product or pieces of machinery and equipment plus any items in their natural and unrefined state. This element may be used when the reporting entity combines raw materials and purchased parts into an aggregate amount.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Committed Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of funds committed to investment company from investors.

unclassified.label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Balance, Principal Amount
unclassified.description: For investments which are quantified by principal amount, principal balance held at close of period.

unclassified.label: LIFO Inventory Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of LIFO (last in first out) inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is also valued using different valuation methods.

unclassified.label: Lease Incentive, Payable
unclassified.description: This item represents an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

unclassified.label: LiabilitiesAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing liabilities.

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Unit-based Payment Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in members' equity for unit-based payment arrangement issued by limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Lines of Credit, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Joint Ventures
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling shareholders, partners, or other equity holders in joint ventures included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Municipal Debt Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Bonds or similar securities issued by state, city, or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city, or local governments which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivative Purchase Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of States in which Entity Operates
unclassified.description: The number of states the entity operates in as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of expected credit loss for credit exposure on off-balance-sheet commitment, including but not limited to, loan commitment, standby letter of credit, financial guarantee not accounted for as insurance. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Adjustment for Settlement or Curtailment Gain (Loss), Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Tax Effect (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Inventory, Capitalized Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before valuation and last-in first out (LIFO) reserves, of costs capitalized in inventory classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Payments for Brokerage Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for brokerage fees during the current period. This element is intended to represent the brokerage fees paid by and between financial industry participants.

unclassified.label: Payments for Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Total amount of cash paid for operating activities during the current period.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Debt Hedged by Interest Rate Derivatives
unclassified.description: Percentage of an entity's outstanding debt that is designated as a hedged item in cash flow, fair value, or net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Issued
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units issued.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Deposits from Customers
unclassified.description: Cash received from customers for deposits on goods or services during the period; excludes deposits with other institutions and time deposits, which pertain to financial services entities.

unclassified.label: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundFederal
unclassified.description: Amount of cash received from federal tax jurisdiction for refund of tax on income. Includes, but is not limited to, national tax received for non-U.S. jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Limited Partners Units
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of preferred limited partners units during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Trust Assets to Pay Expenses
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflows from the sale of trust assets to pay trust expenses.

unclassified.label: Product Liability Accrual, Period Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of loss reported during the period pertaining to product liability.

unclassified.label: Product Warranty Accrual, Currency Translation, Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Production Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized production cost incurred during period for oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes cost incurred to operate and maintain well and related equipment and facility.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Gross amount of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

unclassified.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Discount
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the discount on the note or receivable which is deducted from the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is the difference between the present value and the face amount.

unclassified.label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of receivables, including, but not limited to, trade account receivables, note receivables, and loan receivables.

unclassified.label: Registration Payment Arrangement, Maximum Potential Consideration
unclassified.description: Describes the maximum potential amount of consideration, undiscounted, that could be transferred under the registration payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
unclassified.description: The total value of forfeitures related to restricted stock awards forfeited during the period.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Current Period Gain Recognized
unclassified.description: The portion of the deferred gain that was recognized in the current period.

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of sales-type lease revenue.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Other Share Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Other than shares newly issued, the number of additional shares issued (for example, a stock split) or canceled (for example, to correct a share issuance), during the period under the plan.

unclassified.label: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Allocated
unclassified.description: Number of allocated shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Allocated shares are shares that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Refinanced, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of a short-term obligation that has been excluded from current liabilities in the balance sheet because of a refinancing of the obligation.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Additions from Business Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in liability for standard product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for extended warranty acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Straight Line Rent Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of the adjustment to rental revenues to measure escalating leasing revenues on a straight line basis.

unclassified.label: Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Reclassification from AOCI to Retained Earnings, Tax Effect
Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative translation gain (loss), after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred fees paid by borrowers and unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Underwriting Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: The difference between the price paid by the public and the contract price less the related expenses. A broker-dealer may underwrite a security offering by contracting to buy the issue either at a fixed price or a price based on selling the offering on a best-effort basis.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
Unrealized Gain on Foreign Currency Derivatives, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain related to the increase in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Imputed Interest
unclassified.description: If disclosed, the amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce an unconditional purchase obligation to present value on an unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net of Insurance Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Warrants and Rights Outstanding, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure outstanding warrant and right embodying unconditional obligation requiring redemption by transferring asset at specified or determinable date or upon event certain to occur.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
unclassified.description: The average number of limited partnership and general partnership units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per limited partnership and general partnership unit.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of amount due from customers or clients for goods or services, including trade receivables, that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business, and amounts due from others, including related parties.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Accrued Fees and Other Revenue Receivable
unclassified.description: For an unclassified balance sheet, the amount of fees and other revenue, excluding investment income receivable, earned but not yet received, which were recognized in conformity with revenue recognition criteria based on estimates or specific contractual terms.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as current.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Reclassifications from Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization from reclassification out of property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Write-down of Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Other than Temporary Impairment, Not Credit Loss, Net of Tax, Available-for-sale, Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Accumulated other comprehensive loss related to portion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) due to factors other than credit losses on debt securities categorized as available-for-sale that an entity does not intend to sell and which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis of the debt security. The amount represented by this item is net of tax, as applicable.

unclassified.label: Advertising Barter Transactions, Advertising Barter Costs
unclassified.description: Total expense recognized from advertising barter transactions for each income statement presented.

unclassified.label: Amount of Impairment to Carrying Amount of Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: Discloses the amount of any reduction to the carrying amounts of regulated assets that result from impairment (for example, rate actions of a regulator).

unclassified.label: Amount of Regulatory Assistance Received
unclassified.description: Amount of regulatory assistance received from a federal regulatory agency in conjunction with either an acquisition of a troubled financial institution, transfer of nonperforming assets to a newly-formed entity, or other reorganization.

unclassified.label: Asset-Backed Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Investments in notes or bonds that are collateralized by a specific group of underlying assets owned by the issuer of the notes or bonds which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) asset retirement obligations.

unclassified.label: Assets under Management, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of assets an investment adviser manages on behalf of investors.

unclassified.label: Auction Rate Securities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of securities that are debt instruments (corporate or municipal bonds) that typically have long-term nominal maturities for which the interest rate is reset through an auction process.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Income Tax Expense on Change in Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Short-term Investments, Amortized Cost (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Bank Acceptances Executed and Outstanding
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of drafts and bills of exchange that have been accepted by the reporting bank, or by others for its own account, as its liability to holders of the drafts.

unclassified.label: Bankruptcy Claims, Amount of Claims Filed
unclassified.description: Amount of bankruptcy claim filed with bankruptcy court.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Other Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Other Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisitions, Purchase Price Allocation, Subsequent Years, Remaining Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized premium and intangible asset (unaccreted discount) remaining in year after business combination when total amount of remaining premium, intangible asset, and discount exceeds 30 percent of stockholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Inventory
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to inventory acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Restructuring Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of preacquisition restructuring liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Additional Disclosures, Acquisition Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination and recognized separately from acquisition of asset and assumption of liability. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and cost of registering and issuing debt and equity securities. Excludes integration, restructuring, and other post-combination costs; cost related to acquisition of asset; and acquisition-related cost for transaction with third party.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Revenues and Gains Recognized
unclassified.description: The revenues and gains recognized recorded for each transaction with the acquiree that is recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Receivable in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Property, Plant, and Equipment Other, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation on leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Units, Net Amount
unclassified.description: Net amount applicable to investors of capital units or shares.

unclassified.label: Cash Available for Distributions
unclassified.description: Amount of cash eligible for distribution to members or limited partners of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP), subject to reserves to be maintained as defined in operating or partnership agreement, or in a credit facility agreement.

unclassified.label: Cash Reserve Deposit Required and Made
unclassified.description: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

unclassified.label: Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.

unclassified.label: Commodity Contract Asset, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from commodity contracts such as futures contracts tied to the movement of a particular commodity, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Communications, Information Technology and Occupancy
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of communications, data processing and occupancy expenses.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Issuance of Equity by Subsidiary to Noncontrolling Interests
unclassified.description: Represents a sale (new stock issuance) by a subsidiary to noncontrolling interests (third parties, parties directly or indirectly unrelated to parent) during the period. The capital transaction by subsidiary does not result in a loss of control by the parent, but does effect a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Measure of Progress
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in measure of progress which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Cost of Services, Depreciation and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Credit Derivative, Liquidation Proceeds, Percentage
unclassified.description: Estimated percentage to which the maximum potential amount of future payments under the credit derivative would be covered by the proceeds from liquidation of assets held either as collateral or by third parties.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetAddition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in crypto asset from addition. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetDisposition
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in crypto asset from disposition. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetNumberOfUnits
unclassified.description: Number of restricted and unrestricted crypto asset units held. Excludes crypto asset units held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetPurchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in crypto asset from purchase. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetSale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in crypto asset from sale. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: DebtInstrumentConvertibleLiquidationPreferencePerShare
unclassified.description: Per share excess of preference in liquidation over convertible debt instrument's if-converted par or stated value of share.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Change in Present Value, Expense (Reversal)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deconsolidation, Revaluation of Retained Investment, Gain (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement to fair value of retained investment in former subsidiary and group of assets constituting business or nonprofit activity deconsolidated and derecognized, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of product or service in contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Distribution Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of distribution made to individual in accordance with deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Adjustment
unclassified.description: The amount of any adjustment recognized to the balance of unamortized issuance costs associated with a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, due, for example, to default by the share borrower.

unclassified.label: Deferred Gain on Sale of Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain on the sale of property that does not qualify for gain recognition as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Receivables, Net, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Patent Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from patent costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Undistributed Earnings of Domestic Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of domestic subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), after Tax (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income from prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Contributions by Plan Participants (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Divestiture
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in plan assets of defined benefit plan from disposal or classification as held-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Assumed rate, for next fiscal year, based on annual change in cost of health care cost benefits used to measure expected cost of benefits covered by defined benefit postretirement plan. Factors include, but are not limited to, estimate of health care inflation, change in health care utilization or delivery pattern, technological advances, and change in health status of participant. Excludes factors for change in composition of plan population by age and dependency status.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against an obligation to return collateral.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cap Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Cap rate on an interest rate derivative such as an interest rate cap or collar. If market rates exceed the cap rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability arising from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Instruments, Loss Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
unclassified.description: The effective portion of loss reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, offset against the right to receive collateral.

unclassified.label: Direct Communications and Utilities Costs
unclassified.description: The aggregate costs of direct communications and utilities incurred during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Long Lived Assets (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Dividends and Interest Paid
unclassified.description: The contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the current period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends).

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Undistributed
unclassified.description: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation Foreign Earnings, Jobs Creation Act of 2004, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the temporary incentive for U.S. entities to repatriate accumulated foreign earnings under the American Jobs Creation Act of 2004.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Weighted Average Purchase Price of Shares Purchased
unclassified.description: Weighted average purchase price of capital shares purchased through an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Environmental Remediation Expense
unclassified.description: Amount, before recovery, of expense for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

unclassified.label: Equity Issued in Business Combination, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of equity issued in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Payments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Cash and Cash Equivalents
unclassified.description: Fair value of cash and cash equivalent subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Amount, Liability
unclassified.description: The fair value of financial liabilities, which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Hedges, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Ineligible Items, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of items included in each line item in the statement of financial position that are not eligible for the fair value option.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable on nonaccrual status. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Cost Incurred to Renew or Extend
unclassified.description: Amount of cost incurred and capitalized to renew or extend term of recognized finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Remeasurement
unclassified.description: Foreign exchange rate used to remeasure amounts denominated in a currency other than functional currency into functional currency.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Real Estate, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between the carrying amount and the sales price of real estate properties sold as part of discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) of interest rate cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: General Partners' Offering Costs
unclassified.description: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the general partner.

unclassified.label: Government Contract Receivable, Unbilled Amounts
unclassified.description: Unbilled amounts (net of unliquidated progress payments) of government contract receivables.

unclassified.label: Guarantees, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of guarantee, including, but not limited to, financial standby letter of credit, fair value guarantee, guarantee of collection of scheduled contractual cash flows from financial assets, and contracts that contingently require the guarantor to make payments or perform services.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Amortized Cost, before Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount, before other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) accretion, of investment in debt securities measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Debt Maturities, Net Carrying Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Amount of Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Loss recognized as a result of the initial and subsequent write-down of a long-lived asset's carrying amount to fair value.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Related Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit losses related to recorded investment.

unclassified.label: Impairment Losses Related to Real Estate Partnerships
unclassified.description: Impairment losses measured as the amount by which the carrying amount of the business or real estate partnerships exceeds the fair value of the business or partnership.

unclassified.label: Incentive Fee Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for incentive fee based on performance under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) on income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative tax effect on beginning retained earnings from change in accounting principle.

unclassified.label: IncomeTaxPaidForeignBeforeRefundReceived
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to foreign tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible life insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Affiliates, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Insurance Commissions and Fees
unclassified.description: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Interest Costs, Including Allowance for Funds Used During Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Trading Liabilities
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on short positions arising from sales of securities and other assets, which the entity does not own, to other parties. Trading liabilities includes the fair value of derivative contracts held for trading that are in loss positions.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Domestic Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest earned on deposits in United States money market accounts and other United States interest earning accounts.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation reserves of merchandise or goods held by the entity that are readily available for sale and items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for sale.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Finished Goods and Work in Process, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: The aggregated amount of merchandise or goods held by the entity and readily available for future sale plus items held by the entity which are partially complete or in the process of being readied for future sale. This amount is net of valuation reserves and adjustments.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Face Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount on the investment owned.

unclassified.label: Land Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use. Examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: Maximum month-end amount borrowed under the credit facility during the period.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before allowance of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Long-term Construction Loan
unclassified.description: This element represents the current and noncurrent portions of a long-term real estate loan with an initial maturity beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project (generally one to seven years), usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these loans tends to be high, and the lender has a security interest in the real property.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
ManagementAndServiceFeesRate
unclassified.description: Rate for management and service fees under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Allocated to General Partners
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of net income allocated to general partners.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Net Revenue (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Nonfinancial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of obligations not classified as financial liabilities. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, commitments, obligations, and other liabilities.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Commission Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Foreign Currency Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives held by the entity at the reporting date.

unclassified.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

unclassified.label: Off-market Lease, Unfavorable
unclassified.description: This element represents a liability associated with the acquisition of an off-market lease when the terms of the lease are unfavorable to the market terms for the lease at the date of acquisition.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Credits, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Investment Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Value of the other investment not readily marketable determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques, that was used to record the investment for financial reporting purposes.

unclassified.label: Other Restricted Assets
unclassified.description: Total assets that cannot be used for operating purposes because of contract or regulatory requirements that are in effect for a period that extends beyond one year.

unclassified.label: Other Sundry Liabilities
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheets date, of obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements.

unclassified.label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Shares, Issued
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

unclassified.label: PayableInvestmentPurchase
unclassified.description: Amount of payable for purchase of investment.

unclassified.label: Payments for Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock for Employee Tax Withholding Obligations (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Payments to Acquire Furniture and Fixtures
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of furniture and fixtures.

unclassified.label: Percentage of LIFO Inventory
unclassified.description: The percentage of LIFO (last in first out) inventory to total inventory as of the balance sheet date if other than 100 percent.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Discount on Shares
unclassified.description: Discount on preferred shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Subscriptions Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of subscription receivable from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units outstanding.

unclassified.label: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

unclassified.label: Proceeds, Accounts Receivable, Previously Written Off, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of accounts receivable previously written off.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Deposits on Real Estate Sales
unclassified.description: Cash inflow related to amounts received in advance from a potential buyer showing or confirming an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Financial Services Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing issued by the entity involved in financial services operations.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Furniture and Fixtures
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sale of furniture and fixtures.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Present Value
unclassified.description: Present value of the accrual for product liability loss contingencies as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

unclassified.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLeaseBeforeAccumulatedDepreciation
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Salvage Value
unclassified.description: The estimated or actual value of the asset at the end of its useful life or when it is no longer serviceable (cannot be used for its original purpose).

unclassified.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in land and building held for sale. Excludes real estate considered inventory.

unclassified.label: Receivable from Officers and Directors for Issuance of Capital Stock
unclassified.description: Amounts receivable from officers and directors resulting from the sale of stock to officers or directors before the cash payment is received.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value as of the reporting date of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

unclassified.label: Related Party Tax Expense, Due from Affiliates, Current
unclassified.description: The amount of any current tax-related balances due from affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Gross
unclassified.description: The amount of the gain recorded in connection with the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller to be recognized in future periods.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Net
unclassified.description: The portion of the gain that will be recorded as income or a reduction in rent expense in future periods less amounts recognized in the current period.

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Servicing Assets and Servicing Liabilities at Fair Value, Assumptions Used to Estimate Fair Value, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate used to estimate the fair value of servicing assets and servicing liabilities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Cash Flow Effects (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the holder of the share has the right to redeem the shares.

unclassified.label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Stock Granted During Period, Shares, Share-based Compensation (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
StockOptionDownRoundFeatureIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount1
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Income Tax Expense
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Provisional Income Tax Benefit (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of tax liability from transition tax on accumulated earnings of controlled foreign corporation deemed repatriated under United States of America (US) Public Law 115-97 (House of Representatives (H.R.) 1 of 115th Congress), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Share Subscriptions
unclassified.description: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been allocated to investors to buy. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
unclassified.description: Number of unissued securities classified as temporary equity allocated to investor for purchase on subscription basis.

unclassified.label: Trading Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) resulting from the difference between the acquisition price and the selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, conducted separately from customer trading activities. Includes, but is not limited to, changes in fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Used in Net Investment Hedge, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings, after tax, related to translation from the functional currency to reporting currency, as a result of the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Preferred, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of previously issued preferred shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Weighted Average Cost Inventory Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of weighted average cost inventory present at the reporting date when inventory is valued using different valuation methods.

unclassified.label: Accelerated Share Repurchase Program, Adjustment
unclassified.description: The amount needed to adjust previously recorded stockholders' equity balances to the actual aggregate amounts paid, whether in cash or other consideration, to acquire all of the shares purchased under an Accelerated Share Repurchase arrangement.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Interest-bearing, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and due after one year (or beyond the operating cycle if longer) to vendors that bear interest at either a stated or an imputed rate.

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs but not paid. Excludes amounts due that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

unclassified.label: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable after twelve months or beyond the next operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Accrued Vacation
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for unused vacation time owed to employees based on the entity's vacation benefit given to its employees.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization Expense, Property, Plant and Equipment, Current Charge (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Advances, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances carried under the fair value option.

unclassified.label: Advertising Barter Transactions, Advertising Barter Revenue
unclassified.description: Total revenue recognized from advertising barter transactions for each income statement presented.

unclassified.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Net Income, Per Outstanding Unit, Amount
unclassified.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic net Income or Loss per outstanding limited partnership unit in the future and that were not included in the computation of diluted net income per limited partnership unit, because to do so would increase net income per unit amounts or decrease loss per unit amounts for the period presented.

unclassified.label: AOCI before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to parent. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

unclassified.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale without Allowance for Credit Loss, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) without allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Tax
