unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Asset, Reporting Currency Denominated, Value
unclassified.description: The reporting currency-denominated asset value.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Cash Paid to Settle
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid during the period to settle an asset retirement obligation. Amounts paid to settle an asset retirement obligation are generally included in the operating section of the Statement of Cash Flows.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after 10 Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after rolling tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Tangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Assets and Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of liability in excess of (less than) asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Liabilities
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial liabilities assumed in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustments Related to Previous Period
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income that would have been recognized in previous periods if the adjustments to provisional amounts were recognized as of the acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Financial Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of financial asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Financial Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of financial liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Liabilities Recognized
unclassified.description: The amount of liabilities recognized recorded in a transaction with the acquiree for each transaction that is recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Executory Costs
unclassified.description: Amounts to be paid by lessee to lessor for maintenance, insurance, and tax expenses related to the leased asset.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net
unclassified.description: Amount after depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Units, Cost to Investors
unclassified.description: Cost to investors of each class of capital shares or other capital units.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, Subsidiaries and Equity Method Investees
unclassified.description: This element represents disclosure of the total aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by consolidated subsidiaries, by unconsolidated subsidiaries, and by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
CashHeldInForeignCurrency
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, held in foreign currency. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations, Investing Activities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Charity Care, Reimbursements Received
unclassified.description: The amount of subsidies received by the entity for providing charity care, for example, from an uncompensated care fund.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Held by Subsidiary
unclassified.description: Value of entity shares held by subsidiary, which are purchased for the purpose of granting the shares to senior employees as part of an employee stock option plan approved by the Entity's Board of Directors. Presented as a reduction of shareholders' equity at their cost to the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Share Subscriptions but Unissued, Value (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
unclassified.description: Amount after discount on shares of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock held by shareholders. Includes common stock repurchased and held as treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Communication
unclassified.description: The amount of expense incurred in the period for communication, which is the exchange of information by several methods.

unclassified.label: Construction Loan
unclassified.description: This element represents the carrying value of a short-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project, usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these loans tends to be high, and the lender has a security interest in the real property. Note that there are separate concepts for the current and noncurrent portions of long-term construction loans.

unclassified.label: Contract Receivable Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

unclassified.label: Contractual Interest Expense on Prepetition Liabilities Not Recognized in Statement of Operations
unclassified.description: The amount of contractual interest expense on prepetition liabilities not included in the statement of operations.

unclassified.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Sales-type Lease
unclassified.description: Cost of goods sold for sales-type financing lease.

unclassified.label: Credit Risk Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of credit risk derivative liability.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainOperating
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price, Increase
unclassified.description: Per share increase in conversion price of debt instrument. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityCumulativeUnrecognizedGain
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossNotPreviouslyRecorded
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with no credit loss previously recorded.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Borrowings Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount of debtor-in-possession borrowings outstanding.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Other Expense (Income)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) related to reorganization items classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Distributions Paid (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Employer Contribution (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Deferred Costs, Leasing, Net, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: This element represents costs incurred by the lessor that are (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction. The costs represented by this element are those costs not expected to be recognized in (amortized to) earnings within one year from the date of the statement of financial position or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income in future periods and obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities).

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Capitalization
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Frequent Flier Liability
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from frequent flier obligations.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences derived regulatory assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Parent's Basis in Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from the entity's basis in a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Prepaid Pension Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from regulatory assets.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability, Intra-entity Transfer, Asset Other than Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to intra-entity transfer of asset within consolidated group. Excludes intra-entity transfer of inventory.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Bad Debt Reserve for Tax Purposes of Qualified Lender
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to bad debt reserve for tax purposes of a qualified lender.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as current. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Transition Obligation (Asset) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Obligations (Assets) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities, Range Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities, Range Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Demand Deposit Accounts
unclassified.description: The amount of money in accounts that may bear interest and that the depositor is entitled to withdraw at any time without prior notice.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of deposit liabilities held by the entity, including, but not limited to, foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing, demand deposits, saving deposits, negotiable orders of withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Amount of Hedged Item
unclassified.description: Amount of hedged item in hedging relationship. Excludes hedged asset or liability.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cap Price
unclassified.description: The cap rate on a price risk derivative such as a cap or collar. A payment or receipt is triggered if the market rate exceeds the cap rate on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cost of Hedge
unclassified.description: The premium (cost) of a hedge, expensed during the period.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Assets, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Aggregate fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilityAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure derivative liability.

unclassified.label: DerivativeNetAssetsPercentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of value of derivative contract to net assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Price Risk Option Strike Price
unclassified.description: The strike price on the price risk option contract such as a put option or a call option.

unclassified.label: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentShares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of underlying investment in derivative.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Revenue, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred revenue attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Due from Officers or Stockholders, Current
Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Pro Forma Adjustment
unclassified.description: Pro forma diluted earnings per share adjustment to reconcile between net income and pro forma amounts.

unclassified.label: Effect on Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation and Amortization, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to depreciation and amortization.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Leases, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to lease expense.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Net Sales Proceeds (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Cost of Sales (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment Summarized Financial Information, Equity (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
EquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestriction
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes investment in equity security by investment company for which discount for contractual sale restriction is applied.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of total risk-based capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Exploration Abandonment and Impairment Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with unproved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, previously capitalized cost of drilling exploratory well when proved reserve is not found or when there is substantial doubt about economic or operational viability of project.

unclassified.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the aggregate extended product warranty liability. Does not include the ending balance for the standard product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of receivable assets originating from the indemnification agreement with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), in which the FDIC is to partially cover losses.

unclassified.label: Facility Costs
unclassified.description: Facility expenses incurred related to gas and oil produced and sold during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Derivative Instruments, Liabilities
unclassified.description: Fair value of derivative liability subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Foreign Currency Contracts
unclassified.description: Fair value of derivative liability for foreign currency contract subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Level 1 to level 2 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Obligations, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of obligations measured on a recurring basis.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Debt, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of firm holdings in corporate fixed income securities. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Equities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in corporate stocks (common and preferred), stock options, warrants and any other financial instrument which represents, or provides the ability to obtain, ownership rights in a corporation. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year One, Originated, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Former Gain Contingency, Recognized in Current Period
unclassified.description: Amount of gain recognized in the period that had been disclosed in prior periods as a contingent gain.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

unclassified.label: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Minimum R Square, Percentage
unclassified.description: The correlation coefficient between the hypothetical instrument and the hedged item used in determination of the effectiveness of a hedging relationship.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Not Allocated, Amount
unclassified.description: Portion of goodwill not yet allocated to reportable segments.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability from government assistance.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in liability from government assistance.

unclassified.label: Government Contract Receivable, Progress Payment Offset
unclassified.description: Amount of progress payment offset against unbilled government contract receivable.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of liability hedged in fair value hedging relationship.

unclassified.label: Hedging Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in unrealized loss position.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: ImpairmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLease
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with proved and unproved reserves in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity
unclassified.description: The sum of the tax effects of all items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to other comprehensive income or to related components of shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Range of Possible Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation and Amortization, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation and amortization.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Construction Payables
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of obligations, not classified as trade payables, incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies, and services pertaining to construction projects.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges, Investing
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in noncurrent deferred charges, classified as investing activities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Fuel Costs
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Affiliates, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Employees, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in obligations due within one year (or one business cycle) to employees other than officers.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Advertising
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for advertising that provides economic benefits in future periods.

unclassified.label: IncreaseDecreaseInReceivableForInvestmentSold
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivable from sale of investment.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Investments for Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in marketable securities and investments pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Acquired During Period (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeOperatingAndNonoperating
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income classified as operating and nonoperating.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, Other US Government
unclassified.description: Interest income on securities issued by US government agencies not including US Treasury Securities.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury and Other US Government
unclassified.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on U.S. Treasury securities and other U.S. government securities.

unclassified.label: Interest Portion of Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount necessary to reduce minimum lease payments to present value for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, net of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Inventory Recall Expense
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount charged against earnings comprised of the costs to announce and effect a recall of defective merchandise.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Supplies, Net of Reserves
unclassified.description: Carrying amount, net of valuation reserves and adjustments, as of the balance sheet date of products used directly or indirectly in the manufacturing or production process, which may or may not become part of the final product. May also include items used in the storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods.

unclassified.label: InvestmentInterestRatePaidInCash
unclassified.description: Rate of interest paid in cash on investment.

unclassified.label: InvestmentInterestRatePaidInKind
unclassified.description: Rate of interest paid in kind on investment.

unclassified.label: Investment-related Liabilities
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date for obligations incurred in connection with the entity's investments.

unclassified.label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Balance, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of securities sold short (the short position) as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Gross Additions
unclassified.description: Gross additions to the investment in and advance to the affiliate.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Related to Investment Contracts, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liability related to investment contracts for example, but not limited to, guaranteed investment contract or annuities.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Reported Claims, Amount
unclassified.description: Costs of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for the specified year specifically for claims that have already been submitted to the insurance company for reimbursement.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Capacity Available for Trade Purchases
unclassified.description: The maximum amount of borrowing capacity under a line of credit that is available as of the balance sheet date for financing purchases of goods acquired for inventory or imminent delivery to a customer.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Decrease, Forgiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in line of credit facility from forgiveness by the holder of the line of credit.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Decrease, Repayments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage rate that is indicative of an expected degree of movement against a base line index, and which is included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long Lived Assets Held-for-sale, Proceeds from Sale (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth and fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, over Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of long-term debt outstanding calculated over time.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Net
unclassified.description: Present value of the estimated aggregate accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

unclassified.label: Loss on Contract Termination for Default
unclassified.description: The amount of the loss on termination of a contract for default.

unclassified.label: Loss on Contracts
unclassified.description: Losses recognized in the current period on contracts which are expected to generate losses, which are probable and can be reasonably estimated, in a future period.

unclassified.label: Maturities of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Cumulative Effect of Change on Equity or Net Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Operating Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Interest Acquired
unclassified.description: The level of ownership or equity interest acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash Project Abandonment Costs
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings to eliminate the capitalized costs of projects that have been terminated during the reporting period, which is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by (used in) operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Nontrade Receivables
unclassified.description: Carrying amounts due as of the balance sheet date of the sum of amounts receivable other than from customers.

unclassified.label: Number of Real Estate Properties
unclassified.description: The number of real estate properties owned as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases of Lessee, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessee's operating lease.

unclassified.label: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValuePerShare
unclassified.description: Fair value per share that would be issued upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Cash, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of option contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Origination of Loan to Purchase Common Stock
unclassified.description: Cash outflow for origination of loan for purchasing common stock.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Finalization of Pension and Non-Pension Postretirement Plan Valuation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan. Excludes pension plan.

unclassified.label: Other Restricted Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of noncurrent assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Credit Losses on Debt Securities Held
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for debt security held for which portion of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) was recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Change in the different classes of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Private Placement of Units
unclassified.description: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a private placement.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: PayableCommonStockRedeemed
unclassified.description: Amount of payable for common stock reacquired. Includes, but is not limited to, unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

unclassified.label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Payments to Acquire Projects
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

unclassified.label: Payments to Suppliers and Employees
unclassified.description: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Other
PreferredStockConvertibleDownRoundFeatureDecreaseInNetIncomeLossToCommonShareholderAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for convertible preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
unclassified.description: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Offering Costs
unclassified.description: The cumulative amount of offering costs allocated to the preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
unclassified.description: The unexpired portion of premiums ceded on policies in force as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Principal Investment Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Advances for Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, borrowing from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Commissions Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for commissions during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
unclassified.description: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

unclassified.label: Product Liability Contingency, Accrual, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Rate applied to the undiscounted amount of estimated damages for product liability to arrive at the present value recorded as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: ProductWarrantyLiquidationProceedsPercentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of proceeds from liquidation of asset held as collateral or by third party expected to cover maximum potential future payment for product warranty. Includes, but is not limited to, separately price extended warranty, product maintenance contract, and warranty obligation incurred in connection with agreed upon specification.

unclassified.label: Production Tax Expense
unclassified.description: A tax assessed on oil and gas production.

unclassified.label: Property Management Fee, Percent Fee
unclassified.description: The percentage charged for managing real estate properties.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Purchase Options, Land
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of an option or options to acquire real property.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Premium
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the premium on the note or receivable which is added to the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is defined as the difference between the present value and the face amount.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale
unclassified.description: Amount, before valuation allowance, of accounts and financing receivables held for sale.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Amount of Maturities and Sinking Fund Requirements
unclassified.description: States the combined aggregate amount of maturities and sinking fund requirements for a long-term unconditional purchase obligation that has been recognized on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Recovery of Direct Costs
unclassified.description: Return of or reimbursements received in relation to direct costs and expenses previously paid or incurred.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Advances for Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of advance for construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to developer, builder, government agency, and municipality for borrowing received in construction.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

unclassified.label: Repayments of Subordinated Short-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Amount of Fair Value in Excess of Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of fair value of reporting unit in excess of carrying amount.

unclassified.label: Restatement of Prior Year Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Retail Related Inventory, Packaging and Other Supplies
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of items used in storage, presentation or transportation of physical goods that are targeted for sale to end users.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Undistributed Earnings from Equity Method Investees
unclassified.description: Amount of consolidated retained earnings that represent undistributed (not yet received) earnings from 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for by the equity method (equity method investees).

unclassified.label: Retention Payable
unclassified.description: Amounts owed to vendors and subcontractors that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

unclassified.label: Sales Discounts, Returns and Allowances, Goods (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities for Reverse Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: The carrying value of securities purchased to be resold in reverse repurchase transactions as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of the securities pledged as collateral against securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Securities Received as Collateral
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the assets received as collateral against securities loaned to other broker-dealers. Borrowers of securities generally are required to provide collateral to the lenders of securities, commonly cash but sometimes other securities or standby letters of credit, with a value slightly higher than that of the securities borrowed. In instances where the entity is permitted to sell or re-pledge these securities, the entity reports the fair value of the collateral received and the related obligation to return the collateral as a liability.

unclassified.label: Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Value of the not readily marketable security or category which has been determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques and is included in the schedule of financial condition or the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Fair value of a liability representing servicing arrangements under which the estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award forfeited under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
SharesAcquiredWeightedAverageDiscountToNetAssetsPercentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of weighted average discount on shares acquired to net assets.

unclassified.label: Shares held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Suspense Shares
unclassified.description: Number of suspense shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Suspense shares are shares that have not been released, committed to be released or allocated to individual participant accounts.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, the maximum amount borrowed at any time during the period.

unclassified.label: Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Capital and Surplus Required
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory capital and surplus required to be maintained under prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practice.

unclassified.label: Stock or Units Available for Distributions
unclassified.description: Number of stock or units eligible for distribution to members or limited partners of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion of Interest
unclassified.description: Value of accretion of temporary equity during the period due to unpaid interest.

unclassified.label: Transfers of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sale, Initial Fair Value of Liabilities Incurred
unclassified.description: Represents the initial fair value recorded for liabilities incurred on transfer of financial assets in a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or a similar transfer which transaction is recognized as a sale of the transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of cumulative translation adjustment attributable to gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Preferred, Value
unclassified.description: Amount allocated to previously issued preferred shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock Reissued at Lower than Repurchase Price
unclassified.description: In cases when treasury stock is reissued at a price lower than the cost to repurchase, the excess difference between the selling price and cost to repurchase is charged against retained earnings (assuming that all APIC arising from treasury stock transactions has first been exhausted).

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss), allocated to common stock, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

unclassified.label: Unearned Premiums
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unused Commitments to Extend Credit
unclassified.description: Unused amount of commitments to extend credit to customers.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Loss, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net (Gain) Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of (gain) loss for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or occurs infrequently, or both.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Comparison of Carrying Amount of Assets and Liabilities to Maximum Loss Exposure
unclassified.description: Difference between the carrying amount of assets and liabilities in the reporting entity's statement of financial position that relate to the reporting entity's variable interest in the variable interest entity (VIE) and the reporting entity's maximum exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the VIE, where the reporting entity is not the VIE's primary beneficiary.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of expense between the reporting entity and the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number Diluted Limited Partnership Units Outstanding Adjustment
unclassified.description: The sum of dilutive potential limited partnership units used in the calculation of the diluted per-unit computation.

unclassified.label: Accelerated Share Repurchases, Adjustment to Recorded Amount
unclassified.description: The adjustment needed to reconcile previously recorded amounts to the actual aggregate amount paid, whether in cash or other consideration, to acquire all of the shares purchased under an Accelerated Share Repurchase arrangement.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Interest-bearing
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to vendors that bear interest at either a stated or an imputed rate.

unclassified.label: Accrued Advertising
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for advertising of the entity's goods and services.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Sale or Disposal of Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Acquisition Costs, Cumulative
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Advance Royalties, Current
unclassified.description: The amount paid to music publishers, record producers, songwriters, or other artists in advance of their earning royalties from record or music sales. Such an amount is based on contractual terms and is generally nonrefundable. This amount is expected to be consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Affiliate Costs
unclassified.description: Costs associated with revenues arising from an entity that is an affiliate of the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Foreign Currency Translation
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from converting allowance reserve for credit loss to currency of reporting entity from amount denominated or measured in a different currency, which decreases (increases) the allowance for loan and lease losses.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Amortization of above and below Market Leases
unclassified.description: Amount of non-cash amortization of intangible asset (liability) for above and below market leases.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Capitalized Value of Business Acquired Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
AssetsAverageOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of interest-earning and noninterest-earning assets.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after 10 Years, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after rolling tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security, measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in rolling sixth through tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Long-term Debt (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Liabilities, Long-term Debt (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Including Equity Interest in Acquiree Held Prior to Combination
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition date of asset transferred, liability incurred, equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer, and equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages. Includes, but is not limited to, instrument or interest issued or issuable by acquirer.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Range of Outcomes, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Value, Low
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Amount as of Acquisition Date
unclassified.description: Amount of indemnification asset recognized at acquisition date in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Assets
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial assets acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to property, plant, and equipment acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Liabilities, Current
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Land
unclassified.description: Amount of land acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Contingent Rental Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount due based upon the occurrence of an event specified in the contractual terms.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Two and Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the second and third fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Current
unclassified.description: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments on sales type leases and (b) unguaranteed residual value; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments on sales type leases, and (b) unguaranteed residual value; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases
unclassified.description: The net investment in sales type leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments on sales type leases and (b) unguaranteed residual value; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Units, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of capital units or capital shares outstanding. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Accumulated Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Derivative Instrument Liabilities at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all liability derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations, Operating Activities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Collateral Already Posted, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of assets that are already posted, at the end of the reporting period, as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Additional Series, Shares Authorized (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Compensation and Benefits Trust
unclassified.description: The value of a trust established to hold the stock of an employee compensation and benefits plan as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Additional Interest Issued to Parent
unclassified.description: Represents a (noncash) issuance of additional equity interests to the parent by a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The additional equity interest represented by this element increases the parent's controlling interest in the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Repurchase of Shares by Subsidiary
unclassified.description: Represents the repurchase of equity (treasury stock) by a subsidiary during the period, thereby effecting a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent; but not deconsolidation by the parent.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Cooperative Advertising Amount
unclassified.description: Total amount received by an entity from a vendor under a cooperative advertising arrangement that has been offset against advertising expense.

unclassified.label: Cost, Overhead
unclassified.description: Indirect cost incurred related to good produced and service rendered.

unclassified.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost of Services, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Credit and Debit Card Receivables, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Amount due the Entity as a result of customers utilizing point of sale debit or credit cards in exchange transactions with the entity which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition.

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Purchased Credit Protection
unclassified.description: Amount of purchased credit protection expected to cover future payments under the credit risk derivative.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedGainOperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainLossOperating
