unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: Customer Deposits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of debt premium to be amortized after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not to Sell before Recovery, Credit Loss, Previously Recorded, Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), not intended to be sold and not more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis, with previously recorded allowance.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityCumulativeUnrecognizedLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative unrecognized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleWeightedAverageYield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), sold.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Debtor-in-Possession Facility Financing Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization items related to debtor-in-possession facility financing costs.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization items related to impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Deferred Discounts, Finance Charges and Interest Included in Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned discount, finance charge, and interest included in face amount of receivable. Excludes cash or quantity discount or both.

unclassified.label: Deferred (Gain) Loss on Discontinuation of Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the unamortized adjustment to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item made under an effective fair value hedge that is amortized upon discontinuation of the fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP, and which are expected to be recognized as such after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Lease Income, after Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

unclassified.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for deferred sales inducement cost.

unclassified.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Asset Retirement Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from asset retirement obligations. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Self Insurance
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated losses under self insurance.

unclassified.label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Allocated to Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance for tax benefit to be credited to shareholders' equity if tax benefit subsequently becomes realizable. Includes, but is not limited to, adjustment to opening balance of retained earnings for change in accounting principle or correction of error, gain (loss) in comprehensive income (loss) but excluded from net income (loss), deductible expenditure for income tax purposes reported as reduction of shareholders' equity, and deductible temporary difference existing at date of quasi-reorganization.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement and Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in accumulated benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from effects of settlement and curtailment.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Gain (Loss), before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Plan Amendment on Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase (decrease) in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase, sale and settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Recognized Net (Gain) Loss Due to Settlements (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Debt Securities, Range Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Debt Securities, Range Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Deposit Liabilities, Collateral Issued, Financial Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of securities, mortgage loans, or other financial instruments pledged as collateral for deposits.

unclassified.label: DepreciationExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLease
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of depreciation expense.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetFairValueAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities received as collateral against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative Financial Instruments, Assets, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative, Floor Price
unclassified.description: Floor rate on a price risk derivative such as a floor or a collar. A payment or receipt is triggered if the market rate falls below the floor rate on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Forward Exchange Rate
unclassified.description: Contractual rate at which a foreign currency can be purchased or sold.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the assets arising from derivative contracts and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Aggregate net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized loss of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilityFairValueAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Excludes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Difference between Reported Amount and Reporting Currency Denominated Amount, Value
unclassified.description: The amount of difference between the reported amount and the reporting currency-denominated amount. The default debit balance is based on the reported amount that is greater that the reporting currency-denominated amount.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Other Income (Loss) from Disposition of Discontinued Operations, before Income Tax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Discontinued Operation, Amounts of Material Contingent Liabilities Remaining
unclassified.description: Amounts of material contingent liabilities, for example, but not limited to, product or environmental liabilities or litigation, that remain with the entity despite the disposal of the disposal group that is classified as a component of the entity.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable
unclassified.description: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Liabilities, Noncurrent
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationInvestment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Rental Income
unclassified.description: Amount of rental income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Undistributed
unclassified.description: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security, after giving effect to all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to life insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Committed-to-be-Released Shares
unclassified.description: The shares that, although not legally released, will be released by a future scheduled and committed debt service payment and will be allocated to employees for service rendered in the current accounting period. The ESOP documents typically define the period of service to which the shares relate. ESOP shares are released to compensate employees directly, to settle employer liabilities for other employee benefits, and to replace dividends on allocated shares that are used for debt service.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares Contributed to ESOP
unclassified.description: This item represents the number of shares provided to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) during the period.

unclassified.label: Entity-Wide Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Individual Foreign Countries, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptionModificationEquityIssuanceIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as equity issuance cost. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Equity Restrictions
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the amount of equity that is restricted to use by regulation or agreement.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Estimate Not Practicable, Investments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Long-term Revenue Growth Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Redemption Restriction, Percentage
unclassified.description: The percentage of the total value of investments that cannot be redeemed because of a redemption restriction as of the statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Level 2 to level 1 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Activity for Year, Average Balance of Agreements Outstanding
unclassified.description: The calculated average balance outstanding for the year for all Federal Home Loan Bank advances as of the Balance Sheet date.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Derivatives and Other Contractual Agreements, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in all assets resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments. Their value is derived from the values of one or more underlying assets, reference rates, or indices of asset values. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Services Liabilities
unclassified.description: For entities that provide full or partial financing and servicing for customers supplementary to its major operations (such as a manufacturer or a homebuilder providing and servicing loans to buyers), represents the liabilities associated with such activities, including accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss and Fee
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable individually evaluated for credit loss. Excludes financing receivable collectively evaluated for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Loan in Process
unclassified.description: Amount of undisbursed portion of financing receivable balance. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFinancingReceivablesExcludingAccruedInterestPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage, excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFinancingReceivablesPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Two, Originated, Fiscal Year before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Percent Past Due
unclassified.description: Percentage of financing receivable balance that is past due.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Revolving
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Sale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale and reclassification to held-for-sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Customer Lists, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer list acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Acquired-in-Place Leases
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of value allocated by a lessor (acquirer) to lease agreements which exist at acquisition of a leased property. Such amount may include the value assigned to existing tenant relationships and excludes the market adjustment component of the value assigned for above or below-market leases acquired.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Off-market Lease, Favorable, Gross
unclassified.description: This element represents the identifiable intangible asset established upon acquisition based on a favorable difference between the terms of an acquired lease and the current market terms for that lease at the acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossRealizedAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

unclassified.label: ForwardContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValuePerShare
unclassified.description: Fair value per share that would be issued upon settlement of forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Gain Contingency, Patents Found Not Infringed upon, Number
unclassified.description: Number of entity's patents that another entity was found not to have infringed.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when foreign currency cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Equity Method Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
unclassified.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account
unclassified.description: Amount of net gains or losses recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

unclassified.label: Gain on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The gain recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAssetDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in asset from government assistance.

unclassified.label: Gross Billing, Agent Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration expected to be received as agent for product and service transferred to customer by another party, before deduction of payment for product and service provided by that party.

unclassified.label: Ground Leases, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortization on long-term land leases capitalized as part of real property.

unclassified.label: Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Net
unclassified.description: Sum of the amount of expected guaranteed benefits in excess of the projected account balances for minimum guaranteed benefit contracts, as of the balance sheet date, net of reinsurance recoverables, for all guaranteed benefit types.

unclassified.label: Guaranty Assets
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of the contractual right to receive fees, as compensation in exchange for providing a guarantee to a third party, over life of the guarantee.

unclassified.label: Health Care Organization, Medical Supplies and Drugs Expense (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Hedging Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from a financial instrument or a contract used to hedge price changes in underlying assets, and which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Hedging Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability arising from a financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for 12 months or longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Debt Maturities, Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Restricted
unclassified.description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Impact of Restatement on Opening Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Impaired Financing Receivable, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Amount of unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: IncentiveFeePayable
unclassified.description: Amount of fee payable for management of operations based on performance under arrangement, including, but not limited to, investment.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Prior Period Adjustment
unclassified.description: The tax effect of correction of an error charged or credited directly to the opening balance of retained earnings.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Officers and Stockholders
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Cost in Excess of Billing on Uncompleted Contract
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the asset reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Officers and Stockholders, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in current obligations (due within one year or one operating cycle) owed to reporting entity's executives and owners.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for interest that provides economic benefits in future periods.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Forward Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shared included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity forward arrangements using the reverse treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in indefinite-lived intangible asset from divestiture. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Insurance Tax
unclassified.description: Represents total insurance tax expense reflected in the income statement for each period presented.

unclassified.label: Interest and Dividends Payable
unclassified.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity).

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Customer Deposits
unclassified.description: The interest expense recognized during the period on customer deposits or security deposits held in interest bearing accounts.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Medium-term Notes
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense incurred on medium-term note.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Savings Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on all savings account deposits.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Trust Preferred Securities
unclassified.description: The amount of interest incurred to a trust which has issued trust-preferred securities. In order to issue trust preferred securities, a sponsor forms a trust by investing a nominal amount of cash to purchase all of the voting common stock of the trust. The trust issues nonvoting, mandatorily redeemable preferred securities to outside investors in exchange for cash. The proceeds received from the issuance of the preferred securities, together with the cash received for issuing the common stock to the sponsor, is then loaned to the sponsor in exchange for a note which has the same terms as the trust preferred securities. Trust preferred securities possesses characteristics of both equity and debt issues and are generally issued by bank holding companies.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeDepositWithFinancialInstitutionIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest income on deposit with financial institution.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeOperatingPaidInCash
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from investment paid in cash, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeShortTermInvestmentIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest income on short-term investment.

unclassified.label: Interest Receivable and Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of interest receivable and assets classified as other.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Real Estate, Improvements
unclassified.description: Represents improvements to real estate during development for ultimate sale to third parties. Improvements may consist of project infrastructure and other expenditures necessary to completion of the development project which is generally of a long-term nature.

unclassified.label: Investment Building and Building Improvements
unclassified.description: Aggregate of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of investments in building and building improvements.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Gross Reductions
unclassified.description: Gross reductions to the investment in and advance to the affiliate.

unclassified.label: Lease Incentive Receivable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Noncurrent portion of receivables for an incentive or inducement contractually stipulated between parties to a lease whereby the lessor has committed to provide the entity (lessee) with a cash payment as inducement to enter the lease.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Lease Not yet Commenced, Assumption and Judgment, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of operating lease term for lease that has not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Liabilities of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement, Current
unclassified.description: The current carrying amount, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of liabilities resulting from the transfer of a business segment under contractual arrangement where the transferor maintains certain risks, obligations or liabilities.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Debt and Accrued Interest
unclassified.description: The amount of debt and related accrued interest included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: The amount of other obligations included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

unclassified.label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Amount
unclassified.description: This item represents the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the Entity as of the date of the statement of financial position. Such Entity-owned life insurance policies are commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of preferred units of ownership outstanding of a limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease), classified as other, of the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in financing receivable from proceeds for repayment of loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable with Variable Rates of Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of loan with variable or adjustable rate of interest.

unclassified.label: Long-Lived Assets to be Abandoned, Carrying Value of Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Long-term Construction Loan, Current
unclassified.description: This element represents the current portion of a long-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project (generally one to seven years), usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these loans tends to be high, and the lender has a security interest in the real property.

unclassified.label: Long-term Purchase Commitment, Minimum Quantity Required
unclassified.description: Number of units of goods that must be purchased within the specified time period of the agreement to avoid penalties or unfavorable effects on pricing, among other adverse consequences.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Patents Found Not Infringed, Number
unclassified.description: Number of another entity's patents that the entity was found not to have infringed.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual that is expected to be collected after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

unclassified.label: Loss from Catastrophes
unclassified.description: The charge against earnings in the period for the uninsured portion of a loss from a fire, explosion, or natural disaster (hurricane, earthquake).

unclassified.label: Loss on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
unclassified.description: Aggregate loss on all derivative instruments charged against earnings during the period, before tax effects.

unclassified.label: Losses (Gains) on Sales of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Malpractice Loss Contingency, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: The interest rate used to discount the estimated cash flows associated with the payment of malpractice claims.

unclassified.label: ManagementAndServiceFeesBaseRate
unclassified.description: Base rate for management and service fees under arrangement to manage operations, including, but not limited to, investment.

unclassified.label: Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred Stock, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of shares that an entity is required to redeem for cash or other assets at a fixed or determinable date or upon the occurrence of an event.

unclassified.label: Market Data Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue from market data services, including, but not limited to, information about current quotes and most recent prices for a specific security.

unclassified.label: Mineral Properties, Net
unclassified.description: Mineral properties, net of adjustments.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Amount Represented by Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The amount of noncontrolling interest in subsidiary represented by preferred securities issued by the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Carrying Amount of Mortgages (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Multiemployer Plan, Employer Contribution, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for employer contribution to multiemployer plan. Multiemployer plan includes, but is not limited to, pension plan determined to be individually significant and insignificant and other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Basic Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Diluted Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Employee Benefit Liabilities Assumed
unclassified.description: The amount of employee benefit liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Redeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

unclassified.label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on settlement of other claims for entities not in bankruptcy, reported as a reorganization item.

unclassified.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Amount of Barter Transaction
unclassified.description: The amount of revenue and expenses for the services received and provided in a nonmonetary arrangement.

unclassified.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gain (Loss) Recognized on Transfer
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the difference in values (gain (loss)) between the nonmonetary assets or liabilities exchanged with another entity inclusive of boot (small monetary consideration).

unclassified.label: Nonmonetary Transaction, Gross Operating Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: The amount of gross operating revenue recognized in a nonmonetary transaction.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivative Sale Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Operating Lease, Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee under operating lease. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
unclassified.description: The number of issuer's shares to which the option contract is indexed.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost (Credit) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Derecognition, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk, realized upon derecognition of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Other Ownership Interests, Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: The amount of capital contributed by other unit holders.

unclassified.label: Other Recurring Income
unclassified.description: Amount of recurring income classified as other.

unclassified.label: Participating Mortgage Loans, Participation Liabilities, Amount
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of the participation liability at the end of the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Sale of Units
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Allocated for Income Tax and Other Withdrawals
unclassified.description: Amount of partnership capital allocated for income tax and other withdrawals.

unclassified.label: Payments for Mortgage Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for advance payment to show intention to complete mortgage financing.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Removal Costs
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the costs of disposing of plant, whether by demolishing, dismantling, abandoning, sale, and so forth during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Mineral Rights
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a mineral right which is the right to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment, in the form of royalty, for the extraction of minerals.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Property
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to purchase of mineral interests in oil and gas properties for use in the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

unclassified.label: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Other Assets Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pre-Opening Costs
unclassified.description: Expenditures associated with opening new locations which are noncapital in nature and expensed as incurred.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price, Decrease
unclassified.description: Per share decrease in conversion price of convertible preferred stock. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Premiums and Other Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date, net of allowance for doubtful accounts, of all premiums and other types of receivables due from other persons or entities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Deposits with Other Institutions
unclassified.description: Cash received from refund of deposits with other institutions during the period.

unclassified.label: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundStateAndLocal
unclassified.description: Amount of cash received from state and local tax jurisdictions for refund of tax on income.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Trust Preferred Securities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Total amount of cash received from operating activities during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Refunds from Suppliers of Material
unclassified.description: Cash received for refunds from suppliers during the current period. This element includes refunds from suppliers of materials; it excludes refunds from providers of fixed assets.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturities, repayments and calls of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Partnership Unit
unclassified.description: The proceeds from the sale of an interest in a unit of partnership.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

unclassified.label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Best Estimate
unclassified.description: Best estimate of the loss exposure for a reasonably possible liability for product liability damages for which no accrual has been recorded.

unclassified.label: Product Liability Contingency, Third Party Recovery, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of the estimated recovery from third parties recorded in the period pertaining to product liability damages from specified products.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Equity Capital Structure, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved equity to capital, including debt and equity.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for preferred shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

unclassified.label: Reductions in Other Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of significant reductions in the period of other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

unclassified.label: Registration Payment Arrangement, Accrual Carrying Value
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the liability representing the obligation under the registration payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Retention Policy, Reinsured Risk, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of risk undertaken originally by insurer ceded to reinsurer.

unclassified.label: Related Party Tax Expense, Due to Affiliates, Deferred
unclassified.description: The amount of any deferred tax-related balances due to affiliates as of the date of each statement of financial position presented.

unclassified.label: Related Party Tax Expense Effect of Change in Allocation Methodology
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in tax expense resulting from change in methodology used to allocate tax expense to members of a group for which a consolidated tax return is filed.

unclassified.label: Reorganization Value
unclassified.description: Amount attributed to the reconstituted entity, as well as the expected net realizable value of those assets that will be disposed before reconstitution occurs.

unclassified.label: Research and Development Arrangement with Federal Government, Costs Incurred, Net
unclassified.description: The net amount of research and development costs incurred for a fixed-price, best-efforts research and development cost-sharing arrangement with the Federal Government.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The accumulated depreciation and amortization related to the asset(s) sold in connection with the property sold to another party and leased back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Amount Due under Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: The liability due as of the balance sheet date for leasebacks accounted for using the deposit method.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Historical Cost
unclassified.description: The historical cost of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Rent Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of the current period expense recorded for use of the property in connection with the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted lease receivable in excess of discounted receivable for sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from lease receivable of sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income from net investment on sales-type lease, and profit (loss) recognized at commencement.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability associated with funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Revenue from External Customers (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting, Reconciling Item for Operating Profit (Loss) from Segment to Consolidated, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Self Insurance Reserve, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property that are expected to be paid after one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The net total number of shares (or other type of equity) under an equity-based award plan, other than a stock option plan, that were granted, vested and forfeited during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Capitalized Cost
unclassified.description: The amount by which an asset or assets increased resulting from the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Tax Benefit
unclassified.description: The amount of income tax expense reduction and deferred tax asset recorded in the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Committed-to-be-Released
unclassified.description: Number of committed-to-be-released shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Committed-to-be-released shares are shares that will be released in the future and will be allocated to employees for services rendered in an accounting period. These shares are legally released from suspense and from serving as collateral for ESOP debt as a result of payment of debt service.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Impact of Changes in Fair Value of Shares on Amount
unclassified.description: Increase (decrease) in settlement amount from change in fair value of issuer's equity shares. For example, but not limited to, issuer obligated to pay an additional Y dollars in cash for each $1 decrease in the fair value of one share.

unclassified.label: Subordinated Debt, Current
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying value of subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle, if longer. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Subsequent Event, Effect of Change in Tax Status
unclassified.description: Monetary effect of a change in the tax status effective after year-end but before the financial statements for the reporting period are issued or available to be issue by the entity.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary of Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Ownership Interest
unclassified.description: The number of units or percentage investment held in the subsidiary by the limited liability company or limited partnership.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Proceeds Received on All Transactions
unclassified.description: Cumulative amount of cash and other consideration received by subsidiary or equity method investee in exchange for shares or stock issued or sold. Include amounts of cash received, fair value of non-cash assets received, fair value of liabilities assumed, and fair value of any other forms of consideration.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Cost for Income Tax Purposes
unclassified.description: Amount of cost of investment for federal income tax purpose.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Provisional Undistributed Accumulated Earnings of Foreign Subsidiary (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Time Deposit Maturities, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities of one year or less.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Trade Receivables (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Tax Benefit (Expense) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable
unclassified.description: Amount of unbilled receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable.

unclassified.label: Underwriting Expense Ratio
unclassified.description: Ratio of non-life acquisition expenses and certain non-life general and administrative expenses, to non-life net premiums earned.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Continuing Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges, Pretax, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the increase or decrease in fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which was recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge was determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unsolicited Tender Offer Costs
unclassified.description: Costs incurred in connection with an unsolicited tender offer (one where the Entity being sought has not requested the offer). These would include costs relating to evaluation and dissemination of information regarding an unsolicited tender offer. A tender offer is a broad solicitation by an Entity or a third party to purchase a substantial percentage of another entity's shares or units for a limited period of time. The offer is at a fixed price, usually at a premium over the current market price, and is contingent on shareholders' tendering a fixed number of their shares or units.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Current (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Venture Capital Gain (Loss), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on venture capital activities. Includes venture capital revenue, fair value adjustments, interest and dividends, investment gain (loss) and fee or other income from venture capital activities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Treasury Stock
unclassified.description: Number of shares of treasury stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that treasury shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Treasury stock is stock that the Entity has issued but subsequently reacquired.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Demand
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic demand deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Workers' Compensation Liability
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations and payables pertaining to claims incurred of a workers compensation nature.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liabilities incurred for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business and related party payables.

unclassified.label: AccountsReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
unclassified.description: Amount of accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent, 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

unclassified.label: Accrued Environmental Loss Contingencies, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value of the obligation (known or estimated) arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites, payable in twelve months or in the next operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Accrued Participation Liabilities, Due in Next Operating Cycle
unclassified.description: The amount of accrued participation liabilities that it expects to pay during the upcoming operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Deferred Investment Tax Credit
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of the reserve for accumulated deferred investment tax credits as of the balance sheet date. This is the remaining investment credit, which will reduce the cost of services collected from ratepayers by a ratable portion over the investment's regulatory life.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, after Reinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of reinsurance, of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate governmental agency or vendor on behalf of the borrower.

unclassified.label: Advance Payments Netted Against Claim Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of advance payments received on the contract before its termination shown as a deduction from the claim receivable related to a termination of a contract.

unclassified.label: Advances Received on Government Contracts, Not Netted Against Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Advances received on government contracts that are not offset against receivables because they cannot be definitely regarded as payments on account for contract work in progress.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Adjustments, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other addition (reduction) in allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Loans Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of reduction of allowance reserve for credit loss arising from sale of loan and lease portfolios.

unclassified.label: Amortization Expense Per Dollar of Gross Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense per dollar of gross revenue from production in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

unclassified.label: Amortization of ESOP Award
unclassified.description: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Amount of Ineffectiveness on Net Investment Hedges
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) on hedging derivative instrument or the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on the nonderivative hedging instrument designated as a hedge of a net investment in foreign operations related to hedge ineffectiveness, which is included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Amount Recognized in Income Due to Inflationary Accounting
unclassified.description: The amount that will be recognized through the income statement (as well as the impact on the other financial statements) as part of highly inflationary accounting.

unclassified.label: AOCI, Derivative Qualifying as Hedge, Excluded Component, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative hedge.

unclassified.label: Application of Recognition Provisions of FAS 158, Effect on Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

unclassified.label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Market Value
unclassified.description: Market value of assets sold under agreements to repurchase when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under repurchase agreements exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Par Value Per Share
unclassified.description: The par value of the auction market preferred security.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Value (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Transfers to Trading, Gross Gains
Available-for-sale Securities, Failed Auction, Value
unclassified.description: The value of securities held, for which the interest rate resets through an auction process, that are categorized neither as trading nor held-to-maturity, that failed to be liquidated through auction.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Realized Losses, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Other, Fair Value Volatility, Rate
unclassified.description: This item represents the volatility of the security's fair value, represented as a percentage, which was considered as one of the potential factors in reaching a conclusion that the available-for-sale investments are not other-than-temporarily impaired.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Other, Percentage of Nonperforming Assets
