unclassified.description: This item represents the percentage of nonperforming assets that the underlying assets in the security represent and which were considered as one of the potential factors in reaching a conclusion that the available-for-sale investments are not other-than-temporarily impaired.

unclassified.label: Bank Acceptances Executed
unclassified.description: The amount of the financial institution's obligation to pay the holder of the customer's draft which the financial institution has guaranteed (i.e., Banker's Acceptance).

unclassified.label: BankingRegulationMaximumPayoutAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of eligible retained income multiplied by applicable maximum payout ratio as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Bankruptcy Claims, Amount of Claims Settled
unclassified.description: Amount of bankruptcy claim settled.

unclassified.label: Bankruptcy Claims, Amount Paid to Settle Claims
unclassified.description: Amount paid to settle bankruptcy claim.

unclassified.label: Bankruptcy Claims, Number of Claims Settled
unclassified.description: The aggregate number of claims settled.

unclassified.label: Benefits, Losses and Expenses
unclassified.description: The total amount of expense recognized during the period for future policy benefits, claims and claims adjustment costs, and for selling, general and administrative costs.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Equity Interest Issued or Issuable, Number of Shares (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Preacquisition Contingency, Amount of Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount paid or received to resolve the preacquisition contingency.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Deferred Tax Assets, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Preacquisition Contingency Accrual (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Assets Recognized
unclassified.description: The assets recognized for each amount of assets recorded in a transaction with the acquiree that is recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of loss from remeasurement of acquisition-date fair value of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due in Four and Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fourth and fifth fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Sublease Rentals
unclassified.description: Minimum payments receivable in the future under noncancelable subleases.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: Total amount of lease revenue realized in the period on leasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Sales Type Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: Revenue realized in the period on sales type leases.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The net amount due after one year of the balance sheet date or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortization of deferred income and initial direct costs pertaining to direct financing leases, which resulted from producing constant periodic rates of return on the net investments in the leases over their respective lease terms.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Allowance for Uncollectible Minimum Lease Payments
unclassified.description: The estimate of minimum payments on sales-type leases that are probable of not being collected as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: The remaining (unamortized) difference between the gross investment in a sales-type lease and the cost or carrying amount of the leased property as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Executory Costs
unclassified.description: Estimated remaining costs to be incurred to service the sales-type lease, such as taxes, maintenance and insurance and the profit thereon, that are included in the minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Minimum Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of remaining payments as of the balance sheet date that lessees are obligated to make or can be required to make under sales-type leases, including any guarantee of residual value and executory costs. The amount also includes any guaranteed rental payments by an unrelated third-party provided that are financially capable of making such payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases of Lessee, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessee's capital lease.

unclassified.label: CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearOne
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearThree
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearTwo
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Support Equipment and Facilities
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for support equipment and facility in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, seismic, drilling, construction, and grading equipment, vehicle, repair shop, warehouse, supply point, camp, division, district, and field office.

unclassified.label: Carrying Costs, Property and Exploration Rights
unclassified.description: The costs incurred to retain exploration and property rights after acquisition but before production has occurred. Costs include legal costs for title defense, ad valorem taxes on nonproducing mineral properties, shut-in royalties, and delay rentals.

unclassified.label: Carrying Value of Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements and Deposits Received for Securities Loaned
unclassified.description: Carrying value of securities sold under agreements to repurchase and deposits received for securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Federal Funds Sold
unclassified.description: The sum of cash and cash equivalents plus Federal Funds Sold. Cash and cash equivalents consist of short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and are so near their maturity that they present negligible risk of changes in value due to changes in interest rates -- usually with an original maturity less than 90 days.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Derivative Instrument Assets at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all asset derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Cost of Sales, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedges Derivative Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which is ordinarily reflected within other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Proceeds from New Transfers
unclassified.description: Cash Flows between a transferor and a transferee attributable to newly transferred assets related to either a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Repayments of Servicing Fee Advances
unclassified.description: Cash flows between transferee and transferor in repayment of service fee advances, in advance of a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Servicing Fees
unclassified.description: Cash Flows between a transferee and a transferor attributable to servicing fees related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Beneficial Interest
unclassified.description: Cash flows between transferee and transferor in payment of the transferor's beneficial interest related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction.

unclassified.label: Ceded Premiums Payable
unclassified.description: The consideration due to the assuming enterprise as of the balance sheet date under the terms of the reinsurance contract in exchange for the right to receive reimbursement from such entity for covered claims and expenses.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivative and nonderivative instruments designated as fair value hedge recognized in earnings to extent that fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Collateralized Financings
unclassified.description: The value of the collateral (typically cash) that the entity receives in a financing transaction in exchange for securities lent. This item represents a liability in the financial statements of the lender of the securities.

unclassified.label: Commissions Payable to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount payable to broker-dealers or clearing organizations for executing or clearing trades or orders.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Additional Series, Shares, Issued (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Common Stock, Additional Series, Shares, Outstanding (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Common Stock Issued, Employee Trust, Deferred
unclassified.description: Aggregate value of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued, Value (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Construction Contract Cost, Progress Payment Offset
unclassified.description: Amount of progress payment netted against construction contract cost.

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer withheld under retainage provision in long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional.

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fees, Amount
unclassified.description: All amounts that, per contract, are due to the servicer in exchange for servicing the financial asset and would no longer be received by a servicer if the beneficial owners of the serviced assets (or their trustees or agents) were to exercise their actual or potential authority under the contract to shift the servicing to another servicer. Depending on the servicing contract, those fees may include some or all of the difference between the interest rate collected on the asset being serviced and the rate to be paid to the beneficial owners of the asset.

unclassified.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Depreciation and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost of Goods Sold, Direct Materials (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost of Other Property Operating Expense
unclassified.description: Other operating costs incurred during the reporting period and may include amounts paid to maintain the property.

unclassified.label: Costs in Excess of Billings, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable reflecting the cost incurred on uncompleted contracts in excess of related billings which is expected to be collected after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Costs Incurred, Acquisition of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: Amount of acquisition cost incurred for property with proved and unproved reserves in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Costs Incurred, Asset Retirement Obligation Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligation (ARO) cost incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Costs Incurred, Exploration Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of exploration cost incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetFairValueRestricted
unclassified.description: Fair value of crypto asset subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetPeriodIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in crypto asset. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealizedGainOperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealizedLossOperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized loss from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes change for crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedGainLossOperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetUnrealizedGainNonoperating
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, before Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Custody Fees
unclassified.description: Those fees charged for services related to holding, advising, and managing customer investment assets. These account fees usually charged annually or semi-annually, on a per security basis, for the costs of services.

unclassified.label: Customer Loyalty Program Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Value of deferred revenue or cost to provide products or services, which is expected to be recognized in income or incurred within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, resulting from customer loyalty program. Excludes liability associated with frequent flier programs. Includes liability associated with customer loyalty programs for other businesses, for example, but is not limited to, hotels, supermarkets, credit card companies, automobile rental companies, and book sellers.

unclassified.label: Customer Refund Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Noncurrent regulatory liabilities generally represent obligations to make refunds to customers for various reasons including overpayment.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities. Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Collateral Fee
unclassified.description: Amount of fees associated with providing collateral for the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price, Decrease
unclassified.description: Per share decrease in conversion price of debt instrument. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Sinking Fund Payment
unclassified.description: Amount paid into a fund, which is used to retire the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unused Borrowing Capacity, Fee
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment fees for the unused borrowing capacity under the long-term financing arrangement that is available to the entity.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), from recovery.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Securities Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from sale.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale and Held-to-maturity
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Revaluation of Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount recognized from the revaluation of assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Decommissioning Fund Investments
unclassified.description: Decommission fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities through collection of revenues derived from utility assessments and government appropriations. Decommission fund investment for the process whereby a power station, at the end of its economic life, is taken permanently out of service and its site made available for other purposes. In the case of a nuclear station this comprises three different states of clearance. Immediately after the final closure, radioactive material such as nuclear fuel and operational waste is removed and the buildings surrounding the reactor shield are dismantled and finally the reactor itself is dismantled.

unclassified.label: Deferred Advertising Costs
unclassified.description: The costs of direct-response advertising whose primary purpose is to elicit sales to customers who could be shown to have responded specifically to the advertising and that results in probable future benefits and are reported as assets net of accumulated amortization.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Cash-based Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, before deduction of accumulated amortization or effects of subsequent adjustments.

unclassified.label: DeferredIncomeAddition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in deferred income not accounted for under Topic 606.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Policyholder Liabilities
unclassified.description: The tax effect as of the balance sheet date of the amount of the estimated future tax deductions arising from estimated policyholder reserves, which will be deductible from future taxable income when actual costs are incurred, and which can only be realized if sufficient tax-basis income is generated in future periods to enable the tax deduction to be taken.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Zero Coupon Notes
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in zero coupon (no stated interest) debt securities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance for deferred tax asset related to intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Transition Asset (Obligation), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation)
unclassified.description: Amount of transition asset (obligation) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Remeasurement due to Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from remeasurement due to settlement. Excludes decrease to benefit obligation for settlement payment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Cost of Providing Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cost of providing special or contractual termination benefits payable from defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Five Rolling Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Five (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Three (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of employer stock in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, stock issued or managed by related party of employer.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other, Range Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other, Range Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Real Estate (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations Range Minimum (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Number of Employees Covered (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Demutualization by Insurance Entity, Securities Issued, Amount of Net Proceeds
unclassified.description: The proceeds received by an insurance entity after deducting offering and other costs of securities issued and after policy credits, in connection with its conversion from a mutual form of ownership to a stock entity.

unclassified.label: Deposits Paid for Securities Borrowed, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: This is the amount of cash advanced as security in return for borrowing securities from another party.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Savings Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of interest bearing deposits with no stated maturity, which may include passbook and statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs).

unclassified.label: Deposits with Clearing Organizations and Others, Securities
unclassified.description: The amount of securities on deposit with clearing organizations and other entities which provide services necessary to operations of the Company. This item would include, for instance, securities advanced as refundable collateral for securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellSecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Excludes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average fixed interest rate related to the group of interest rate derivatives.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Forward Exchange Rate
unclassified.description: Average contractual rate at which a foreign currency can be purchased or sold.

unclassified.label: Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative liabilities to properly reflect the credit quality of the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Floor Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Floor rate on an interest rate derivative such as an interest rate floor or collar. If market rates falls below the floor rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Forward Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Stated rate on an interest rate forward or futures contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
unclassified.description: The effective portion of gain reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Recognized in Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Swaption Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Fixed interest rate that will be received or paid upon exercise of the interest rate swaption contract.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term, guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee under direct financing lease. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Continuing Cash Flows after Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) the discontinued operation after the disposal transaction.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Other Income (Loss) from Disposition of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Declared
unclassified.description: Amount of equity impact of cash distribution declared to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distributions on Mandatorily Redeemable Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of distribution on mandatorily redeemable financial instrument issued in form of share classified as liability.

unclassified.label: DividendIncomeOperatingPaidInCash
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend income from investment paid in cash, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
unclassified.description: Amount of operating dividend income on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

unclassified.label: Due from Customer Acceptances
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

unclassified.label: Due from Other Related Parties, Noncurrent
Early Repayment of Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets before its maturity.

unclassified.label: Effect on Future Earnings, Amount
unclassified.description: The quantified amount of the future effect on earnings.

unclassified.label: Effect on Future Earnings, Offset Amount
unclassified.description: The amount that will be offset against future earnings by anticipated increases or decreases in other expenses or revenues.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to depreciation.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxCreditEnergyRelatedAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to energy-related tax credit.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxCreditEnergyRelatedPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to energy-related tax credit.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Cash Contributions to ESOP
unclassified.description: This item represents the amount of cash contributions during the period made by the entity to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of unearned shares held by the employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Gain (Loss) on Transactions in Deferred Shares
unclassified.description: The difference between cost and fair value added or subtracted from paid-in capital, arising from contribution of shares to an ESOP or commitments-to-release ESOP shares.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Tax Benefit of Dividends Paid to Plan
unclassified.description: The tax benefit resulting from dividends paid on preferred stock held by an employee stock option plan, when that stock is not a common stock equivalent.

unclassified.label: Entertainment, License Agreement for Program Material, Capitalized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized cost for right acquired by broadcaster under license agreement for program material.

unclassified.label: EntertainmentLicenseAgreementForProgramMaterialLiabilityNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation incurred for right acquired by broadcaster under license agreement for program material, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Environmental Expense and Liabilities
unclassified.description: The adjustment to exclude the noncash portion of, and include cash payments for environmental costs when calculating operating cash flows under the indirect method. The adjustment can include the increase (decrease) during an accounting period in total estimated obligations recorded for probable future loss attributable to environmental contamination issues.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Deferred Gain on Sale
unclassified.description: This element represents disclosure of the amount of gain which has been deferred as the result of the sale of a business or operating assets to a highly leveraged entity which deferred gain has been reflected in the accompanying statement of financial position as reduction from the related asset.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities and Equity (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Escrow Deposit Disbursements Related to Property Acquisition (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Exploration Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized exploration cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and development costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Per Share, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Per share impact of the gain (loss) on the extinguishment of debt, net of applicable taxes.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
FDIC Indemnification Asset, Cash Payments Received
unclassified.description: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to cash payments received relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Expected Dividend (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Derivative Instruments, Assets
unclassified.description: Fair value of derivative asset subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: FairValueConcentrationOfRiskLiabilitiesRelatedToInvestmentContracts
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability for investment contract subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Face Amount, Liability
unclassified.description: The face amount of financial liabilities, which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Equity, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Equity, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Estimate Not Practicable, Equity Method Investments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Percent Equity Securities
unclassified.description: The percentage of the total value of investments that are equity securities for a given category of investments for which net asset value per share is calculated.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Trading Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Debt Instrument, Valuation Techniques, Change in Technique, Quantification of Effect
unclassified.description: Represents the quantification of the effect of changes in the valuation technique and related inputs, during the period, used to measure the liability at fair value as of the statement of financial position reporting date.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset and Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Settlements (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases, Sales, Issues, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Interest rate of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Film, Monetized on Its Own, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized film cost for film predominantly monetized on its own.

unclassified.label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Par Value Per Share
unclassified.description: Par value per share of mandatory redeemable financial instrument classified as liability.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of firm holdings in securities classified as other. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestModified
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued interest on financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanPurchased
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased loan classified as other. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, purchased seasoned loan, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Effect of Change in Method
unclassified.description: The effect of a change in method or methods for calculating the allowance for credit losses on the current period provision.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Provisions (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Recoveries (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable from change in methodology. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Change in Present Value, Expense (Reversal)
Financing Receivable, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable collectively evaluated for credit loss. Excludes financing receivable individually evaluated for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Deferred Commitment Fee
unclassified.description: Amount of fee received for commitment to originate or purchase financing receivable where likelihood of commitment being exercised is remote, to be recognized as service income.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestNonaccrualPercentPastDue
unclassified.description: Percentage of nonaccrual financing receivable, excluding accrued interest, that is outstanding and past due. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingConvertedToTermLoan
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Postmodification
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortized cost of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of financing receivable contracts modified as troubled debt restructuring within previous 12 months, with subsequent payment default.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on financing receivable on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Three, Originated, Two Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated two years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Purchase Price
unclassified.description: Amount at purchase price of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 30 to 59 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable 90 days or more past due and still accruing. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableSale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Unamortized Loan Fee (Cost)
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized loan commitment, origination, and other costs (fees) on financing receivable recognized as adjustment to yield. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Unamortized Purchase Premium (Discount)
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized purchase premium (discount) on financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Contractual Rights, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of an intangible asset that arises from a contractual arrangement with a third party (not including franchise rights and license agreements).

unclassified.label: Flight Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Cash, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid upon settlement of forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Shares
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that could be issued to settle forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Assets, Current
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Current
Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of funds held as security for payments to be received under reinsurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: Net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) of foreign currency cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss)recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) during the reporting period due to ineffectiveness in foreign currency cash flow hedges. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on interest rate fair value hedges.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Commodity Contracts
unclassified.description: The difference between the book value and the sale price of agreements to purchase or sell mineral resources, energy, and agricultural products at some future point. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Insurance Block
unclassified.description: Excess (deficiency) of net proceeds received over the net carrying value of a certain, bundled grouping of insurance policies.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
unclassified.description: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary
unclassified.description: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

unclassified.label: General and Administrative Costs in Inventory, Amount Remaining
unclassified.description: Actual or estimated amount of general and administrative costs remaining in inventory.

unclassified.label: General Partners' Capital Account
unclassified.description: The amount of the general partner's ownership interest.

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Liquidation Proceeds, Percentage
unclassified.description: Indicates, if estimable, (as a percentage) the approximate extent to which the proceeds from liquidation of any assets held either as collateral or by third parties would be expected to cover the maximum potential amount of future payments under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Discontinued Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged liability in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk, remaining after discontinued hedge. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investment positions in unrealized loss position for held-to-maturity security where cost exceeds fair value and its impairment is not other-than-temporary.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Includes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) previously recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impairment Effect on Earnings Per Share, after Tax
unclassified.description: After tax earnings per share or per unit impact arising from asset impairment.

unclassified.label: ImpairmentLessorAssetUnderOperatingLease
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Excludes discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Other
unclassified.description: The tax effect of items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to components of shareholders' equity and are not otherwise defined.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Leases, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible lease expense.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Collateral Held under Securities Lending
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of assets, which may include but are not limited to cash and investments, received as collateral pertaining to securities loaned to a counterparty to the transaction. Includes the change during the period in any unrealized gain or loss on such investments.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of price risk derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Assets
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period in insurance industry assets which are classified as cash flows from operating activities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Inventory for Long-term Contracts or Programs
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of inventory pertaining to construction, development, or other contracts or programs that initially were expected to take more than one year or the normal operating cycle to complete.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense Reserve
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in net unamortized loan origination fees and other fees that are collected at origination but recorded as income over the life of the loan.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Raw Materials, Packaging Materials and Supplies Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of raw materials, packaging materials and supplies held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Recoverable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Loaned Transactions
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability arising from securities loaned transactions.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of accelerated share repurchase agreements. An accelerated share repurchase program is a combination of transactions that permits an entity to purchase a targeted number of shares immediately with the final purchase price of those shares determined by an average market price over a fixed period of time.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Initial Franchise Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of initial franchise fees.

unclassified.label: Insurance Receivable for Malpractice, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of the amount receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedAccumulatedAmortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseRemainderOfFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed, expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Intercompany Foreign Currency Balance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

unclassified.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Available-for-sale
Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Money Market
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Capital Securities
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on capital securities issued by the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Demand Deposit Accounts
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on demand deposit accounts that represent borrowings rather than outstanding drafts.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased
unclassified.description: Gross expenses on the purchase of Federal funds at a specified price with a simultaneous agreement to sell the same to the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price at a future date.

unclassified.label: InterestExpenseInterestBearingLiabilityIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest expense on interest-bearing liability.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense on Prepetition Liabilities Recognized in Statement of Operations
unclassified.description: The amount of interest expense on prepetition obligations included in the statement of operations.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Other Short-term Borrowings
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on other short-term borrowings.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits
unclassified.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, in domestic offices.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, less than $100,000 in domestic offices.

unclassified.label: Interest Income and Fees, Bankers Acceptances, Certificates of Deposit and Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income derived from banker's acceptances, certificates of deposit and commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Foreign Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest income generated from amounts on deposit with foreign entities located outside the United States of America.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Money Market Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest earned on funds deposited in US domestic money market accounts.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Purchased Receivables
unclassified.description: Interest earned from receivables purchased; for instance, receivables purchased through a factoring arrangement.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, Corporate Debt, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on corporate debt securities.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury
unclassified.description: Interest income on US treasury securities. US treasury securities are negotiable debt obligations of the US government, secured by its full faith and credit and issued at various schedules and maturities. The income from treasury securities is exempt from state and local, but not federal, taxes. There are three types of securities issued by the US treasury (bonds, bills, and notes), which are distinguished by the amount of time from the initial sale of the bond to maturity.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivatives designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Real Estate
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate project held for sale, held for development, and under development with intent to sell upon completion of project.

unclassified.label: Investment Advisory, Management and Administrative Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Investment Banking Revenue
unclassified.description: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyExcessExpenseReimbursable
unclassified.description: Amount of carryover of excess expense potentially reimbursable to adviser but not recorded as liability by investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Fee Paid Indirectly
unclassified.description: Amount that would have been incurred for brokerage service had service been paid for directly in arm's-length transaction.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyIssuanceOfSharesPerShare
unclassified.description: Per share amount of share issuance by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, per unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyMarketValuePerShare
unclassified.description: Market value per share of investment portfolio by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, per unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Registration Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of registration fee expense for issuance of shares or units.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Shareholder Service Fee Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for shareholder services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee and expense for transfer and dividend disbursing agent.

unclassified.label: Investment in Physical Commodities
unclassified.description: Investments held in physical commodities, such as gold, silver, platinum, crude oil, coal, sugar, rice, wheat.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation
unclassified.description: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net
unclassified.description: This element represents the net excess or deficiency of the fair value of an investment (security, contract) over or under its cost (face amount, notional amount), respectively, which excess value or deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value
Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the investments in and advances to affiliates.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Balance, Principal Amount
Landing Fees and Other Rentals
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for cost incurred at airport in which airline conducts flight operation. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid to airport authority for takeoff and landing, gate space and facility, security, fuel storage facility, and other terminal costs. Excludes expense for leasing aircraft from third party.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in period after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Liabilities of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion, due in greater than one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of liabilities resulting from the transfer of a business segment under contractual arrangement where the transferor maintains certain risks, obligations, or liabilities.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: The amount of trade accounts payable included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process.

unclassified.label: Life Premiums as Percentage of Gross Premiums
unclassified.description: Ratio with total life insurance premiums in numerator and total GAAP premiums in the denominator.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value amount of life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: This item represents the gains or losses recognized and realized during the period on investments in life settlement contracts sold during the period.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.
