unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Authorized
unclassified.description: Maximum number of preferred units of ownership permitted to be issued of a limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Issuance Value
unclassified.description: Stated value of preferred units of ownership issued by a limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Preferred Unit, Issued
unclassified.description: Number of preferred units issued of limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Issued
unclassified.description: The number of limited partner units issued.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance, Covered
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for loan and lease losses covered by loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sales, Net
unclassified.description: Reflects the net positive or negative amount derived from subtracting from net proceeds of sale and the carrying amounts, net of allocated reserves, of financial assets transferred to third parties in transactions that qualify for sales treatment.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Nonaccrual of Interest
unclassified.description: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which no interest is continuing to be recognized.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income
unclassified.description: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Basis Spread on Variable Rate, During Period
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate or index during the adjustment period to compute the variable [fully indexed] rate on the loans receivable realized during the reporting period. This may be an effective margin for the period depending on the specific terms of the underlying loan agreement (for example, an annual disclosure for a loan with a quarterly adjustment period).

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Trade Financing (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage discount rate used to calculate present value of an expected stream of future payments, which is included in the calculation of the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long Lived Assets Held-for-sale, Gain (Loss) on Sale (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Long-term Commercial Paper, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term unsecured obligations issued by corporations and other borrowers to investors (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Long-term Contract for Purchase of Electric Power, Annual Minimum Debt Service Payment Required
unclassified.description: Under long-term contracts with public utility districts, cooperatives or other organizations, a utility company receives a portion of the output of a production plant constructed and financed by the district or cooperative. The utility has only a nominal or no investment at all in the plant but pays a proportionate part of the plant's costs, including debt service. If the utility is obligated to pay certain minimum amounts which cover debt service requirements whether or not the plant is operating, the amount can be disclosed here.

unclassified.label: Long-term Notes Payable, Current and Noncurrent (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the second and third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Remainder of Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Transition Bond, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Long-Term transition bonds are bonds under the Competition Act in which the proceeds of Transition Bonds are required to be used principally to reduce qualified stranded costs and the related capitalization of the utility. This represents the noncurrent portion.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Amount
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Carrying Value, Provision (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loss Contingency, Patents Found Infringed, Number
unclassified.description: Number of another entity's patents that the entity was found to have infringed.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of additions to receivables pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Undiscounted Amount of Insurance-related Assessment Liability
unclassified.description: The liability as of the balance sheet date representing required funding mandated by statute or regulatory authority that is related directly or indirectly to underwriting activities, including pools for self-insurance and excluding premium taxes and income taxes. The funds derived from the assessments generally enable a government guarantor to pay insurance claims in the event that the underwriting insurer is insolvent or otherwise unable to meet its payment obligations.

unclassified.label: Loss on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The loss recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Malpractice Insurance, Coverage Floor
unclassified.description: Amount at the low end of the range in which the insurance begins to cover losses and costs associated with malpractice claims.

unclassified.label: Market Risk Benefit, Change in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in fair value of contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk. Excludes change attributable to instrument-specific credit risk.

unclassified.label: Medium-term Notes
unclassified.description: Amount of debt instrument classified as medium-term.

unclassified.label: Medium-term Notes, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of debt instrument classified as medium-term and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Mineral Properties, Gross
unclassified.description: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral properties, gross of adjustments.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Other (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, New Mortgage Loan
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from new investment.

unclassified.label: Mortgages Held-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of mortgage loans held-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plans, Withdrawal Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of the obligation recognized by withdrawing from a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Diluted
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to limited partnership (LP) unit-holder and units that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of limited partner units for dilutive potential units outstanding.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Net income (loss) allocated to each outstanding limited partnership and general partnership unit.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Liabilities, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Value
unclassified.description: Value of net shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Nonredeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

unclassified.label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Legal and Advisory Professional Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization items related to legal and advisory professional fees related to entities not in bankruptcy.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Income, Other
unclassified.description: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Fair Value Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Net Investment Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Notional Amount of Net Investment Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Credit Risk Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of credit risk derivative instruments held.

unclassified.label: Number of Interest Rate Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of interest rate derivative instruments held by the entity at the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Number of Properties Subject to Ground Leases
unclassified.description: Number of separate real estate development properties located on land subject to ground leases.

unclassified.label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount outstanding, before the effects of recovery, of obligation under the joint and several liability arrangement.

unclassified.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

unclassified.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

unclassified.label: Oil and Gas Property, Full Cost Method, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depletion, of oil and gas properties subject to amortization accounted for under full cost method.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, over Term
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease initial direct cost recognized as expense over lease term.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth and fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second and third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Minimum Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: The total amount of lease revenue recognized for the period for which the lessee was obligated under leasing arrangements regardless of any other events or conditions. This amount excludes contingent revenue and sublease revenue.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Sublease Rentals (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Shares, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding option contract.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Reclassification for Discontinuance, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from discontinuance of cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Credits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Increase (Decrease) in Environmental Liabilities
unclassified.description: Other increase (decrease) not attributable to current expense nor cash payments during an accounting period in estimated obligations recorded for probable future costs attributable to environmental contamination issues.

unclassified.label: Other Nonoperating-Asset Related Income
unclassified.description: Amount of income related to nonoperating assets, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Partners' Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of other partners' capital.

unclassified.label: Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
unclassified.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

unclassified.label: Liability, Other Retirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for retirement benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

unclassified.label: OtherReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on receivable classified as other and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: OtherReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of receivable classified as other and noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Other Tax Carryforward, Deferred Tax Asset (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, No Previous Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held for which no OTTI was previously recognized.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Shares, Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of shares outstanding as of the date of the statement of financial position in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Exchanges and Conversions
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to exchanges and conversions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Option Exercise
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to option exercise. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units
unclassified.description: Monetary value of the issuance of new units of limited partnership interest in a public offering.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Treasury Units, Purchased
unclassified.description: Value of units that were previously issued and have been repurchased during the year.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital, Distribution Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: The distribution amount per share for all classes of units.

unclassified.label: Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
Payments for Deposits with Other Institutions
unclassified.description: Cash paid to make deposits at other institutions during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Environmental Liabilities
unclassified.description: Cash outflows made during the period for environmental remediation activities.

unclassified.label: Payments for Origination and Purchases of Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

unclassified.label: PaymentsForPurchaseOfInvestmentOperatingActivity
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for acquisition of investment, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, funding, origination, drawdown, and participation in investment.

unclassified.label: Payments for Reinsurance
unclassified.description: Cash payments made for reinsurance during the current period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
unclassified.description: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the purchase of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Royalty Interests in Mining Properties
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the purchase of royalty interests in mining properties is the amount of cash the mineral producer pays the owner of the mine or mineral resource.

unclassified.label: Payments to Purchase Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Demand
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets, Other, Not Separately Reported on Statement of Financial Position
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Finance Receivables Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Loans Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Policyholder Dividends, Rate on Policy Earnings
unclassified.description: The percentage of earnings allocable to participating policyholders based on earnings of such policies for payment of dividends.

unclassified.label: Postconfirmation, Prepaid and Other Current Assets
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Shares Authorized (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Convertible, Conversion Price, Increase
unclassified.description: Per share increase in conversion price of convertible preferred stock. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Redemption Amount, Future Redeemable Securities
unclassified.description: The redemption (or callable) amount of redeemable preferred stock, excluding currently redeemable preferred stock. Includes amounts representing dividends not declared or paid but which will be payable under the redemption features or for which ultimate payment is solely within the control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on premium receivable from recovery.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Insurance Premiums Collected
unclassified.description: Cash received as payments for insurance premiums during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of First Mortgage Bond
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from a long-term debt instrument secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of an equity security that embodies an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the security by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Repayments and Calls of Debt Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Mortgage Deposits
unclassified.description: Cash inflow received in association with a commitment to issue a mortgage.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
unclassified.description: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes long-term debt and short-term debt.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Lease Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

unclassified.label: Program Rights Obligations
unclassified.description: Total amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements.

unclassified.label: Program Rights Obligations, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations related to rights to programming, including, but not limited to, feature films and episodic series, acquired under license agreements that will be paid within the next twelve months.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Additions
unclassified.description: Total increase in earnings in the period representing the cost of equity (based on assumed rate of return) and/or borrowed funds (based on interest rate) used to finance construction of regulated assets, which is expected to be recovered through rate adjustments.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Debt Capital Structure, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved debt to capital, including debt and equity.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
unclassified.description: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Vehicles
unclassified.description: Period end book value of vehicles owned by the public utility.

unclassified.label: Ratio of Indebtedness to Net Capital
unclassified.description: Indebtedness divided by net capital.

unclassified.label: Real Estate and Accumulated Depreciation, Carrying Amount of Land and Buildings and Improvements (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: For each period for which an income statement is required, disclosure of the changes in the allowance, including balances at end of period.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Tax Expense
unclassified.description: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

unclassified.label: Realized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities and Cost Method Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments, and Other Investments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Nonfinancial Assets Pledged as Security, Value
unclassified.description: The value of assets other than financial instruments pledged to provide security to a suppler under a recorded unconditional purchase obligation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for common shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

unclassified.label: Reduction of Short-term Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing recorded for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities within one year or the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

unclassified.label: Regulated Entity, Other Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Total of noncurrent other assets held by public utility entities.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Exploration and Production
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated exploration and production operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulatory Liability, Current
unclassified.description: The amount for the individual regulatory current liability as itemized in a table of regulatory current liabilities as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Retention Policy, Excess Retention, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurer in excess of risk undertaken originally by insurer that is not ceded to reinsurer.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Due from (to) Related Party, Noncurrent
Rental Properties
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of income producing properties held for rental.

unclassified.label: Reorganization Value, Net Realizable Value of Asset Dispositions
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization value related to estimated net realizable value of asset dispositions. Reorganization value is the amount attributed to the reconstituted entity, as well as the expected net realizable value of those assets that will be disposed before reconstitution occurs.

unclassified.label: Repayments of First Mortgage Bond
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument issued, secured by a first mortgage deed of trust, containing a pledge of real property. The lender has the highest claim on the property in case of default.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Zero or Negative Carrying Amount, Amount of Allocated Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of goodwill allocated to reporting unit with zero or negative amount of net assets.

unclassified.label: Repurchase Agreement Counterparty, Amount at Risk
unclassified.description: The amount at risk under repurchase agreements is defined as the excess of carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount or if there is no carrying amount) of the securities or other assets sold under agreement to repurchase, including accrued interest plus any cash or other assets on deposit to secure the repurchase obligation, over the amount of the repurchase liability (adjusted for accrued interest).

unclassified.label: Repurchase Agreements, Interest Expense Amount
unclassified.description: This is the amount of interest expense incurred during the reporting period as a result of repurchase agreements.

unclassified.label: Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Restatement of Prior Year Income, Gross (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures, Dividends
unclassified.description: The value of dividends forfeited related to restricted stock awards forfeited.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Revenue, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue in oil- and gas-producing activities, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Retail Land Sales Receivables, Stated Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage of stated interest rate for receivables from retail land sales.

unclassified.label: Retained Interest, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of interest continued to be held by a transferor after transferring financial assets to a third party.

unclassified.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Excluding Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding interest income, of revenue not accounted for under Topic 606.

unclassified.label: Revenues and Gains, Reporting Currency Denominated, Value
unclassified.description: The reporting currency-denominated revenue (including gains) amount.

unclassified.label: Revenues, Excluding Interest and Dividends
unclassified.description: Revenues from operations, excluding interest and dividend income. Includes revenues from the following sources: investment banking (underwriting and financial advisory), principal transactions (sales and trading, and investment gains and losses), commissions, asset management, and investment advisory and other services.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Annual Rental Payments
unclassified.description: The yearly payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Transaction Costs, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for transaction costs in a sale-leaseback recognized in financing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, closing and debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Profit (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of profit (loss) for sales-type lease and (loss) for direct financing lease recognized at commencement.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Secured Demand Notes
unclassified.description: Represents the carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of loans made to broker-dealers which are generally secured by marketable securities owned by the borrower broker-dealer but held by the lender, are interest-bearing, and payable upon demand. The right to demand payment may be conditioned upon the occurrence of certain events.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Includes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities pledged as collateral against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale, Gain (Loss) on Sale
unclassified.description: Reflects, by transferred financial asset type, the amount of sales proceeds in excess of or deficient from the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs, including those transactions in which the seller/transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

unclassified.label: Continuing Involvement with Continued to be Recognized Transferred Financial Assets, Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction that continue to be recognized in the statement of financial position. Includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Additions
unclassified.description: The value of new servicing assets, subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through purchases or from transfers of financial assets.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Additions
unclassified.description: The value of new servicing liabilities, that are subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through assumptions of servicing obligations and servicing obligations that result from transfers of financial assets.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Increase (decrease) in the number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Shares Approved for Issuance
unclassified.description: The maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) that have been approved for issuance in the equity-based payment transaction.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Excess of Liabilities over Assets
unclassified.description: The value of the excess of liabilities over assets. If all outstanding shares are subject to mandatory redemption and the redemption price is more than the book value (the redemption price exceeds the company's equity balance), the resulting cumulative transition adjustment and subsequent adjustments to reflect changes in the redemption price of the shares are recorded as an excess of liabilities over assets.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Maximum Number of Shares
unclassified.description: The maximum number of shares that the issuer could be required to issue to redeem the instrument, if applicable.

unclassified.label: Standardized Measure of Discounted Future Net Cash Flow Relating to Proved Oil and Gas Reserves, Accretion of Discount
Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Net Income Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of net income for the period determined using accounting principles prescribed or permitted by insurance regulators.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the shareholders to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

unclassified.label: Stock Option, Down Round Feature, (Increase) Decrease in Equity, Amount
Stock Repurchase Program, Period in Force (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent, Not Allowable for Net Capital (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Subordinated Liabilities, Additions
unclassified.description: New liabilities assumed during the reporting period that are subordinated to claims of general creditors.

unclassified.label: Subordinated Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of collateralized/uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind the primary lender of the company.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Number of Shares Issued for All Transactions
unclassified.description: Cumulative number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee on all stock transactions.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-15, Insurance Companies, Summary of Investments, Other than Investments in Related Parties, Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of investment held by insurance company, excluding investment in related party.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Liability for benefits due terminated employees.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Salary Continuation
unclassified.description: Liability for agreement to continue an employee's salary after termination of employment (but before retirement) including death, disability, or other event. For example, a company may agree to continue a disabled employee's salary for six months.

unclassified.label: Supplies and Postage Expense
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Gross, Unrealized Appreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase in investment from unrealized gain when value exceeds cost for federal income tax purpose.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Gross, Unrealized Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative decrease in investment from unrealized loss when cost for federal income tax purpose exceeds value.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Decrease in Deferred Tax Liability due to Transition Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Interest in Subsidiary Earnings
unclassified.description: Subsidiary earnings portion attributable to temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Termination Loans
unclassified.description: Definite liabilities to third parties under a termination loan agreement, whether or not guaranteed in whole or in part by the government.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Trading Liabilities
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date that pertain to principal and customer trading transactions, or which may be incurred with the objective of generating a profit from short-term fluctuations in price as part of an entity's market-making, hedging and proprietary trading. Examples include short positions in securities, derivatives and commodities, obligations under repurchase agreements, and securities borrowed arrangements.

unclassified.label: Trading Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liabilities pertaining to principal and customer trading transactions, or which may be incurred with the objective of generating a profit from short-term fluctuations in price as part of an entity's market-making, hedging and proprietary trading. Examples include, but are not limited to, short positions in securities, derivatives and commodities.

unclassified.label: Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Fair Value of Derecognized Assets
unclassified.description: Fair value of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

unclassified.label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Assets, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

unclassified.label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Associated Liabilities, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of liabilities associated with financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the cumulative translation adjustment from gain (loss), after tax, on foreign currency derivatives, that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Loss (Gain), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Trustee Fees
unclassified.description: Fees charged annually for the professional services of a trustee, usually quoted as a percentage of the funds being managed. The fee for appointing an offshore Trustee is included in the trust price.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Discounts on Acceptances Executed
unclassified.description: The amount of the unearned (fee) income on the financial institution's issuance of short-term negotiable time drafts (also known as Banker's Acceptances).

unclassified.label: Unamortized Loss Reacquired Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Unamortized Loss on Reacquired Debt is the loss incurred upon reacquisition or refinancing of debt, is treated as a deferred charge and amortized over the life of the new debt issued.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from continuing operations allocated to common stock as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Gain, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Tax Effect
unclassified.description: Amount of tax related to an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense for depreciation and amortization of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Maintenance, Operations, and Other Costs and Expenses
unclassified.description: The amount of operating expenses for the period that are associated with the utility's normal revenue producing operation; including selling, general, and administrative expenses, costs incurred for routine plant repairs and maintenance, and operations.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other operating expense of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Deductions for Aggregate Write-Downs
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from write-downs charged against the allowance.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Income or Loss before Tax
unclassified.description: Description of the amount of pre-tax income (loss) derived by the reporting entity from the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Operating Income or Loss
unclassified.description: The amount of income (loss) from operations derived by the reporting entity during the period from the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Current (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Assets and Liabilities, Net (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Primary Beneficiary, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of maximum exposure to loss from involvement with consolidated variable interest entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Variable Lease, Income
unclassified.description: Amount of variable lease payments from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Warehouse Agreement Borrowings
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the outstanding short-term borrowings under a revolving line of credit used by mortgage bankers to finance the origination or purchase of loans.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Interest Rate on Overdrawn Demand Deposit
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on overdrawn demand deposit.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Limited Partnership and General Partnership Units Outstanding, Basic
unclassified.description: Weighted average number of limited partnership and general partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that limited partnership and general partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Includes, for example, the number of units distributed to unit holders whereby unit holders have the ability to elect to receive the unit holders' entire distribution in cash or units of equivalent value or there is a potential limitation on the total amount of cash that all unit holders can elect to receive in aggregate.

unclassified.label: Extensions, Discoveries, Additions and Improved Recovery, Less Related Costs
SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Principal Amount of Delinquent Loans
Accounts Payable, Interest-bearing, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable to vendors that bear interest at either a stated or an imputed rate. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Underwriters, Promoters, and Employees
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to underwriters, promoters, and employees excluding salaries, wages and amount to related party.

unclassified.label: AccountsReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of accounts receivable classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, Accrued Interest, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on accounts receivable classified as noncurrent recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, Nonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amount of accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent, on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Accretion Expense, Including Asset Retirement Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount of accretion expense, which includes, but is not limited to, accretion expense from asset retirement obligations, environmental remediation obligations, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Component Amount
unclassified.description: Recorded amount of the accrual for a material component of an environmental loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the accrual for environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Revision in Estimates
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the accrual for environmental loss contingencies from revisions in estimates to existing obligations. Excludes changes related to business acquisitions, divestitures, or currency movement.

unclassified.label: Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Payments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Accrual for Environmental Loss Contingencies, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to settle environmental loss contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrued Reclamation Costs, Current
unclassified.description: Current portion of reclamation reserve to restore a mining or drilling site to the condition agreed upon within the mining or drilling contract.

unclassified.label: Accrued Utilities
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for utilities, such as electrical power, heating oil, natural gas, and water.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Reclassifications of Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Accumulated Distributions in Excess of Net Income
unclassified.description: The amount as of the balance sheet date by which cumulative distributions to shareholders (or partners) exceed retained earnings (or accumulated earnings).

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Other than Temporary Impairment, Not Credit Loss, Net of Tax, Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Total of accumulated other comprehensive loss related to that portion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) due to factors other than credit losses on debt securities categorized either as available-for-sale or held-to-maturity that an entity does not intend to sell and which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis of the debt security. The amount represented by this item is net of tax, as applicable.

unclassified.label: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceBenefitPayment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder related to benefit payment for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Current Weighted-Average Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Current weighted-average discount rate used to measure present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceIssuance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment from contract issuance. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Original Discount Rate, before Cash Flow and Reinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment, discounted at original rate. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceReinsuranceRecoverableAfterAllowance
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, recoverable under reinsurance for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: Additions to Contract Holders Funds
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a segregated fund account during the period.

unclassified.label: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Gross of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

unclassified.label: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Shares, Requisite Service Period Recognition (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Adjustments to Reconcile Income (Loss) to Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Adjustments to Reconcile to Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
AdministrativeFeePayable
unclassified.description: Amount of fee payable for administrative service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, and overhead costs.

unclassified.label: Advance Royalties, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The amount paid to music publishers, record producers, songwriters, or other artists in advance of their earning royalties from record or music sales. Such an amount is based on contractual terms and is generally nonrefundable. This amount is expected to be consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Advances for Gas Exploration, Development and Production Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of advance for exploration, development, and production in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Agricultural Related Inventory
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of merchandise or supplies held which are related to plants and animals.

unclassified.label: Airline, Capacity Purchase Arrangements
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for air service provided by third-party transportation company, including, but not limited to, regional airline affiliate.

unclassified.label: Airline Related Inventory, Aircraft Parts, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, of plant or equipment components to be used for the primary purpose of air transportation.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Cash inflow due to change during the period in the allowance for other funds used during construction classified as an investing activity.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Loans Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of addition to allowance reserve for credit loss arising from purchase of loan and lease portfolios.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Allowance for Uncollectible Customer's Liability for Acceptances
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Property Taxes
unclassified.description: The amount of amortization charged against earnings during the period for deferred property taxes.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: ArtistAdvancesCommitmentsAmount
unclassified.description: The amount the entity has committed to make for future artist advances.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionPriceOfAcquisitionExpected
unclassified.description: Purchase price of expected asset acquisition prior to consideration being transferred. Excludes business acquisition.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Assets Designated to Closed Block, Deferred Tax Asset, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset pertaining to the closed block.

unclassified.label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Equity Securities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of equity securities allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block.

unclassified.label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Equity Securities, Available-for-sale, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of equity securities designated as available for sale, which are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

unclassified.label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Other Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of other long-term investments held by the closed block.

unclassified.label: Assets Needed for Immediate Settlement, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of assets needed to immediately settle the derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Repurchase Liability
unclassified.description: Amount, including accrued interest, to be repaid to counterparty to repurchase agreement when carrying amount or market value if higher, of security or other asset sold under repurchase agreement exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

unclassified.label: Assumed Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: Liability as of the balance sheet date for the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims and claim adjustment expense relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date for those liabilities owed to another party as a result of assuming another insurer's primary obligation.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Dividend, Cumulative Undistributed (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Auction Market Preferred Securities, Shares Outstanding
unclassified.description: Number of auction market preferred securities shares outstanding.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: The number of shares of a preferred security the entity has authorized through an auction process.

unclassified.label: AuctionMarketPreferredSecuritiesStockSharesOutstandingPeriodIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in the number of Auction Market Preferred Securities during the period being reported.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Transfers to Trading, Gains (Losses)
Available-for-sale Securities, Transfers to Trading, Gross Losses
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Other, Default Rate
unclassified.description: This item represents the default rate of the underlying assets in the security that were considered as one of the potential factors in reaching a conclusion that the available-for-sale investments are not other-than-temporarily impaired.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Other, Third Party Guarantees, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of third party guarantees against loss of value in the underlying assets related to available-for-sale security in an unrealized loss position and for which other-than-temporary impairments (OTTI) have not been recognized.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive (available-for-sale) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) previously recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Bad Debt Reserve, Tax Purpose of Qualified Lender
unclassified.description: Amount of bad debt reserves for tax purposes of qualified lenders excluded in calculating deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Bank Owned Life Insurance Income
unclassified.description: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Maximum Leverage Payout Ratio
unclassified.description: Maximum percentage of eligible retained income that can be paid out in distribution and discretionary bonus payment by global systemically important bank (GSIB) as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Bankruptcy Claims, Number Claims Filed
unclassified.description: The aggregate number of claims filed with the bankruptcy court.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Net
