unclassified.description: Amount after amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Billings in Excess of Cost, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Liability attributable to (i) billings in excess of costs under the percentage of completion contract accounting method representing the difference between contractually invoiced amounts (billings) and revenue recognized based, for example, on costs incurred to estimated total costs at period end or (ii) contractually invoiced amounts (billings) in excess of costs incurred and accumulated under the completed contract accounting method that are expected to be realized more than one year or one operating cycle, whichever is longer, from the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Contingent Consideration, Shares Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Planned Restructuring Activities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Preexisting Relationship, Gain (Loss) Recognized (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Capital Lease Obligation Accrual (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Liabilities, Restructuring Cost Accrual (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Projected Benefit Obligation (Asset) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Assets and Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized, Other than at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of liability in excess of (less than) asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Assets Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Assets Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized, Other than at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Including Equity Interest in Acquiree Held Prior to Combination (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
BusinessCombinationOrJointVentureFormationValuationAllowanceDeferredTaxAssetEffectOnGoodwillIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation allowance for deferred tax asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation, or both, and reported as adjustment to goodwill. Excludes change in valuation allowance outside of measurement period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Equity Interests
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to equity interests acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets, Current
Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Including Subsequent Acquisition, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of voting equity interests acquired in a business combination achieved in stages, including equity interests in the acquiree held by the acquirer immediately before the acquisition date and acquired at the acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leased Assets, Number of Units
unclassified.description: The number of units (items of property) under capital lease arrangements.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Contingent Rental Payments Received
unclassified.description: For sales-type and direct financing leases, total contingent rentals received during the period.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Capital Leases, Indemnification Agreements, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of payments made under the terms of an indemnification agreement contained in a lease.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Building (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Machinery and Equipment (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases, Current
unclassified.description: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessor Balance Sheet, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Current
unclassified.description: The net amount due within one year of the balance sheet date or the normal operating cycle, if longer, consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs, less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases
unclassified.description: The net investment in direct financing leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Initial Direct Costs
unclassified.description: Remaining unamortized costs as of the balance sheet date that were essential to acquiring the lease, and that would not otherwise have been incurred without the lease agreement, including evaluating the lessee's credit condition, guarantees, and collateral and costs incurred negotiating, processing, and closing the lease agreement.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Unguaranteed Residual Values of Leased Property
unclassified.description: The estimate of the lease property's economic value at the end of the sales-type lease term excluding any amounts guaranteed by either the lessee or a third-party.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum total risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum total risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseRemainderOfFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: CapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearFour
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion, Amortization and Valuation Allowance Relating to Oil and Gas Producing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance for capitalized cost in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Asset Retirement Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for asset retirement in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs of Unproved Properties Excluded from Amortization, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs and capitalized interest incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Proved Properties
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for proved property in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Uncompleted Wells, Equipment and Facilities
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for uncompleted well, equipment, and facility in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, cost incurred to drill and equip well not yet completed and cost incurred to acquire or construct equipment and facility not yet completed and installed.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Wells and Related Equipment and Facilities
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for well and related equipment and facility in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, cost incurred to drill and equip exploratory well and exploratory-type stratigraphic test well that has found proved reserve and cost incurred to obtain access to proved reserve and provide facility for extracting, treating, gathering, and storing oil and gas, including the drilling and equipping of development well, development-type stratigraphic test well, and service well.

unclassified.label: Carrying Value of Federal Funds Purchased, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, and Deposits Received for Securities Loaned
unclassified.description: Carrying value of federal funds purchased and securities sold under repurchase agreements and deposits received for securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Other Expense, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Gain Reclassified to Earnings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations, Financing Activities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Available-for-sale Debt Securities, Outstanding Balance
unclassified.description: The undiscounted sum of all amounts, including amounts deemed principal, interest, fees, penalties, and other under the loan, owed to the investor at the reporting date, whether or not currently due and whether or not any such amounts have been written or charged off by the investor. This relates to loans accounted for as available-for-sale debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Outstanding Balance
unclassified.description: The undiscounted sum of all amounts, including amounts deemed principal, interest, fees, penalties, and other under the loan, owed to the investor at the reporting date, whether or not currently due and whether or not any such amounts have been written or charged off by the investor. This relates to loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: ChangeInReportingEntityEarningsPerShareBasic
unclassified.description: Per share effect on income (loss) after tax available to each common stock or unit outstanding from change in reporting entity.

unclassified.label: ChangeInReportingEntityEarningsPerShareDiluted
unclassified.description: Per share effect on income (loss) after tax available to each common stock or unit outstanding and each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming issuance of common share or unit for dilutive potential common share or unit outstanding, from change in reporting entity.

unclassified.label: ChangeInReportingEntityIncomeLossAfterTaxAttributableToParent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of effect on income (loss) attributable to parent from change in reporting entity.

unclassified.label: ChangeInReportingEntityOtherComprehensiveIncomeLossAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of effect on other comprehensive income (loss) from change in reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of the increase (decrease) in fair value of the hedged item in a foreign currency fair value hedge which was recognized in earnings, net of offsets by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge was determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Closed Block Operations, Net Results
unclassified.description: Amount of net income (loss) from operations of the closed block.

unclassified.label: CommercialPaperAverageOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Commodity Contract Asset, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from commodity contracts such as futures contracts tied to the movement of a particular commodity, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Additional Series, No Par Value (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Common Stock, Additional Series, Par or Stated Value Per Share (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Common Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Concentration Risk, Net Assets Amount, Geographic Area
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of total assets less total liabilities of a designated geographic area if disclosed as a concentration risk.

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Contract Receivable Retainage, after Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract to be collected after the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Contract Receivable Retainage, Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Contract Receivable Retainage, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract to be collected in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Contract Termination Claims, US Federal Government
unclassified.description: Amount included in accounts receivable for long-term contracts and programs associated with governmental contracts at the balance sheet date representing amounts deemed to be reimbursable items under a terminated United States government contract or subcontract and included in a claim with the United States government, including those associated with terminated war and defense contracts.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Not Past Due
Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Right to Recover Product, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of right to recover product from customer on settling refund liability, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts
unclassified.description: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts.

unclassified.label: Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts, Expected to be Collected in Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts that are expected to be collected in the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Contributions in Aid of Construction
unclassified.description: Developers, builders, governmental agencies and municipalities will provide the entity with cash, or in some cases property, to extend its services to their properties. Nonrefundable contributions are recorded as contributions in aid of construction ("CIAC").

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Cooperative Advertising Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense under a cooperative advertising arrangement.

unclassified.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Direct Financing Lease
unclassified.description: Cost of goods sold for direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Cost of Services, Catering
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for food and beverage served to airline passenger.

unclassified.label: Cost-method Investments, Realized Losses, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
Costs Incurred, Oil and Gas Property Acquisition, Exploration, and Development Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of property acquisition, exploration, and development costs incurred in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes capitalized cost and cost charged to expense.

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Liquidation Proceeds, Monetary Amount
unclassified.description: Estimated amount to which the maximum potential amount of future payments under the credit derivative would be covered by the proceeds from liquidation of assets held either as collateral or by third parties.

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
unclassified.description: Maximum potential amount of future undiscounted payments that could be required under the credit derivative, before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

unclassified.label: Credit Risk Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset after deduction of credit risk derivative liability.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetCostRestricted
unclassified.description: Cost of crypto asset subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetFairValueUnrestricted
unclassified.description: Fair value of crypto asset not subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetNumberOfRestrictedUnits
unclassified.description: Number of crypto asset units held subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes crypto asset units held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossOperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedGainLossOperatingAndNonoperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as operating and nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: CryptoAssetRealizedGainNonoperating
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain from remeasurement of crypto asset, classified as nonoperating. Excludes crypto asset held for platform user.

unclassified.label: Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Tabular Presentation by Financial Statement Line Item, Adjustment Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of FAS 158 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of FAS 159 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Customer Advances for Construction
unclassified.description: For utilities only, represents the carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date for payments received by a utility from its customers in advance of performing its obligations under terms of its construction agreements.

unclassified.label: Customer Advances or Deposits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate noncurrent portion of prepayments received from customers for goods or services to be provided in the future, as well as the current portion of money or property received from customers that is to be returned upon satisfactory contract completion or as partial prepayment for goods or services to be provided in the future.

unclassified.label: Customer Refundable Fees
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of proceeds that had been received in revenue related transactions that are refundable to the customers and do not meet the criteria for revenue recognition (for example, refundable membership fees).

unclassified.label: Customer Refundable Fees, Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from customers for revenue related transactions that are refundable to the customers and do not meet the criteria for revenue recognition.

unclassified.label: Customer Refundable Fees, Refund Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to customers for refund payments.

unclassified.label: Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Fair Value of Securities Sold or Repledged
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it has sold or re-pledged to counterparties as collateral.

unclassified.label: Customer's Liability for Acceptances, Net
unclassified.description: The aggregate of all customer's outstanding debt to the institution that resulted from short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as banker's acceptance transactions), net of allowance for uncollectible customer's liability for acceptances.

unclassified.label: DebtAndEquitySecuritiesAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeUnrealizedGainLossOperatingBeforeTax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities and foreign currency transaction on investment in debt and equity securities from change in market price, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from investment in debt and equity securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income, and recognized from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure debt instrument, including, but not limited to, convertible and non-convertible debt.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of debt premium to be amortized within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt of Subsidiary, Not Assumed
unclassified.description: Debt of a subsidiary that has not been assumed or guaranteed by the entity and any liens on premises of a subsidiary, or its consolidated subsidiaries, which have not been assumed by the entity, or its consolidated subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Sell before Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from intent to sell or more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossNotToSellBeforeRecoveryCreditLossPreviouslyRecordedExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with previously recorded allowance and not intended to be sold and not more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossPeriodIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Purchase Price
unclassified.description: Amount at purchase price of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Loss, Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accrued Interest, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateYearOne
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Derivative, Cumulative Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestSale
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of decrease in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from sale.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) transferred to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer to Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred into available-for-sale out of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityWeightedAverageYield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Amount Arranged
unclassified.description: Amount debtor-in-possession financing arranged (but not necessarily all borrowed).

unclassified.label: Debtor-in-Possession Financing, Letters of Credit Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount of letters of credit outstanding under debtor-in-possession financing arrangement.

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Debtor Reorganization Items, Net Gain (Loss) on Rejection of Leases and Other Executory Contracts
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on rejection of leases and other executory contracts, reported as a reorganization item.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Accumulated Amortization Expense, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the accumulated amortization of deferred issuance costs associated with an own-share lending arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Fuel Cost
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized fuel costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the unamortized adjustment to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item made under an effective interest rate fair value hedge that is amortized upon discontinuation of the interest rate fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Amortization Expense, Effect of Adjustments to Estimated Gross Profit or Estimated Gross Margin
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) of deferred policy acquisition costs from a revision in estimated gross profit or estimated gross margin.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Amortization Expense, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) to amortization expense of deferred policy acquisition cost (DAC).

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment and Other
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost due to the effect of foreign currency translation gain (loss) and increase (decrease) classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Disposition
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition costs disposed or classified as held-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for deferred policy acquisition costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Purchased Power Costs
unclassified.description: Costs of power used for operations in prior periods that were expected to be recovered from customers in future periods.

unclassified.label: Deferred Lease Income, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred lease income, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

unclassified.label: Deferred Sale Inducement Cost, Capitalization
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred sale inducement cost capitalized.

unclassified.label: Deferred Sales Inducement Cost, Other Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred sales inducement cost, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Set-up Costs, Current
unclassified.description: Deferred incremental direct costs incurred typically at a contract's inception so that the company may be in a position to fulfill all contractual obligations of an arrangement. The costs are directly related to specified activities under the arrangement and are deferred in order to match revenue that will be recognized within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Unearned Premiums Reserve
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the unearned premiums reserve.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Interests in Financial Assets Continued to be Held
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from interests in financial instruments continued to be held after sale or transfer of related financial instruments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from regulatory assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance for deferred tax asset related to goodwill acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

unclassified.label: Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance for deferred tax asset related to goodwill and intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assets for Plan Benefits (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, before Adoption of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions, Accrued Benefit Liability (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Cost of Providing Special or Contractual Termination Benefits Recognized During Period (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Four (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Two (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in net periodic benefit cost from effect of change in substantive term of existing defined benefit plan or initiation of new defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt
unclassified.description: Amount of receipt from prescription drug subsidy which increases plan assets of defined benefit postretirement plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations Range Maximum (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred into (out of) Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan, for assets transferred into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy. Includes, but is not limited to, transfer due to change in observability of significant inputs.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Increase (Decrease), Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cost for defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Number of Employees
unclassified.description: Number of employees eligible to participate in defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Demutualization by Insurance Entity, Securities Issued, Price Per Share or Unit
unclassified.description: The share or unit price of securities issued in an insurance entity stock offering in connection with its conversion from a mutual form of ownership to a stock entity.

unclassified.label: Depletion of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: The noncash expense charged against earnings to recognize the consumption of oil and gas reserves that are part of an entities' assets.

unclassified.label: Deposit Assets, Present Value of Expected Recoveries
unclassified.description: Present value of initial expected recoveries that will be reimbursed under the insurance or reinsurance contracts.

unclassified.label: DepositLiabilitiesOtherAverageRatePaid
unclassified.description: Average rate paid on deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: DepositSecuritySoldShort
unclassified.description: Amount of deposit for security sold short.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Foreign
unclassified.description: The aggregate of all foreign interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deposits Received for Securities Loaned, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash received as collateral for security loaned to another party.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Retail
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of all retail deposit accounts including demand accounts, savings accounts, and certificates of deposit.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAndForeignCurrencyTransactionPriceChangeRealizedGainLossOperatingBeforeTax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of realized gain (loss) on derivative and foreign currency transaction on derivative from change in market price, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Number of Instruments Held
unclassified.description: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative asset or group of derivative assets held by the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Includes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability associated with derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed, offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellSecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Cap Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average cap rate on a group of interest rate derivatives, such as interest rate caps or collars. If market rates exceed the cap rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Cap Price
unclassified.description: The average cap rate on a group of price risk derivatives such as caps or collars. A payment or receipt is triggered if the market rate exceeds the cap rate on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Exchange Rate Floor
unclassified.description: Average floor rate on a group of foreign currency derivatives for example, but not limited to, floors or collars.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Floor Price
unclassified.description: The average floor rate on a group of price risk derivatives such as floors or collars. A payment or receipt is triggered if the market rate falls below the floor rate on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Price Risk Option Strike Price
unclassified.description: The average strike price on the group of price risk option contracts such as put options or call options.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Swaption Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average fixed interest rate that will be received or paid upon exercise of a group of interest rate swaption contracts.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Exchange Rate Cap
unclassified.description: Cap rate on a foreign currency derivative for example, but not limited to, a cap or a collar.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral, Net
unclassified.description: The net amount as of the balance sheet date of the fair value of derivative assets and derivative liabilities that in accordance with the entity's accounting policy were offset against collateral under a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Higher Range of Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Derivative Instruments, Gain Recognized in Income, Ineffective Portion and Amount Excluded from Effectiveness Testing
unclassified.description: The portion of gains on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments representing (a) the amount of the hedge ineffectiveness and (b) the amount, if any, excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Number of Instruments Held
unclassified.description: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative liability or group of derivative liabilities held by the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Includes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of asset associated with derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Lower Range of Basis Spread on Variable Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal number of units used to calculate payment on derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount, Energy Measure
unclassified.description: Nominal energy measure used to calculate payments on a derivative instrument.

unclassified.label: DerivativePremiumPaid
unclassified.description: Amount of premium paid on derivative.

unclassified.label: DerivativeUnderlyingInvestmentPrincipal
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of underlying investment in derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings from the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Development Costs, Cumulative
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized development cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project in oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes acquisition and exploration costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Development Profits, Nonoperating
unclassified.description: Income recognized during the period from participation in unconsolidated joint ventures engaged in real estate development (such as the building upon or otherwise improving property).

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Deferred Selling Profit
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred selling profit from direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in direct financing lease, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of direct financing lease revenue.

unclassified.label: Direct Operating Communications Costs
unclassified.description: Communications costs incurred and are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Direct Operating Maintenance Supplies Costs
unclassified.description: Costs of maintenance supplies used that are directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: DisaggregationOfIncomeStatementExpenseCaptionReimbursementFromAnotherEntityAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of expense reimbursement, included in statement of income expense caption being disaggregated, from another entity related to cost-sharing or cost-reimbursement arrangement.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Application of Specialized Accounting for Regulated Operations
unclassified.description: Net effect of discontinued application of the specialized accounting to all or part of its operations; the entity eliminates from its statement of financial position prepared for general-purpose external financial reporting the effects of any actions of regulators that had been recognized as assets and liabilities pursuant to that specialized accounting but would not have been recognized as assets and liabilities by entities in general except for carrying amounts of plant, equipment, and inventory measured and reported pursuant to that specialized accounting unless those assets are impaired, in which case the carrying amounts of those assets is reduced to reflect that impairment. This element is gross of the related tax effect.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Equity Method Investment Retained after Disposal, Ownership Interest after Disposal
unclassified.description: Percent, after disposal, of ownership interest of a discontinued operation in which an equity method investment is retained.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Discontinued Operation, Intra-Entity Amounts, Discontinued Operation after Disposal, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense in continuing operations related to continuing involvement in a discontinued operation after the disposal that before the disposal was eliminated as intra-entity transactions.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Intra-Entity Amounts, Discontinued Operation after Disposal, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue in continuing operations related to continuing involvement in a discontinued operation after disposal that before the disposal was eliminated as intra-entity transactions.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Adjustment to Prior Period Gain (Loss) on Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for an increase (decrease) to a gain (loss) previously reported in discontinued operations in a prior period.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Assets of Business Transferred under Contractual Arrangement (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Capital Leased Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as capital leased assets attributable to disposal group, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationDeferredPolicyAcquisitionCost
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Asset, Current
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Assets, Noncurrent
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Liabilities, Current
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Inventory, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as inventory attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Long Lived Assets, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationPremiumReceivableAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of premium receivable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationReinsuranceRecoverableIncludingReinsurancePremiumPaid
unclassified.description: Amount of reinsurance recoverable including reinsurance premium paid, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Declared, Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions declared to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Liability Company (LLC) Member, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited liability company (LLC).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of cash distribution paid to unit-holder of limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Limited Partner, Distributions Paid, Per Unit
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount of cash distributions paid to unit-holder of a limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Distribution Made to Member or Limited Partner, Cash Distributions Paid (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
DistributionPayable
unclassified.description: Amount of distribution payable to ownership interest holder from investment income and return of capital.

unclassified.label: DividendAndInterestReceivable
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend and interest receivable from investment.

unclassified.label: Dividend Payments Restrictions Schedule, Statutory Capital and Surplus
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory capital and surplus computed using prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practice that can be distributed to stockholder as dividend payment.

unclassified.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Paid-in-Kind
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Due from Correspondent Brokers
unclassified.description: Amount receivable from correspondent broker-dealer.

unclassified.label: Due from Officers or Stockholders, Noncurrent
Due to Correspondent Brokers
unclassified.description: Amount payable to correspondent broker-dealer.

unclassified.label: Earnest Money Deposits
unclassified.description: A deposit made by a purchaser of real estate to evidence good faith. It is customary for a buyer to give the seller earnest money at the time a sales contract is signed. The earnest money generally is credited to the down payment at closing, which is applied at closing as a component of payment against the purchase price.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Distributed
unclassified.description: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Distributed
unclassified.description: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security, taking into account all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

unclassified.label: Effect of Change in Cash Flow Projection Estimate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Discontinued Operations
Effect of LIFO Inventory Liquidation on Income
unclassified.description: The effect of liquidating LIFO (last in first out) inventory layers on income.

unclassified.label: Effect on Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Effect on Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Effect on Future Earnings and Cash Flows, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Embedded Derivative Liability, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure embedded derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares Expected to be Repurchased, Next Fiscal Period
unclassified.description: Number of shares to be repurchased in accordance with a policy to use treasury stock to satisfy share-award conversions.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Employer Cash Payments Used for Debt Service
unclassified.description: The amount of cash provided by the employer through contributions or dividends that the ESOP used in the period to repay debt and interest on a third-party loan made directly to the ESOP.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Dividends Paid to ESOP
unclassified.description: Dividends paid on stock held by an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
unclassified.description: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

unclassified.label: Energy Marketing Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for energy purchases, typically by a utility or an entity engaged in selling energy contracts.

unclassified.label: Energy Marketing Contract Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Current liabilities attributable to energy marketing activities (trading activities). Current energy marketing (trading activities) are when entities engage in both financial and physical trading to increase profits, manage their commodity price risk and enhance system reliability. They may trade electricity, coal, natural gas and oil. These entities typically use a variety of financial instruments, including forward contracts, options and swaps.

unclassified.label: Energy Related Inventory, Coal
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of coal, which is a combustible rock or minerals which are extracted from the ground and used as fuel.

unclassified.label: Entertainment, License Agreement for Program Material, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for right acquired by broadcaster under license agreement for program material.

unclassified.label: Environmental Costs Recognized, Capitalized
unclassified.description: Amount of costs recognized in the balance sheet for known or estimated future costs arising from requirements to perform activities to remediate one or more sites.

unclassified.label: Environmental Exit Costs, Reasonably Possible Additional Loss
unclassified.description: Estimate of reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of amount accrued for remediation, site restoration, postclosure, monitoring commitments, or other exit costs associated with the sale, disposal or abandonment of a particular property resulting from unanticipated contamination of the assets.

unclassified.label: EnvironmentalRemediationExpenseAfterRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, after recovery, of expense for known and estimated future costs arising from requirement to perform environmental remediation.

unclassified.label: EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptionModificationDebtModificationIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as debt extinguishment or troubled debt restructuring related to debt modification. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Equity Issuance, Number of Equity Securities Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Equity Excluding Noncontrolling Interests (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Sales or Gross Revenue (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Redeemable Preferred Stock (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Unrealized Intercompany Profit (Loss) Not Eliminated, Amount (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Securities, FV-NI, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Restricted
unclassified.description: Amount of restricted investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Estimate of Cancellations
unclassified.description: Estimates of cancellations for refundable service fees, if accounted for by analogy to FASB Statement No. 48.

unclassified.label: Excess of Replacement or Current Costs over Stated LIFO Value
unclassified.description: The excess of replacement or current cost over the stated LIFO (last in first out) inventory value when the LIFO inventory method is utilized.

unclassified.label: Expenses and Losses, Reporting Currency Denominated, Value
unclassified.description: The reporting currency-denominated expense (including losses) amount.

unclassified.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Additions from Business Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in liability for extended product warranty acquired in business combination. Excludes liability for standard warranty acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount at end of the reporting period of the aggregate extended product warranty liability that is expected to be paid after one year from the balance sheet date or normal operating cycle, if longer. Does not include the balance for the standard product warranty liability.

unclassified.label: Extended Product Warranty Accrual, Increase for Warranties Issued
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the extended product warranty accrual from warranties issued. Excludes standard product warranties.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Earnings Per Share Impact, Net (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
FDIC Indemnification Asset, Disposals
unclassified.description: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to disposals relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

unclassified.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Change in carrying amount of the indemnification asset relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC). The change includes for example, but is not limited to, acquisitions, additional estimated losses, disposals, cash payments, accretion of discount and write-offs, net of recoveries.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Investment Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Equity Method Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Loans Receivable (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Fair value of account receivable subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Foreign Currency Contract, Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value of derivative asset for foreign currency contract subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Investment in Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Retained Interest
unclassified.description: Fair value of retained interest subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Estimate Not Practicable, Cost Method Investments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Estimate Not Practicable, Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Counterparty Credit Risk (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Entity Credit Risk (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Long-term Pre-tax Operating Margin, Percent (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Borrowings (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
