Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Investment Contracts (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings (Deprecated 2019-01-31)

Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Issuances (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Transfers Into Level 3 (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Transfers, Net (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Value of Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Option, Aggregate Differences, Loans and Long-term Receivables
unclassified.description: This item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of loans and long-term receivables (other than securities categorized as trading, available-for-sale or held-to-maturity) that have contractual principal amounts and for which the fair value option has been elected.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Loans Held as Assets, Aggregate Amount in Nonaccrual Status
unclassified.description: This item represents the aggregate fair value of loans held as assets that are in nonaccrual status for which the fair value option has been elected, if the entity's policy is to recognize interest income separately from other changes in fair value.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Recurring Basis, Unobservable Input Reconciliation, Asset (Liability), Gain (Loss), OCI
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Federal Funds Purchased
unclassified.description: Amount of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

unclassified.label: Federal Funds Purchased, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of interest applicable on advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Weighted Average Interest Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Discount
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized discount on outstanding advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Collateral Pledged
unclassified.description: Amount of the collateral pledged in support of federal home loan bank advances outstanding.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

unclassified.label: Fee Income on Acceptances Executed
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization to income from discounts on short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances).

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Credit and Debit Cards (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fees Paid on Acceptances Resold
unclassified.description: Represents the amortization to expense from discounts on short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances) which have been resold in the secondary market.

unclassified.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Accelerated Premium Revenue, Amount
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of premium revenue on financial guarantee insurance contracts recognized during the period that was accelerated for revenue recognition purposes.

unclassified.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premium Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of the premium receivable for financial guarantee insurance contracts reported in the statement of financial position. This element primarily would consist of those financial guarantee insurance contracts which premiums are to be collected over the contract period, but may, on occasion, include premiums which are to be collected in full at inception, but which straddle a financial reporting period.

unclassified.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premium Received over Contract Period, Premium Receivable, Weighted Average Risk Free Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average risk-free rate used to discount amount of premium expected to be collected for financial guarantee insurance contract where premium is to be received over contract period.

unclassified.label: Financial Guarantee Insurance Contracts, Premiums Receivable, Adjustment, Accretion of Discount on Premium Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of accretion of the discount for premiums receivable on financial guarantee insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: FinancialInstrumentMandatorilyRedeemableLiabilityClassifiedSettlementAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of settlement of mandatorily redeemable financial instrument classified as liability.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, State and Municipal Government Obligations, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in fixed income obligations issued by state and local governments and authorities. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Derivatives and Other Contracts
unclassified.description: Fair value of obligations arising from derivatives and other contracts sold short.

unclassified.label: Financial Instrument Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of mandatorily redeemable capital stock maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanSold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on collective basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on individual basis.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityYearOne
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoffAfterRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease (increase) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff (recovery). Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossFeeAndLoanInProcess
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestNonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable on nonaccrual status. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestPurchase
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of increase in financing receivable from purchase. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestTransferToHeldForSaleAllowanceForCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of reversal of credit loss expense on financing receivable transferred out of held-for-investment into held-for-sale classification. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated four years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated three years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated two years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest of financing receivable originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated in fiscal year before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Pre-Modification Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Premodification
unclassified.description: Amount, before troubled debt restructuring, of financing receivable to be modified.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModifiedPast12Months
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable 12 months after modification for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, No Allowance
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 1 to 29 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 60 to 89 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, Equal to Greater than 90 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
FinancingReceivableRevolvingWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in financing receivable from purchase. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Transfer to Held-for-Investment, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for allowance for credit loss on financing receivable transferred to held-for-investment classification.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForSaleValuationAllowanceExpense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for valuation allowance on financing receivable transferred to held-for-sale classification.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable originated four years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable originated three years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable originated two years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable originated in fiscal year before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivablesBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivables.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivables, Impaired, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Write-down
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount of the write-down related to a troubled debt restructuring.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal after Year Five (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Flight Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Flight Equipment, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Financial Institutions, Actual Deposits
unclassified.description: The amount of deposits held by branches of foreign institutions.

unclassified.label: Foreign Financial Institutions, Actual Reserve Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of reserves held by branches of foreign institutions.

unclassified.label: Foreign Financial Institutions, Mandated Deposits
unclassified.description: The amount of mandated deposits required of branches of foreign institutions.

unclassified.label: ForwardContractIndexedToEquitySettlementShareFairValue
unclassified.description: Fair value of shares that would be issued upon settlement of forward contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Forward Rate Per Share
unclassified.description: The per share price of the Company's stock at which the contract holder of the freestanding contract has the right to purchase or sell the Company's stock at a future date.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Indexed Shares
unclassified.description: The number of issuer's shares to which the forward contract is indexed.

unclassified.label: Forward Contract Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Settlement Alternatives, Shares, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Number of shares as a settlement alternative for each freestanding forward contract.

unclassified.label: Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Additional Paid-in Capital
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Cash and Cash Equivalents
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Assets, Noncurrent
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Noncurrent
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Liabilities and Stockholders' Equity
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Preferred and Common Stock Held in Treasury
Funds Held under Reinsurance Agreements, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of the reinsurer's funds held on its behalf by the ceding insurer, including funds held in trust, under reinsurance treaties or contracts with the assuming insurer as security for the payment of the obligations thereunder.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when interest rate cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on foreign currency fair value hedges.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
unclassified.description: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
unclassified.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of proven and unproven oil and gas properties.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Loans and Leases
unclassified.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of other loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period; excludes gains (losses) on sales of consumer and mortgage loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, before Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Proved Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property with proven oil and gas reserves.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Equity Investee
unclassified.description: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
unclassified.description: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

unclassified.label: General Fair Value Hedge Information, Dollar Offset Threshold, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
General Fair Value Hedge Information, Dollar Offset Threshold, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
General Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of general partner units outstanding.

unclassified.label: Good Faith and Margin Deposits with Broker-Dealers
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Adjustment to Initial Estimate Amount (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
GovernmentAssistanceAssetIncreaseCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in asset from government assistance, classified as current.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceExpense
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease (increase) in expense from government assistance.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDecreaseCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in liability from government assistance, classified as current.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityDecreaseNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in liability from government assistance, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceLiabilityIncrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in liability from government assistance.

unclassified.label: Gross Investment Income, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

unclassified.label: Ground Leases, Net
unclassified.description: Net long-term land leases which are capitalized as part of real property.

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Liquidation Proceeds, Monetary Amount
unclassified.description: Indicates, if estimable, the approximate extent to which the proceeds from liquidation of any assets held either as collateral or by third parties would be expected to cover the maximum potential amount of future payments under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

unclassified.label: Guaranteed Interest Contracts
unclassified.description: The amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date pertaining to the guarantee given by the insurance entity to contract holders of a specified rate of return (a guaranteed yield) on their investments for a specified period.

unclassified.label: Health Care Organization, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Percentage of Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Ratio of the allowance for doubtful accounts to accounts receivable, expressed as a percentage, for health care organizations.

unclassified.label: Health Care Organization, Patient Service Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Health Care Organization, Stop Loss Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: Amount of stop-loss insurance recoveries. In stop-loss insurance, prepaid health care providers or associated entities transfer portions of their financial risks to other companies. A provider typically contracts to recover health care costs in excess of stated amounts during the contract periods.

unclassified.label: Hedged Asset, Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of asset hedged in fair value hedging relationship.

unclassified.label: Hedged Asset, Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged asset in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Sold Security, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Transferred Security, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Transferred to Available-for-sale Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with interest rate reset through auction process, sold at par value.

unclassified.label: Hybrid Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of hybrid instruments.

unclassified.label: Impact of Restatement on Earnings Per Share, Basic (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Impaired Financing Receivable, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Average amount of investment of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income recognized that the financing receivables (with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses) were impaired.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Retained Interest
unclassified.description: The charge against earnings to reduce the carrying value of an interest continued to be held by the transferor in a securitized financial instrument.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) before Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Outstanding Limited Partnership and General Partnership Unit, Basic and Diluted
unclassified.description: The amount of income (loss) derived from discontinued operations during the period, net of related tax effect, per each basic and diluted limited partnership and general partnership unit when the per unit amount is the same for both basic and diluted units.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Individually Significant Component Disposed of or Held-for-sale, Excluding Discontinued Operations, Attributable to Parent, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from an individually significant component disposed of or held-for-sale attributable to parent. Excludes discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Ongoing Equity Method Investment in Discontinued Operation after Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of share in income (loss) of the equity method investee after the disposal of the discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) of Discontinued Operation, Equity Method Investment Retained after Disposal, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) of the investee in which an equity method investment is retained after disposal of discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest from Examination (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Income Tax Examination, Penalties from Examination (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Jobs Creation Act of 2004, Amount (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) Cash Collateral from Counterparties
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash held either as collateral directly or provided to third parties associated with derivative instruments. Upon the occurrence of any specified triggering event or condition associated with the derivative, these amounts can be utilized to recover all or a portion of the amounts due or payable under the derivative.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable from Securitization
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Loaned Securities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Coal Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of coal held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Gas Cost
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in carrying amount of capitalized gas costs of a regulated entity that are expected to be recoverable through rate adjustments within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Dividends Receivable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash disbursements due from investments, representing the shareholders' portion of profits.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Officers and Stockholders, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current receivables (due within one year or one operating cycle) to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Earnest Money Deposits Outstanding
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of deposits given by the reporting entity to a seller which shows that the prospective buyer is serious about purchasing a property.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Film Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film. Examples include, but are not limited to, costs of story and scenario, compensation, set construction and postproduction costs.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Guarantee Insurance Contract Liabilities (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased. Proprietary securities transactions entered into by the broker-dealer for trading or investment purposes are included in "Securities Owned and Securities Sold, Not Yet Purchased." Although proprietary trading is frequently thought of as purchasing securities for sale to others, trading securities for the broker-dealer's own account sometimes leads to a liability for the fair value of securities sold but not yet purchased, that is, sold short. The broker-dealer is then obliged to purchase the securities at a future date at the then-current market price.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fuel Inventories
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of fuel held in inventory.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loss and Loss Adjustment Expense Reserve (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Other Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of other assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs to the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: The change in cash during the period due to the net increase or decrease in outstanding checks, the liability that represents checks that have been issued but that have not cleared. The entity may classify these cash flows as financing or operating activities. Another element, Increase (Decrease) in Outstanding Checks, Financing Activities, represents cash flows from outstanding checks classified as financing activities.

unclassified.label: IncreaseDecreaseInPayableForInvestmentPurchased
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in payable for purchase of investment.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of assets that are created when regulatory agencies permits public utilities to defer costs (revenues) to the balance sheet. This element is a the increase (decrease) of regulatory assets and liabilities combined.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Regulatory Liabilities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in regulated liabilities. Regulated liabilities are created when regulatory agency permits an entity to defer revenues to the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Reserve for Commissions, Expense and Taxes
unclassified.description: The change in the reserve for commissions, expenses and taxes recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Trading Liabilities
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of trading liabilities from the reporting entity's trading activities. This include liabilities resulting from sales of assets that the reporting entity does not own and revaluation losses.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Unproved Oil and Gas Property
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the book value of property designated for oil and gas production that has not been found (through exploratory drilling) to have extractible reserves of oil and gas.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-Lived Franchise Rights
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through a franchise arrangement having an indefinite period of benefit.

unclassified.label: Insurance Agency Management Fee
unclassified.description: Fees earned during the period for providing management services.

unclassified.label: Insurance Investment Income
unclassified.description: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

unclassified.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) of amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedBeforeAccumulatedAmortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearFour
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed, expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearOne
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed, expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearThree
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed, expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedEstimatedAmortizationExpenseYearTwo
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed, expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Intangibles Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Interest Accrual Rate Associated with Amortization Method of Present Value of Future Insurance Profits
unclassified.description: Rate of interest used in determination of present value of future profits on insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income related to commercial loans including industrial and agricultural, real estate (commercial and residential, construction and development), trade financing, and lease financing.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Credit Card
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income from credit card balances due from individuals. Such loans are considered revolving credit arrangements.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Trade Financing
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income generated by trade financing. Trade financing is a specialized area of commercial lending frequently used by businesses that engage in international activities. Such financing includes open account financing, sales on consignment, documentary collections, advances against collections, letters of credit, bankers' acceptances, factoring, and forfeiting.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Nonmortgage Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

unclassified.label: InterestEarningAssetsAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of interest-earning assets.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Beneficial Interests Issued by Consolidated Variable Interest Entities
unclassified.description: Interest expense on beneficial interests issued by consolidated variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Junior Subordinated Debentures
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on loans received from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

unclassified.label: InterestExpenseTimeDepositIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest expense on time deposit.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, of $100,000 or more in domestic offices.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Trading, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold
unclassified.description: Interest income on federal funds sold. Federal funds sold represent the excess federal funds held by one commercial bank which it lends to another commercial bank, usually at an agreed-upon (federal funds) rate of interest. Such loans generally are of short-duration (overnight).

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeFinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from financing receivable before allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The carrying amount (fair value) as of the balance sheet date of the transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (typically securitized receivables, generally not involved in the collection of principal) following transfer of significant portions of such financial instruments to other parties. Such interests could be ancillary cash flows and interest-only strips.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Buildings and Improvements
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of building structures held as inventory including any additions, improvements, or renovations to those structures.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Noncurrent, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of inventory expected to be realized or consumed after one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Real Estate, Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Represents properties which were acquired directly or through foreclosure for which a committed plan to sell exists and an active program to market such properties has been initiated.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Real Estate, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in certain other real estate investments not specifically identified elsewhere in the existing taxonomy.

unclassified.label: InvestmentBasisSpreadVariableRate
unclassified.description: Percentage added to reference rate used to compute variable rate on investment.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyAmountReceivedToNavExcessLess
unclassified.description: Amount received for shares issued in excess of (less than) net asset value (NAV) of same class of security before sale.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyAverageNetAssets
unclassified.description: Amount of average net assets for investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Contributed Capital to Committed Capital Ratio
unclassified.description: Percentage of capital contributed to capital committed by investment company's investors.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyDebtInstrumentAmountRepaidToNavExcessLess
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for repayment of debt instrument in excess of (less than) net asset value (NAV) at date of repayment.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Appreciation (Depreciation)
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) from unrealized appreciation (depreciation) of investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Distributable Earnings (Loss), Accumulated Capital Loss Carryforward
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed deficit from capital loss carryforward of investment company.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyDistributionOrdinaryIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend distribution by investment company from ordinary income.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Dividend Distribution
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend distribution from ordinary income and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyExpenseAfterReductionOfFeeWaiverAndReimbursement
unclassified.description: Amount, after reimbursement and fee waiver, of expense for generation of investment income classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Financial Support to Investee Contractually Required, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of financial support committed by investment company to investee that is contractually required.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Gain (Loss) on in-kind Redemption
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on redemption of investment company shares or units by payment in portfolio securities.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Incentive Fee to Average Net Assets
unclassified.description: Percentage of incentive fee expense to average net assets.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyIncreaseDecreaseFromShareTransaction
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity from change in number of shares or units by investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss), Per Share
unclassified.description: Per-basic-share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss) from investment held by investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) Ratio
unclassified.description: Percentage of investment income (loss) to average net assets.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyPreferredShareAmountRepurchasedToNavExcessLess
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for repurchase of preferred shares in excess of (less than) net asset value (NAV) at repurchase date.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyPurchasePremiumPerShare
unclassified.description: Per share amount of premium paid by investor to purchase shares of investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, per unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyTotalReturnMarketValue
unclassified.description: Percentage increase (decrease) in portfolio market value assuming reinvestment of dividend and capital gain distribution.

unclassified.label: Investment in Federal Home Loan Bank Stock, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investments in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

unclassified.label: InvestmentIncomeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

unclassified.label: InvestmentInterestRateFloor
unclassified.description: Minimum rate of interest on investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Balance, Contracts
unclassified.description: Balance held at close of period in number of contracts.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Restricted, Cost
unclassified.description: The cost of the restricted investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Depreciation
unclassified.description: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Sale Proceeds
unclassified.description: The amount of proceeds received resulting from the short sale of a security.

unclassified.label: InvestmentUnrestrictedPurchasePriceDatePerUnit
unclassified.description: Per unit amount of unrestricted investment at date when purchase price was agreed, including, but not limited to, share or other unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Amount of Equity
Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Balance, Shares
Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Dividends or Interest
Investments in Power and Distribution Projects
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of investments in power and distribution projects that are expected to be realized after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Japanese Welfare Pension Insurance Law, Government Subsidy
JointVentureFormationFairValueOfJointVenture
unclassified.description: Fair value of joint venture at its formation date.

unclassified.label: Jointly Owned Utility Plant, Proportionate Ownership Share
unclassified.description: The proportionate share of interest (percent) in a jointly owned utility plant.

unclassified.label: Land under Purchase Options, Not Recorded
unclassified.description: Discloses the total purchase price of land option agreements that were not recorded.

unclassified.label: Oil and Gas Property, Lease Operating Expense (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Leasing Commissions Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of commissions expense incurred because the lessor of real estate obtained a lessee for a rental property through a real estate agent.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Assumptions and Judgments, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of operating lease term.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Indemnification Payment Received
unclassified.description: Amount received for indemnification payment for tax effect other than investment tax credit for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Lease Investment
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of leveraged lease investments which represent the aggregate amount of the estimated residual value of the lease assets and lease payments receivables, net of unearned and deferred income to be allocated over the lease term and non-recourse debt.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: The total recognized during the period for income on leases meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases including deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Benefits Paid (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Asbestos Obligations
unclassified.description: The amount of asbestos related liabilities included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Capital Lease Obligations and Accrued Interest
unclassified.description: The amount of capital lease obligations and related accrued interest included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Cash Disbursements and Reclassification Increase (Decrease) under Bankruptcy Court Order, Resolutions of Contingencies Subject to Chapter 11 (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Employee and Deemed Claims
unclassified.description: The amount of employee and related claims included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Expense (Income) Items (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Expense (Reversal of Expense) for Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) related to liabilities subject to compromise since the bankruptcy filing date.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Payments under Bankruptcy Court Order for Trade Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to creditors related to liabilities subject to compromise pursuant to bankruptcy court orders for trade accounts payable.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Provision for Expected and Allowed Claims
unclassified.description: The amount of the provision for expected and allowed claims included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liability for Asbestos and Environmental Claims, Net, Incurred Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process attributable to asbestos and environmental claims.

unclassified.label: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Property Casualty Liability
unclassified.description: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to casualty insurance insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date) and the amount needed to provide for the estimated ultimate cost required to investigate and settle claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before a particular date (ordinarily, the balance sheet date), whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) of Actual Variance from Expected Experience
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected net premium component for liability of future policy benefit from effect of variance from cash flow assumption change for actual experience.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitRemeasurementGainLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of remeasurement gain (loss) on liability for future policy benefit from application of revised benefit ratio as of contract issue. Includes, but is not limited to, remeasurement gain (loss) for annuitization insurance benefit, death and other insurance benefits, and traditional and limited-payment contracts.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Other Contracts
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under other insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Liability for Policyholder Contract Deposits, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of interest credited to policyholder deposits.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in the current period and related claims settlement costs.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in prior periods and related claims settlement costs.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred but Not Reported (IBNR) Claims, Amount
unclassified.description: Estimated costs as of the balance sheet date of settling insured claims and costs incurred in the claims settlement process for claims that have not yet been submitted to the insurance company for reimbursement.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Adjustments
unclassified.description: Sum of adjustments to the estimated reserve for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of increase (decrease) in the liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

unclassified.label: Liability, Premium Deficiency Testing on Long-Duration Contract, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of liability from premium deficiency and loss recognition testing on long-duration contract issued by insurance entity. Excludes closed block.

unclassified.label: Life Insurance Assumed Ratio
unclassified.description: Ratio of life insurance assumed from another insurer to gross life insurance in force.

unclassified.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Authorized
unclassified.description: The number of limited partner units authorized to be issued.

unclassified.label: Limited Partners' Capital Account, Units Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of limited partner units outstanding.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Decrease, Forgiveness (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Items Previously Not Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of other item not previously recognized but expected to be either sold or used to settle liability in liquidation under liquidation basis of accounting.

unclassified.label: Loan Restructuring, Trial Modifications, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable modified on trial basis.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Collateral for Secured Borrowings
Loans and Leases Receivable, Commitments to Purchase or Sell
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable commitment to purchase or sell.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Consumer, Allowance (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment and Revolving (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred interest and fee income, unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Foreign, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Covered
unclassified.description: Aggregate gross carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Accrual of Interest
unclassified.description: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which interest is continuing to be earned or accrued.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process
unclassified.description: Amount of undisbursed portion of the loan receivable balance (loans in process). Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered and Not Covered
unclassified.description: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Ratio of Nonperforming Loans to All Loans
unclassified.description: Percentage of nonperforming loan to total loans.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Collections (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Additions to Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Deductions from Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of deduction to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Long Lived Assets Held-for-sale, Impairment Charge (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Long-term Debt, Components, Commercial Loans, Current (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Long-term Debt, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure long-term debt.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling after Year Five (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Five (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Four (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Long-term Debt of Registrant, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Two (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Loss Contingency Accrual, Insurance-related Assessment, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: The rate applied as of the balance sheet date to reduce the undiscounted amount of a guarantee fund and other insurance-related assessments to present value.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Discount
unclassified.description: The amount of imputed interest necessary to reduce (reconcile) the estimated aggregate undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) to the present value recognized on the balance sheet (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product or process expected to be paid in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: LossContingencyAccrualProductLiabilityDueInRollingYearTwo
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount of the accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product or process expected to be paid in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Related Receivable Carrying Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loss Contingency, Receivable, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of receivables pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Loss on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
unclassified.description: The amount of loss reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Loss on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of recognized loss from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Loss Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of loss recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

unclassified.label: Malpractice Insurance, Annual Coverage Limit
unclassified.description: Annual coverage limit provided by the insurance arrangement for malpractice claims.

unclassified.label: Malpractice Loss Contingency, Claims Incurred in Period
unclassified.description: Amount of loss recognized for asserted and unasserted malpractice claims.

unclassified.label: ManagementAndIncentiveFeesExpense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for management and incentive fees for performance under arrangement to manage operation, including, but not limited to, managing investment.

unclassified.label: Margin Deposit Assets
unclassified.description: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.

unclassified.label: MarketRiskBenefitLiabilityAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of liability position for contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk.

unclassified.label: Maturities of Subordinated Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a long-term borrowing where lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets as it matures.

unclassified.label: Memberships in Exchanges Owned
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized cost for obtaining membership with right to do business on trading exchange.

unclassified.label: Mineral Extraction Processing and Marketing Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Mineral Rights
unclassified.description: Carrying amount at the balance sheet date of mineral rights, or rights to extract a mineral from the earth or to receive payment in the form of a royalty for the extraction of minerals, net of amortization.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Net Capital Required for Entity
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Joint Venture Partners (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Limited Partnerships (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) of Consolidated Entities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Preferred Unit Holders
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling preferred unit holders in an entity included in the reporting entity's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Mortgage-backed Securities Available-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as available-for-sale.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net
unclassified.description: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Cost of Mortgage Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from sale.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Interest Rate
SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Periodic Payment Terms, Balloon Payment Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Multiemployer Plan, Employee Increase (Decrease), Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of increase (decrease) in entity's employees covered by multiemployer plan.

unclassified.label: Net Capital under Commodity Exchange Act Computation
Net Change Contract Holders Funds
unclassified.description: The cash inflow or outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

unclassified.label: Net Change Interest-bearing Deposits, Foreign
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in interest bearing deposits foreign.

unclassified.label: Net Change Noninterest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
