unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in domestic noninterest bearing deposits.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of income (loss) from consolidated real estate investments attributed to parent.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss), Per Outstanding Limited Partnership Unit, Basic, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Per unit of ownership amount after tax of income (loss) available to outstanding limited partnership (LP) unit-holder.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Assets, Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivatives designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAccruedInterestWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseChangeInPresentValueInterestIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseNonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Net Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Trading Securities
Net Shares Reclassified to Mandatorily Redeemable Capital Stock, Shares
unclassified.description: Net number of shares reclassified to mandatorily redeemable capital stock.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Current Period Disclosures, Deferred Revenue, Amount (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Income from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Options Issued
unclassified.description: The number of options issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Limited Partnerships, Nonredeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling partner of a limited partnership.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Other Noncontrolling Interests, Nonredeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to other nonredeemable noncontrolling equity holder.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Preferred Unit Holders, Redeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling preferred unit holders.

unclassified.label: Nondebtor Reorganization Items, Net (Gain) Loss on Settlement of Other Claims (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
unclassified.description: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Distribution and Servicing Fees (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees
unclassified.description: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves investment results above a specified contractual level.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Credit Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Derivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on a nonderivative instrument.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Price Risk Cash Flow Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

unclassified.label: Number of Aircraft Operated
unclassified.description: Number of aircraft operated by airline.

unclassified.label: Number of Units in Real Estate Property
unclassified.description: The number of units in a real estate property owned as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable from other entities recognized in the balance sheet resulting from the joint and several liability arrangement.

unclassified.label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Corresponding Entry, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of asset in corresponding entry for joint and several liability arrangement.

unclassified.label: OCI, Market Risk Benefit, Instrument-Specific Credit Risk, Adjustment from AOCI for Derecognition, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for gain (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, not recognized in income and used in calculating liability for future policy benefit for payout annuity.

unclassified.label: OciMarketRiskBenefitInstrumentSpecificCreditRiskGainLossReclassificationAdjustmentFromAociAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for gain (loss) (AOCI) from (increase) decrease in instrument-specific credit risk on contract or contract feature in long-duration contract issued by insurance entity that both protects contract holder from other-than-nominal capital market risk and exposes insurance entity to other-than-nominal capital market risk, realized in income upon derecognition for benefit.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Carrying Amount at Lease Inception Exceeds Fair Value
unclassified.description: This element represents the loss resulting from the amount by which the cost or carrying amount, if different, of an asset subject to an agreement classified as an operating lease, at the inception of a lease involving real estate, exceeds the fair value of the leased property.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Contingent Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of contingent rental revenue recognized for the period under lease, based on the occurrences of an event or condition.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Initial Direct Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of incremental cost of lease that would not have been incurred if lease had not been obtained.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases of Lessor, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessor's operating lease.

unclassified.label: OptionContractIndexedToEquitySettlementCashEffectOfChangeInFairValueOfShare
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash that would be paid upon settlement from change in fair value of share for option contract indexed to equity.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Redeemable Stock, Redemption Requirements, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of redeemable stock for issue of capital stock that are redeemable at fixed or determinable prices on fixed or determinable dates in each of the five years following the date of the latest statement of financial position presented.

unclassified.label: Origination of Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to finance the entity's defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Costs Arising During Period ,Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Derecognition, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk, realized upon derecognition of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk on financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from derivative designated and qualifying as net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Investment Transferred from Available-for-sale to Equity Method, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) of investment classified as available-for-sale transferred to equity method.

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Held-to-maturity Transferred to Available-for-Sale Securities, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Adjustment from AOCI for Accretion of Noncredit Portion of OTTI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for accretion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Adjustments, Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax (expense) benefit for increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized in earnings for investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Assets at Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Liabilities at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities not designated as a hedging instrument.

unclassified.label: Other Increase (Decrease) in Provision for Restructuring (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Other Interest Earning Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of interest earning assets classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Purchased Goods, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount of components used by the entity which are bought from another entity rather than produced by the entity.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Significant Noncash Items Other than Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Ownership Interests, Units Issued
unclassified.description: The number of units of other ownership interests issued in a limited partnership or master limited partnership. Does not include limited or general partners' ownership interests.

unclassified.label: Other Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount of other payables due to broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

unclassified.label: Liability, Other Retirement Benefits, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, classified as noncurrent, for retirement benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate and Foreclosed Assets
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of other real estate and foreclosed assets. Other real estate may include real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. Foreclosed assets include all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Disposals
unclassified.description: Disposals of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

unclassified.label: Other Secured Financings
unclassified.description: Secured financing other than securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Received (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, Additional Credit Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held for which previous OTTI was recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI), investor does not intend to sell debt security, and it is not more likely than not that investor will be required to sell debt security before recovery of its amortized cost basis.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Reductions, Securities Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security from sale of impaired security.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in earnings and other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive income loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Collateral
unclassified.description: The amount of collateral required to be received or received by the entity from the counterparty (share borrower) in connection with an own-share lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

unclassified.label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Shares, Outstanding, Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the date of the statement of financial position of shares outstanding in connection with an own-share lending arrangement, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

unclassified.label: Participating Insurance, Percentage of Premium Income
unclassified.description: Percentage of participating insurance to premium income.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Distribution Per Unit of Limited Partner Interest
unclassified.description: The amount of the distribution per unit of limited partner interest.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Redemptions
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to redemptions and adjustments to redemption value. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units
unclassified.description: The number of each class of partnership units outstanding at the balance sheet date. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Change in the number of units for each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to acquisitions. Partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Redeemed
unclassified.description: The number of units redeemed during the year of each class of partners' capital account. Units represent shares of ownership of the general, limited, and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Units, Sale of Units
unclassified.description: Total units issued during the year due to the sale of units. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of partners' capital (deficit), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests. Excludes temporary equity and is sometimes called permanent equity.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
unclassified.description: Cash outflow during the period as a deposit on account for application (deposits to retire or pay down) against an amount of debt owed by the entity.

unclassified.label: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Payments for Film Costs
unclassified.description: Cash payments related to direct negative costs incurred in the physical production of a film, as well as allocations of production overhead and capitalized interest. Examples of direct negative costs include costs of story and scenario; compensation of cast, directors, producers, extras, and miscellaneous staff; costs of set construction and operations, wardrobe, and accessories; costs of sound synchronization; rental facilities on location; and postproduction costs such as music, special effects, and editing.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

unclassified.label: Payments for Origination of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Deposits
unclassified.description: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the mortgage.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Interest Earning Assets
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in other interest earning assets not separately disclosed.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Trust Preferred Securities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stocks issued by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

unclassified.label: Payments for Time Deposits
unclassified.description: Cash paid to customers who withdraw money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire and Develop Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land and anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth, and payments to develop real estate assets by adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements. Including real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excluding real estate acquired for use by the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Management Contract Rights
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from amounts paid for the rights to manage the property.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Oil and Gas Equipment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to purchase long lived physical asset use for the normal oil and gas operations and not intended for resale.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Water Systems
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of a facility and equipment that provides water supply which includes wells, reservoirs, pumping stations, and control facilities.

unclassified.label: Payments to Fund Policy Loans
unclassified.description: The initial funding or additional funding of loans receivable to policy holders principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

unclassified.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plans, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Percentage of FIFO Inventory
unclassified.description: The percentage of FIFO (first in first out) inventory to total inventory as of the balance sheet date if other than 100 percent.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Money Market
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Savings
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Unamortized Film Costs
unclassified.description: The percentage of unamortized film costs for released films, excluding acquired film libraries, that it expects to amortize within three years from the date of the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Finance Receivables
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Real Estate Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Securities Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Securities Pledged under Letter of Credit Facilities, at Fair Value
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Loans Receivable Pledged as Collateral
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities for Letter of Credit Facilities
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities
Policy Loans Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of loans made to policyholders against the cash surrender value (CSV) or other policyholder funds, and secured by the CSV, policyholder funds or the death benefit provided by the insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Postage Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense associated with postage.

unclassified.label: Postconfirmation, Preferred and Common Stock Held in Treasury
Preconfirmation, Preferred and Common Stock Held in Treasury
Preconfirmation, Prepaid and Other Current Assets
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Par or Stated Value Per Share (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Shares, Outstanding (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Units, Preferred Partners' Capital Accounts
unclassified.description: The amount of the preferred partners' ownership interests.

unclassified.label: Premiums Earned, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-17, Insurance Companies, Reinsurance, Premium, Percentage Assumed to Net
unclassified.description: Percentage of assumed premium earned to premium earned after effects of reinsurance, as disclosed in supplementary reinsurance information.

unclassified.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.

unclassified.label: Premiums Receivable, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Provision Charged to Expense (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of premium receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Premiums Receivable, Proceeds from Sale of Receivables
unclassified.description: The amount of proceeds from the transfer of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

unclassified.label: Preproduction Costs Related to Long-term Supply Arrangements, Costs Capitalized
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of capitalized preproduction costs incurred on long-term supply arrangements, including recoverable costs to design and develop products.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit, Net Periodic Postretirement Benefit Cost, (Increase) Decrease for Subsidy
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in net periodic benefit cost from government subsidy for prescription drug benefits.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Five Fiscal Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipts, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Accrued Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination from accrued interest on unamortized balance.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Amortization Expense, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of amortization expense) for future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination from realized investment gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Percentage, Year One
unclassified.description: Percentage of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Price Risk Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of price risk derivative assets, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as assets on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Asset, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Price Risk Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Liability, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Price Risk Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of price risk derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Price Risk Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of price risk derivative assets, net of price risk derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Price Risk Fair Value Hedge Derivative, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all price risk derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Principal Amount Outstanding on Loans Managed and Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: This is the sum of principal amount outstanding for both securitized and unsecuritized loans of all types.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Other Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes loans that are not mortgages.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Contribution in Aid of Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from contribution in aid of construction, classified as investing activity. Includes, but is not limited to, contribution from developer, builder, government agency, and municipality.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Customers for Progress Payments
unclassified.description: Cash received from customers as progress payments on projects that have been partially completed.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Distributions Received from Real Estate Partnerships
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from earnings received from real estate partnerships.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Financing Revenue Received under Leases
Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
unclassified.description: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Deposits Applied to Debt Retirements
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from payments to deposit account and application of deposits to retire or pay down debt during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
unclassified.description: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Rents Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for rents during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Accounts Receivable Securitization
unclassified.description: Proceeds from (repayments of) securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Mortgage Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from proceeds from sale of receivables arising from the mortgage note on real estate; includes collections on mortgage notes receivable that are not classified as operating cash flows.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale and collection of receivables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Flight Equipment
unclassified.description: Cash received from sales of long-lived depreciable flight assets, including owned aircraft or capital improvements.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Credit Cards
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the securitization of credit card receivables. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Loans Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

unclassified.label: ProceedsSalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeasePreviouslyWrittenOffRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of net investment in sales-type lease, previously written off.

unclassified.label: Product Liability Accrual, Component Amount
unclassified.description: Recorded amount of the accrual for a material component of a product liability contingency.

unclassified.label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Production Costs, Cumulative
unclassified.description: The capitalized costs incurred (excluded from amortization), as of the date of the balance sheet, to operate and maintain wells and related equipment and facilities, including depreciation and applicable operating costs of support equipment and facilities and other costs of operating and maintaining those wells and related equipment and facilities. They become part of the cost of oil and gas produced. Examples of production costs (sometimes called lifting costs) are: costs of labor to operate the wells and related equipment and facilities; repairs and maintenance; materials, supplies, and fuel consumed and supplies utilized in operating the wells and related equipment and facilities; property taxes and insurance applicable to proved properties and wells and related equipment and facilities; severance taxes; some support equipment or facilities may serve two or more oil and gas producing activities and may also serve transportation, refining, and marketing activities. To the extent that the support equipment and facilities are used in oil and gas producing activities, their depreciation and applicable operating costs become exploration, development or production costs, as appropriate. Depreciation, depletion, and amortization of capitalized acquisition, exploration, and development costs are not production costs but also become part of the cost of oil and gas produced along with production (lifting) costs identified above.

unclassified.label: Progress Payments Netted Against Inventory for Long-term Contracts or Programs
unclassified.description: Amount of advances received from customers under long-term contracts which have been offset against inventories accounts at the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Collections, Not Capitalized
unclassified.description: Amount not capitalized of work of art, historical treasure, and similar asset classified as collections.

unclassified.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentCollectionsNotCapitalizedDeaccessedFairValue
unclassified.description: Fair value of not capitalized work of art, historical treasure, and similar asset classified as collections that are deaccessed.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life, Average (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Public Utilities, Amount of Allowance for Funds Used During Construction, Equity Costs Capitalized Only for Rate-making Purposes
unclassified.description: Amount of costs of debt and equity financing capitalized for setting rates but not capitalized for financial statement purposes.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Rate Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of public utility's approved rate increase (decrease) by regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Return on Equity, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved return on equity.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Interim Rate Increase (Decrease), Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's interim rate increase (decrease) allowed while waiting final decision of regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Inventory
unclassified.description: The period end amount for a type of inventory held by the utility in a schedule of inventories.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Equipment
unclassified.description: Period end book value of equipment owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Interest Rate on Intermediary Debt for Electric Utility Plant Construction
unclassified.description: Discloses the interest rate related to debt for plant construction for an electric utility using an intermediary for each period for which an income statement is presented.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
unclassified.description: Period end amount of total net PPE.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Original Cost of Intangible Utility Plants
unclassified.description: Original cost of establishing intangible utility plants.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Requested Equity Capital Structure, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's requested equity to capital, including debt and equity.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Requested Rate Increase (Decrease), Amended, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of public utility's amended requested rate increase (decrease) with regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Requested Return on Equity, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's requested return on equity.

unclassified.label: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Principal Amount Outstanding (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Arrangements of Financial Support, Amount
unclassified.description: The transferor's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its continuing involvement in transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: Quarterly Financial Information, Quarterly Charges and Credits, Amount Affecting Comparability
unclassified.description: Amount of the item included in the interim period that affected period-to-period comparability (excluding restatement adjustments).

unclassified.label: Quarterly Financial Information, Quarterly Charges and Credits, Amount Reconciling to Previously Reported Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation pertaining to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule III, Real Estate, Federal Income Tax Basis
SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale
unclassified.description: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale by the consolidated entity.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale, Subsidiary
unclassified.description: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or resale by subsidiary entities which hold such assets in the course of business.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest costs that were capitalized to properties under development during the land development and construction period of a project, and which are included in inventory.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Partnership Cost of Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of cost of sales related to investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Partnership Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investments, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investments, Joint Ventures
unclassified.description: The book value of investments in real estate joint ventures including direct and indirect investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Amounts Applied
unclassified.description: Amount of the valuation allowance for real estate owned that was applied in the period against the carrying amount of real estate owned that was sold, written down or written off.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance
unclassified.description: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Receivable for Recovery of Import Duties, Net, Current (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Receivables from Brokers-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

unclassified.label: Receivables with Imputed Interest, Amortization Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of amortization of the discount or premium on the note or receivable which was the result of the determination of present value in cash or noncash transactions, recognized in the statement of operations for the period.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, Value, Excluding Additional Paid in Capital (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the reporting date of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Other, Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest for other shares, units or ownership interests classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the reporting date of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Range of Estimated Fair Value, High (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Registration Payment Arrangement, Gains and Losses
unclassified.description: The decrease (gain) or increase (loss) in the carrying amount of the registration payment obligation that was recognized in earnings during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulated and Unregulated Operating Revenue
unclassified.description: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Other
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated other operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulated Operating Revenue, Steam
unclassified.description: The amount of regulated steam operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: The amount for the individual regulatory asset as itemized in a table of regulatory assets as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Regulatory Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The amount for the individual regulatory noncurrent liability as itemized in a table of regulatory noncurrent liabilities as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Assumed and Ceded
unclassified.description: Amount of recovery (expense) related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed and ceded.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Payable
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the known and estimated amounts owed to insurers under reinsurance treaties or other arrangements.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverables, Including Reinsurance Premium Paid
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts including premium paid under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverables, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation allowance recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

unclassified.label: Reorganization Value, Cash in Excess of Normal Operating Needs
unclassified.description: Amount of reorganization value related to cash in excess of normal operating requirements generated by operations. Reorganization value is the amount attributed to the reconstituted entity, as well as the expected net realizable value of those assets that will be disposed before reconstitution occurs.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow related to equity securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Zero or Negative Carrying Amount, Number
unclassified.description: Number of reporting units with zero or negative amount of net assets.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost Remaining (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Reportable Segment, Cost Incurred to Date (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Reportable Segment, Expected Cost (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Reportable Segment, Incurred Cost (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Results of Operations, Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment for oil and gas properties charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Income Tax Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Sales or Transfers to Entity's Other Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue from sale and transfer to entity's other operation in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Retail Land Sale Receivables, Weighted Average Interest Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Retail Land Sales, Deposit Method, Deposit Received
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of deposit received in a retail land sale transaction accounted for under the deposit method.

unclassified.label: Retail Land Sale, Estimated Cost of Major Improvement
unclassified.description: Estimated cost of expenditure for improvement for each major area from which retail land sale was made during five fiscal years following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Retail Land Sales, Installment Method, Cost of Sales
unclassified.description: Cost of sales related to retail land sales transactions accounted for under the installment method.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Retrospective Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Tabular Presentation by Financial Statement Line Item, Amount of Application Adjustment (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Revenue Recognition, Multiple-deliverable Arrangements, Determination of Selling Price, Amount
unclassified.description: Represents the value established as the selling price of the significant unit of accounting used to allocate the consideration of the multiple-deliverable arrangement.

unclassified.label: Revenue Recognition, New Accounting Pronouncement, Material Effect, Revenue Deferred under Amended Guidance (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Revenue Recognition, New Accounting Pronouncement, Material Effect, Revenue Recognized under Amended Guidance (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Revenue Recognition, New Accounting Pronouncement, Revenue Recognized under Prior Guidance (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Risk-Weighted Assets, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Cumulative Gain Recognized
unclassified.description: Cumulative amount of gain recognized (out of deferred gain) as income or a reduction in rent expense.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Imputed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The financing cost related to leases that have been recorded under the deposit method, as a financing or as a capital leases in connection with the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Other Payments Required
unclassified.description: Other amounts the seller-lessee is required to pay under the terms of the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and lease of the property back to the seller, including reimbursements for such items, as utilities, taxes, insurance and common area maintenance.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Quarterly Rental Payments
unclassified.description: The amount of the quarterly rental payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transactions involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Transaction Costs, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for transaction costs in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, closing and debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Sales Revenue from Energy Commodities and Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, Commencement
unclassified.description: Amount of sales-type lease initial direct cost recognized as expense at commencement date.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: SalesTypeLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Unguaranteed Residual Asset
unclassified.description: Present value expected to be derived from underlying asset following end of lease term not guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Variable Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of sales-type lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Secured Borrowings, Gross, Difference, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of secured borrowings in excess of (less than) the liability for repurchase agreements and securities lending transactions, before offset, included in offsetting disclosures.

unclassified.label: Secured Debt, Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Carrying value, as of the balance sheet date, of securities sold under agreements to repurchase where the transferor maintains effective control over the assets, accounting for them as secured debt.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: SecuritiesBorrowedCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of securities borrowed from other entities.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of the securities received as collateral against securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability associated with securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Gross
