unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Increase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, offset against an obligation to return collateral.

unclassified.label: Securities Received as Collateral, Amount Repledged and Sold
unclassified.description: The fair value of collateral received that has been sold or re-pledged and is owed to the debtor (transferor) upon settlement of the related contractual obligation under which it was received.

unclassified.label: Securities Reserve Deposit Required and Made
unclassified.description: Securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

unclassified.label: Securities Segregated under Securities Exchange Commission Regulation
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of asset associated with funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price.

unclassified.label: SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security sold under agreement to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Fair Value
Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Quoted Price
unclassified.description: Amount of not readily marketable security or investment measured by quoted price.

unclassified.label: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 10 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 10 percent adverse change of the discount rate on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: A specified percentage variance in the discount rate assumption in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityPeriodIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in liability for separate account.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityPolicyCharge
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in separate account liability from policy charge.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityPremium
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow to separate account liability from premium collected from policyholder.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing assets that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs or Changes in Assumptions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs, assumptions, or model used to calculate the fair value of the contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of additions from purchases, assumption or transfer to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Balance
unclassified.description: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs or Changes in Assumptions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs, assumptions, or model used to calculate the fair value of the contract to service financial assets under which the estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The net increase (decrease) in the fair value of servicing liabilities subsequently measured at fair value.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares to be Repurchased Next Year
unclassified.description: An entity expecting to repurchase shares in the following period, generally discloses an estimate of the amount or range of shares to be repurchased.

unclassified.label: Shareholder Loans to Finance Leveraged Buyout (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Excess of Assets over Liabilities
unclassified.description: The value of the excess of assets over liabilities. If all outstanding shares are subject to mandatory redemption and the redemption price is less than the book value (the redemption price is less than the company's equity balance), the resulting cumulative transition adjustment and subsequent adjustments to reflect changes in the redemption price of the shares are recorded as an excess of assets over liabilities (equity).

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Maximum Amount
unclassified.description: The maximum amount that the issuer could be required to pay to redeem the instrument by physical settlement, if applicable.

unclassified.label: Short-Duration Contracts, Discounted Liabilities, Amount
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of loss reserves carried at present value.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, maximum month-end borrowings during the period.

unclassified.label: Significant Acquisitions and Disposals, Gain (Loss) on Sale or Disposal, Pretax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Significant Costs Incurred to Acquire Mineral Interest of Proved Reserves
unclassified.description: Significant costs that have been incurred, including capitalized costs and costs charged to expense, to acquire mineral interests that have proved reserves.

unclassified.label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Best Estimate
unclassified.description: Best estimate of the reasonably possible loss exposure in excess of the amount accrued for environmental loss contingencies at an individual site.

unclassified.label: Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Site Contingency, Loss Exposure in Excess of Accrual, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Square Footage of Real Estate Property (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Currency Translation, Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Standard Product Warranty Accrual, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the standard product warranty accrual. Excludes extended product warranties.

unclassified.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Portion of Excess Retained Earnings Not Taxed
unclassified.description: The amount of retained earnings as of the balance sheet date in excess of statutory unassigned surplus on which no income tax provisions have been made.

unclassified.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Amount Available for Dividend Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of dividends available for payment after computation of statutory restrictions on capital surplus.

unclassified.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Amount Available for Dividend Payments without Regulatory Approval
unclassified.description: Amount of dividends that can be declared or paid without approval of regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Adjusted Balance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Storm Damage Provision
unclassified.description: A noncash adjustment to the provision established for storm damage by an oil, gas, or utility company.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Deferred Income Tax Provision on Gain (Loss) Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount provided for deferred income taxes in relation to any gain (loss) recognized in income of the entity resulting from the issuance of shares by a subsidiary or equity method investee.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Noncontrolling Interest in Income of Subsidiary
unclassified.description: The dividends from redeemable preferred stock of a subsidiary that are accounted for as a noncontrolling interest in income of a subsidiary in a parent's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Price-Per-Share (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-15, Insurance Companies, Summary of Investments, Other than Investments in Related Parties, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of investment held by insurance company, excluding investment in related party.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-15, Insurance Companies, Summary of Investments, Other than Investments in Related Parties, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment held by insurance company, excluding investment in related party.

unclassified.label: Current Year Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense for claims incurred in the current reporting period and related claims settlement costs.

unclassified.label: Prior Year Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claims incurred in prior reporting periods and related claims settlement costs.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Continuation of Health Care
unclassified.description: Liability for extension of health coverage in instances where coverage under the plan would otherwise end.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Other Policy Claim and Benefit Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of claim and benefit payable classified as other, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-16, Insurance Companies, Supplementary Insurance Information, Premium Written
unclassified.description: Amount, after premiums ceded and assumed, of premium written, disclosed in supplementary insurance information.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in investment from unrealized gain (loss) when value exceeds (is less than) cost for federal income tax purpose.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Existing Income Tax Expense (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Existing Income Tax Benefit (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Existing Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Existing Undistributed Accumulated Earnings of Foreign Subsidiary (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Provisional Liability, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Undistributed Accumulated Earnings of Foreign Subsidiary, Existing Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 1 leverage capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 capital to average assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 1 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityUninsured
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability. Excludes uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, after Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing after the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of less than $100,000.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than four years, but five years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Four
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than three years, but four years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Three
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than two years, but three years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Two
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than one year, but two years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Sharing Transactions, Aggregate Maturities of Notes Receivable, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of notes receivable related to time share sales, before allowance for uncollectible accounts and deferred profit.

unclassified.label: Time Sharing Transactions, Allowance for Uncollectible Accounts
unclassified.description: Allowance for uncollectible accounts.

unclassified.label: Time-Sharing Transaction, Notes Receivable, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for uncollectible account, of notes receivable for time-sharing transaction maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Sharing Transactions, Weighted Average of Stated Interest Rates for Notes Receivable (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Trade Receivables Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Additions to Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to trade receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Trade Receivables Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in trade receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Trading Account Assets, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Trading Securities, Short-term Investments, Amortized Cost (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Transfers of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sale, Initial Fair Value of Assets Obtained as Proceeds
unclassified.description: Represents the initial fair value recorded for assets received on transfer of financial assets in a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or a similar transfer which transaction is recognized as a sale of the transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Increase (Decrease), Gross of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) in the cumulative translation adjustment from gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Tax Benefit (Expense) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Treasury Stock, Value, Retired, Cost Method (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Unamortized Discounts on Acceptances Resold
unclassified.description: The amount of the unamortized discount or expense related to the financial institution's sale of short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by the institution (also known as Banker's Acceptances) in the secondary market.

unclassified.label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected after Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected after the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected after Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected after the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unbilled Receivables, Not Billable, Amount Expected to be Collected in Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of receivables under long-term contracts that have not been billed and were not billable that are expected to be collected in the next fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to common stock as if earnings had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations, allocated to common stock, as if earnings and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares, had been distributed. Excludes distributed earnings.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Net Realized Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Units of Partnership Interest, Amount
unclassified.description: The number of units or equivalent units outstanding for all classes.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Energy Contracts
unclassified.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open agreements to purchase or sell energy at some future point, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hybrid Instrument, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of the unrealized gain (loss) in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value on hybrid instruments measured at fair value.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) arising from the change in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Fair Value Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of price risk derivatives instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of the fixed and determinable portion of the unrecorded unconditional purchase obligation maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unrecovered Production Costs, Excess Unrecoverable under Existing Firm Orders
unclassified.description: The portion of the aggregate amount of manufacturing or production costs and any related deferred costs (for example, initial tooling costs) that exceeds the aggregate estimated cost of all in-process and delivered units on the basis of the estimated average cost of all units expected to be produced under long-term contracts and programs not yet complete, which would not be absorbed in cost of sales based on existing firm orders at the latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Unregulated Operating Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of unregulated operating revenues recognized during the period.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Earnings Per Share Impact, Net
unclassified.description: Per share amount of earnings, after tax, of an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, Fourth Quarter (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Utilities Operating Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Impairments
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense for impairments of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense for taxes other than income taxes of regulated operation.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Balance
unclassified.description: Reflects the estimated amount of impairment as of the balance sheet date of recognized servicing assets that are being amortized in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Disposals
unclassified.description: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on disposal of the related asset.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales
unclassified.description: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on sale of the related asset.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Purchases
unclassified.description: The amount of purchases between the reporting entity and the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Carrying Amount of Assets, Consolidated VIE (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Carrying Amount of Liabilities, Consolidated VIE (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Assets, Not Pledged (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, Recourse (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Weighted Average General Partnership Units Outstanding
unclassified.description: Weighted average number of general partnership units outstanding determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that general partnership units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of time deposits, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Shares Not Committed to be Released
unclassified.description: Number of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) shares that have not been committed to be released determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate, Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits, Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate calculated at point in time for domestic deposit liability.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Money Market
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Savings
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic savings deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate, Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits, over Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate calculated over time for domestic deposit liability.

unclassified.label: Workers' Compensation Discount, Percent
unclassified.description: Percent discount applied to worker's compensation reserve liability to reduce the reserve to present value.
